在那裡有座「慘劇終末的村子」，那是擁有自己一套價值觀的慘劇終末們所生活的地方。



[簡介原文]
隅々まで探索されつくした世界に、唯一殘された秘境の大穴『アビス』。
どこまで続くとも知れない深く巨大なその縦穴には、奇妙奇怪な生物たちが生息し、今の人類では作りえない貴重な遺物が眠っている。
｢アビス｣の不可思議に満ちた姿は人々を魅了し、冒険へと駆り立てた。そうして幾度も大穴に挑戦する冒険者たちは、次第に『探窟家』と呼ばれるようになっていった。
アビスの縁に築かれた街『オース』に暮らす孤児のリコは、いつか母のような偉大な探窟家になり、アビスの謎を解き明かすことを夢見ていた。
ある日、母・ライザの白笛が発見されたことをきっかけに、アビスの奧深くへ潛ることを決意するリコ。リコに拾われた記憶喪失のロボット・レグも自分の記憶を探しに一緒に行くことを決意する。
深界四層でタマウガチの毒に苦しむリコ。リコを救ったのは成れ果てのナナチだった。ナナチを仲間に加え、ボンドルドの待つ深界五層へと三人は冒険を進める。 そこで、出會ったプルシュカと名乗る女の子は、ボンドルドに育てられ外界を知らずにいた。リコの冒険話に夢中になり一緒に冒険に行きたいと願うが、あえなくボンドルドの実験に利用されてしまう。
しかし、プルシュカは形を変えリコの白笛となり、一同は深界六層「還らずの都」へと進む。
そこには、成れ果てが獨自の価値観を持って生活している「成れ果ての村」が存在していた。
anilist:114745.synopsis_en:
The second season of Made in Abyss.

Directly after the events of Made in Abyss: Fukaki Tamashii no Reimei, the third installment of Made in Abyss covers the adventures of Reg, Riko, and Nanachi in the Sixth Layer, The Capital of the Unreturned.

Note: The last episode aired with a runtime of ~48 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.
anilist:114745.source_doc_raw: 來自深淵 烈日的黃金鄉(12)

anilist:133844.synopsis_zh:
アインズは悩んでいた。
アインズ・ウール・ゴウン魔導國の王として、この國をどのように導くのか。

アルベド、デミウルゴスら優秀なNPCたちと不眠不休で働けるアンデッドによって、
魔導國は今や安全で飢えもない場所となっている。
しかし、そこで暮らす人々はいまだ恐怖と不安を抱え、
街は火が消えたように靜かでかつての活気は失われていた。

答えが見つからぬ中、アインズは一人で冒険者組合を訪問。
組合長のアインザックにある提案をする。

一方、突如できた魔導國に戸惑う諸國の支配者たちも各々に対抗策を講じていた。
果たしてアインズは各國の謀略を阻み、自身の理想郷を作ることができるのか。
anilist:133844.synopsis_en:
The fourth season of Overlord.

E-Rantel, the capital city of the newly established Sorcerer Kingdom, suffers from a dire shortage of goods. Once a prosperous city known for its trade, it now faces a crisis due to its caution—or even fear—of its king, Ainz Ooal Gown. To make amends, Ainz sends Albedo to the city as a diplomatic envoy.

Meanwhile, the cardinals of the Slane Theocracy discuss how to retaliate against Ainz after his attack crippled the Re-Estize Kingdom's army, plotting for the Baharuth Empire to take over the Sorcerer Kingdom. However, when Emperor Jircniv Rune Farlord El Nix arranges a meeting with the Theocracy's messengers at a colosseum, he is confronted by none other than Ainz himself.

With their secret gathering now out in the open, the emperor and his guests learn that Ainz has challenged the Warrior King, the empire's greatest fighter, to a duel. With Ainz's motivations beyond his comprehension, Jircniv can do nothing but watch as humanity's future changes before his very eyes.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

titles.primary_zh: 轉生賢者的異世界生活～取得第二職業，成為世界最強～
titles.ja: 転生賢者の異世界ライフ～第二の職業を得て、世界最強になりました～
titles.ja_romaji: Tensei Kenja no Isekai Life: Daini no Shokugyou wo Ete, Sekai Saikyou ni Narimashita
titles.en: My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World!

anilist:129192.synopsis_zh: 在黑心企業工作的社畜佐野裕司像往常一樣帶工作回家做。突然，電腦螢幕上出現了一個陌生的視窗。——您，被召喚到異世界了！然後，裕司醒來看見的是，存在著狀態數值與技能的異世界。在這個異世界，職業作為“馴魔師”的他，根本難以成為冒險者。但在夥伴史萊姆的幫助下，裕司在一個晚上讀完了世界上誰也讀不完的魔導書，在不知不覺中取得了“賢者”的副職！雖然獲得壓倒性力量，裕司卻對自己的強大毫無自覺……？最強力量下無意識間成為世上最強！
anilist:129192.synopsis_en:
Getting isekai’d to a magical world and developing incredible powers is every otaku’s wildest dream, but for salaryman Yuuji Sano, it’s the stuff of absolute nightmare! He’s in the middle of a mountain of work when he gets unwillingly pulled into a fantasy realm, where he accomplishes the enviable feat of developing a second character class by making the most of his Monster Tamer abilities. Now he’s traded the office for adventuring to make a living, but he keeps getting roped into major events because his powers are unmatched, second to none — and he doesn't even realize it yet!

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)
anilist:129192.source_doc_raw: 轉生賢者的異世界生活～取得第二職業，成為世界最強～(12)

titles.primary_zh: 歡迎來到實力至上主義的教室 第二季
zh_aliases: 歡迎來到實力至上主義的教室
titles.ja: ようこそ実力至上主義の教室へ
titles.ja_romaji: Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e 2nd Season

anilist:145545.synopsis_zh:
這個社會是否平等呢。真正的“實力”是什麼——。
東京都高度育成高等學校。那是宣揚徹底的實力至上主義，以升學率·就業率100%而引以為豪的升學學校。升入那裡，被分配到1年D班的綾小路清隆，卻發現學校與實力至上主義的招牌相反，學生每個月會得到相當於10萬日元、與現金同等價值的分數，在授課和生活態度方面也貫徹放任主義。在夢幻般的高中生活當中，不斷地揮金如土、過著自甘墮落日子的同班同學們。但，不久他就得知了學校系統的真面目，並被打入絕望的深淵……！
來自吊車尾聚集的D班的少年少女們所發現的，是世界的矛盾，還是正當的實力社會？
anilist:145545.synopsis_en:
The second season of Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e.

Tokyo Metropolitan Advanced Nurturing High School seems like a paradise, but in reality, it is an extreme meritocracy. In the class of underachievers, Kiyotaka has begun working with Suzune, who seeks to ascend higher. After a survival test on an uninhabited island, they get to enjoy a luxury liner, but a new class-scrambling test will begin.

(Source: Anime News Network)
anilist:145545.source_doc_raw: 歡迎來到實力至上主義的教室 第二季(13)

anilist:136707.synopsis_zh:
現代日本藥學研究者藥谷完治醒來後，發現自己轉世為宮廷藥師名家德·梅迪西斯家的兒子法爾瑪·德·梅迪西斯。
法爾瑪對這個世界上充斥著錯誤的治療方法和藥物調配、無法稱之為醫療行為的巫術和魔法的醫療感到絕望。
前世培養的現代藥學，再加上在異世界得到的特異能力【物質創造&物質消除】，使用只有貴族才能使用的【神術】，對抗所有疾病。
然後，為了將真正有效的藥物廣泛地傳遞給人們，開設了“異世界藥局”……
異世界作弊×現代藥學！改變異世界醫療的助人幻想，今天開業！
anilist:136707.synopsis_en:
A young pharmacologist and researcher in Japan died from overworking, and was reincarnated in a Medieval Parallel Europe. He was reincarnated as a 10-year-old apprentice to a famous Royal Court pharmacist, had attained an inhuman skills of ability to see through disease, material creation, and material destruction.

In a society in which dubious medical practice are rampant, price gouging thru the monopoly of the pharmacist guild, and good medicine aren't available to the commoners. He was recognized by the Emperor at that time and opened a Pharmacy at the corner of the town. He will wipe out the fraud that has swept the world, and deliver to the commoners a truly effective medicine that was developed using present day pharmacology. Thus the boy pharmacist will cheat by using his previous knowledge to create innovative medicines while helping the people of the parallel world, a story about living his new life to the fullest this time.

anilist:145260.synopsis_zh: 故事講述拿自己的記憶與女神做交易，從異世界轉生而來的召喚士「凱爾文」，雖然失去了所有記憶，卻擁有史上最強的技能組合以及愛好「戰鬥」的熱血精神。身為最下級的冒險者，為了升級勇敢挑戰不可能的任務與最強對手。不僅跟轉生女神締約，還一一收服了貪食史萊姆、黑靈騎士等魔獸，並且率領這些部下展開了一段精彩刺激的神奇冒險旅程。
anilist:145260.synopsis_en:
Waking up in a strange new place with no memory of his past life, Kelvin learns that he’s bartered away those very memories in exchange for powerful new abilities during his recent transmigration. Heading out into a whole new world as a Summoner — with his first Follower being the very goddess who brought him over! — Kelvin begins his new life as an adventurer, and it isn’t long before he discovers his hidden disposition as a battle junkie. From the Black Knight of the Ancient Castle of Evil Spirits to the demon within the Hidden Cave of the Sage, he revels in the fight against one formidable foe after another. Join this OP adventurer in an exhilarating and epic saga as he and his allies carve their way into the annals of history!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

anilist:125038.synopsis_zh:
這是一座擁有秘密的宅邸——
聳立在懸崖上的巨大宅邸——「影宅」裡頭住著模仿貴族舉止，沒有臉的一族人「影家人」。以及他們的「臉」，負責服侍影家人的「活人偶」。
某天，一名「活人偶」來到「影家」一族的少女凱特身邊，就此展開「影子」與「人偶」之間不可思議的日常生活。
世界奇妙的哥德式懸疑故事，終於迎來動畫版！



[簡介原文]
この館には秘密がある──
斷崖に佇む大きな館「シャドーハウス」で貴族の真似事をする、顔のない一族「シャドー」。その“顔”としてシャドーに仕える世話係の「生き人形」。
ある日、“シャドー”一族の少女・ケイトのもとに一人の“生き人形”が訪れ、“影”と“人形”の不思議な日常が始まる。
世にも奇妙なゴシックミステリー、ついにアニメ化！
anilist:125038.synopsis_en: High atop a cliff sits the mansion known as Shadows House, home to a faceless clan that pretends to live like nobles. They express their emotions through living dolls that also endlessly clean the home of soot. One such servant, Emilico, aids her master Kate as they learn more about themselves and the mysteries of the house.(Source: Funimation)

titles.primary_zh: 古見同學有交流障礙症 第二季
titles.ja: 古見さんは、コミュ症です。2期

anilist:142984.synopsis_en:
The second season of Komi-san wa, Komyushou desu. 

Komi and pals are back! Who else will Komi make friends with? How will her relationship with Tadano evolve? 

(Source: Netflix)
anilist:142984.source_doc_raw: 古見同學有交流障礙症 第二季(24)(12)

titles.primary_zh: 式守同學不只可愛而已
titles.ja: 可愛いだけじゃない式守さん

anilist:127911.synopsis_zh:
超級“帥氣女友“登場！

和泉是一名擁有不幸體質的高中男生，他有一個和他同班的女朋友，叫做式守。
式守的笑容十分甜美、溫柔，跟和泉在一起的時候臉上總是洋溢著幸福。

她平時可愛動人，心中滿是愛情，
但只要看到和泉遇到危險，她就會……
搖身一變，變成“帥氣女友”！

滿是可愛×帥氣的式守跟和泉
將與他們的小夥伴一起帶來無限愉快的日常！
1000%美好的愛情喜劇，即將開幕！
anilist:127911.synopsis_en:
The ultimate "heartthrob girlfriend" appears! Naturally unlucky high school student Izumi's girlfriend is his classmate Shikimori. She has a beautiful smile and kind personality and always seems happy when she's with Izumi. She's a pretty, cute, and loving girlfriend, but when Izumi's in trouble… she transforms into a super cool "heartthrob girlfriend!" The fun lives of the cute and cool Shikimori, Izumi, and their good friends never end!

(Source: Crunchyroll)
anilist:127911.source_doc_raw: 式守同學不只可愛而已(12)

titles.primary_zh: 平凡職業造就世界最強 第二季
titles.ja: ありふれた職業で世界最強 2nd season
titles.ja_romaji: Arifureta Shokugyou de Sekai Saikyou 2nd season
titles.en: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest Season 2

anilist:112323.synopsis_zh:
在與昔日的同班同學們道別後，主角始所率領的隊伍為了取得新的神代魔法動身前往大迷宮。一行人突破了各式各樣的試煉，一步步取得了為返回原本的世界所需的力量。然而，此刻在臺面底下，魔人族們卻出現了不平穩的動向。
等待他們的是悄悄逼近王都的黑影以及在暗中行動的神秘人物。
「我要擊敗所有敵人――哪怕對方是神也一樣。」
阻擋在他們面前的真正的敵人到底是何方神聖呢――！？
「最強」的異世界奇幻故事，第二季現在即將拉開序幕！



[簡介原文]
かつてのクラスメイトたちと別れた後、主人公ハジメが率いるパーティーは新たな神代魔法を手に入れるため大迷宮へと向かっていた。様々な試練を突破し、元の世界に帰るために著々と力をつけていく一行。しかし、その裡では魔人族たちも不穏な動きをみせていた。
王都に忍び寄る影と暗躍する謎の人物。
「敵はすべて倒す――たとえそれが神だとしても」
彼らの前に立ちはだかる真の敵とは一體何者なのか――!?
“最強”異世界ファンタジー、セカンドシーズン開幕！
anilist:112323.synopsis_en:
The second season of Arifureta Shokugyou de Sekai Saikyou.

Transported to another world and left behind by his former friends, Hajime had to make his rise from literal rock bottom. It was in the labyrinth where he strengthened his weak magic and found several beautiful allies. Now after saving his classmates, he ventures for Erisen to escort Myuu and her mother. He'll fight and defeat anyone he has to in order to find a way home—including a god!

(Source: Funimation)
anilist:112323.source_doc_raw: 平凡職業造就世界最強 第二季(12)

titles.primary_zh: 我的英雄學院 第五季
titles.ja: 僕のヒーローアカデミア 第5期

anilist:117193.synopsis_zh:
超常能力“個性”を持つ人間が當たり前の世界。憧れのNo.1ヒーロー・オールマイトと出會った“無個性”の少年・緑谷出久、通稱「デク」は、その內に秘めるヒーローの資質を見出され、オールマイトから“個性”ワン・フォー・オールを受け継いだ。デクはヒーロー輩出の名門・雄英高校に入學し、“個性”で社會や人々を救ける“ヒーロー”になることを目指し、ヒーロー科1年A組のクラスメイトたちと切磋琢磨する毎日を過ごしていた。
「プロヒーロー仮免許」取得とプロヒーローインターン活動。そこでの少女・エリとの出會いと、そのエリを恐るべき計畫に利用する「死穢八斎會」の若頭オーバーホール、エリを救うための死闘。エリや雄英生徒の皆を笑顔にするための文化祭。新たなヒーローランキングの発表…。慌ただしい日々の中、デクは著実に成長を続けていく。その一方で、死柄木弔率いる敵＜ヴィラン＞連合もその力を蓄えていた。
“最高のヒーロー”を目指すデクの次なる試練、それは同じくヒーローを目指す1年B組との、互いのプライドを懸けた対抗戦！體育祭以來の直接対決に、生徒たちの意気は上がる。そんな中、デクの中で新たな“何か”が目覚めようとしていた―。
anilist:117193.synopsis_en:
The rivalry between Class 1-A and Class 1-B heats up in a joint training battle. Eager to be a part of the hero course, brainwashing buff Shinso is tasked with competing on both sides.

But as each team faces their own weaknesses and discovers new strengths, this showdown might just become a toss-up.
(Source: Funimation)
anilist:117193.source_doc_raw: 我的英雄學院 第五季(113)(25)

titles.ja: 迷宮ブラックカンパニー

anilist:120608.synopsis_zh:
“不想工作！”
在這樣的想法下不斷努力，靠著不勞而獲的收入成為了“上流家裡蹲”的二之宮錦司。正在他打算到死為止都要這樣懶惰地生活下去時，出於某種原因突然穿越到異世界。那裡是一個“迷宮就是職場”的超級黑心企業。
優雅的生活突然改變，每天都要在曾經被稱作“地下城”的地方不斷勞動，過著流血流汗又流淚的日子。惡劣的工作環境、長時間的勞動、低薪。更過分的是上司的職權騷擾、洗腦、榨取人力價值。天天過著被各種瞧不起的“社畜”生活。
哪怕這樣錦司也沒有放棄。為了要奪回最強的家裡蹲生活，有時就要不擇手段、有時還要用一些陰謀詭計來讓自己成功暴富……
這就是，唯我獨尊又善用邪門歪道的青年不屈不撓奮鬥的故事。“異世界迷宮”×“黑心企業”的社畜幻想故事，開幕。
anilist:120608.synopsis_en:
Work sucks and Kinji was avoiding it beautifully by investing every penny. Good plan ’til he found himself in a new world…with DEBT! Now under the rule of an evil mining company, avoiding work is gonna be a tough grind. Does he have what it takes to pull off the ultimate workaround on this gig?

(Source: Funimation)

zh_aliases: 朋友的妹妹只喜歡煩我
titles.ja: 友達の妹が俺にだけウザい
titles.ja_romaji: Tomodachi no Imouto ga Ore ni dake Uzai
titles.en: My Friend's Little Sister Has It In for Me!

anilist:129195.synopsis_zh:
不需要交往，不需要女友，高中生·大星明照將青春的一切都當作低效的東西捨棄了。
不知為何，好友的妹妹·小日向彩羽一直泡在他家裡。
被佔據的床！突然的點到即止美人計！與呼嘯的煩人暴風雨！
在學校作為清秀的優等生大受歡迎的彩羽，只喜歡纏著明照。
被這樣情緒高漲的女性彩羽煩惱的明照面前，出現了鹽對應女子·真白。
以此為契機，明照、彩羽以及夥伴們的日常生活發生了鉅變——！？
煩人又可愛的女孩子（明明沒有拜託過）不斷逼近！
悶絕至極的甜膩粘人青春戀愛喜劇，開幕！
anilist:129195.synopsis_en:
For high schooler Akiteru Ooboshi, the whole youthful experience thing—like fun, friendships, and even having a girlfriend—is a complete waste of time. So when his best friend’s sister, Iroha Kohinata, keeps teasing him, Akiteru naturally finds it annoying. She practically lives in his room, she’s always on his bed, she’s just a raging storm of clinginess! Why is she only annoying around him?!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

titles.primary_zh: 盾之勇者成名錄 第二季
titles.ja: 盾の勇者の成り上がり
titles.ja_romaji: Tate no Yuusha no Nariagari Season 2
titles.en: The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 2

anilist:111321.synopsis_zh: 極為平凡的御宅族大學生·巖谷尚文，受到在圖書館發現的一本書所引導，被召喚到了異世界。他被賦予的使命，是作為裝備著劍、槍、弓、盾的四聖勇者之一“盾之勇者”，驅逐給世界帶來混沌的災害“波”。因為大冒險而心潮澎湃，和同伴一同踏上旅程的尚文。但，他剛出發沒幾天就遭到背叛，金錢和立場全都失去。變得無法相信他人的尚文，驅使著奴隸少女·拉芙塔莉雅，向波和世界發起對抗——。究竟他能否打破這種絕望的狀況？失去一切的男人的成名奇幻故事，開幕。
anilist:111321.synopsis_en:
The second season of Tate no Yuusha no Nariagari.

With another Wave happening in a week, Naofumi Iwatani and his party have no time to waste. However, when bat familiars raid Lurolona Village and the Wave countdown comes to a halt, the Four Cardinal Heroes reconvene with the queen, Mirelia Q Melromarc, for a quick briefing. The queen presumes that the odd occurrences are linked to the Spirit Tortoise—a threatening creature that has awakened from its slumber, back to cause havoc once again. A plan to put the Spirit Tortoise to rest is devised—but out of the four men, only the cursed Shield Hero agrees to help.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)
anilist:111321.source_doc_raw: 盾之勇者成名錄 第二季(13)

titles.primary_zh: 輝夜姬想讓人告白 ー超級浪漫ー
zh_aliases: 輝夜大小姐想讓我告白 通往大人的階梯
titles.ja: かぐや様は告らせたい 大人への階段

anilist:125367.synopsis_zh:
"每一處都令人懷念，而所有的一切都是無可替代的重要回憶。" 這裡是聚集秀才的精英學校——秀知院學園。在該校學生會相遇的副會長四宮輝夜與學生會長白銀御行，在經歷了漫長的戀愛頭腦戰後，終於確定了彼此關係……。時光流逝——輝夜獨自在房間裡翻閱著一本相簿。相簿中的每一張照片，都記錄著她與白銀，以及在秀知院學園共度的夥伴們之間點點滴滴的回憶。隨著她沉浸在思念之中，一頁接一頁地翻過。而輝夜的回憶也再次鮮明地浮現在心頭……。



[簡介原文]
「どれも懐かしくて、全てがかけがえのない大切な思い出。」 

秀才たちが集うエリート校・秀知院學園 
その生徒會で出會った副會長・四宮かぐやと生徒會長・白銀御行。 
2人は長きにわたる戀愛頭脳戦の末、交際することに…… 

月日は流れ、部屋でひとりアルバムを眺めるかぐや。 
そこには、白銀や秀知院學園の仲間と過ごした思い出を収めた寫真が並んでいる。 

懐かしさに浸りページをめくる度、かぐやの思い出が蘇る。
anilist:125367.synopsis_en:
The elite members of Shuchiin Academy's student council continue their competitive day-to-day antics. Council president Miyuki Shirogane clashes daily against vice-president Kaguya Shinomiya, each fighting tooth and nail to trick the other into confessing their romantic love. Kaguya struggles within the strict confines of her wealthy, uptight family, rebelling against her cold default demeanor as she warms to Shirogane and the rest of her friends.

Meanwhile, council treasurer Yuu Ishigami suffers under the weight of his hopeless crush on Tsubame Koyasu, a popular upperclassman who helps to instill a new confidence in him. Miko Iino, the newest student council member, grows closer to the rule-breaking Ishigami while striving to overcome her own authoritarian moral code.

As love further blooms at Shuchiin Academy, the student council officers drag their outsider friends into increasingly comedic conflicts.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

Note: The first episode had an advanced screening on April 2, in both New York & Los Angeles.
anilist:125367.source_doc_raw: 輝夜姬想讓人告白 ー超級浪漫ー(13)

titles.primary_zh: 骸骨騎士大人異世界冒險中
titles.ja: 骸骨騎士様、只今異世界へお出掛け中
titles.ja_romaji: Gaikotsu Kishi-sama, Tadaima Isekai e Odekakechuu

anilist:132474.synopsis_zh:
“亞克”在醒來後，發現自己以在MMORPG使用的角色外觀被丟到異世界。而他的模樣，是外表全身鎧甲，內在全身骨骼的“骸骨騎士”。
——要是真面目曝光，肯定會被誤會成是怪物變成討伐物件！？
亞克決心當個低調的傭兵過生活，但他卻是個無法對眼前發生的壞事置之不理的男人。
由骸骨騎士大人無自覺“懲惡勸善”的異世界奇幻故事現在登場。
anilist:132474.synopsis_en:
One day, a gamer played video games until he fell asleep…and when he woke up, he found himself in the game world–as a skeleton! Equipped with the powerful weapons and armor of his avatar but stuck with its frightening skeletal appearance, Arc has to find a place for himself in this new, fantastical land. All his hopes for a quiet life are dashed when he crosses paths with a beautiful elven warrior, setting him on a journey full of conflict and adventure.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
anilist:132474.source_doc_raw: 骸骨騎士大人異世界冒險中(12)

anilist:140457.synopsis_zh:
勇者雷歐從魔王軍的侵略中拯救了世界。
然而對於迎來和平的人族來說，他的強大實力是個極大的威脅。
他最終被趕出了聖都。

失去了地位、榮譽和安身之所，四處漂泊的勇者最終來到了……千瘡百孔的魔王軍？！

不知是出於對人族的憤恨抑或是自暴自棄，他向魔王隱瞞了身份，同時開始和四天王一起嘗試重建軍隊。
退役勇者大展拳腳，等待他的會是什麼？
anilist:140457.synopsis_en:
After saving humanity from the despicable Demon King, Leo Demonhart does not earn a hero’s standing. Instead, he is regarded with suspicion and hostility by those he fought to protect. Treated as a pariah with nowhere else to turn, exiled Leo seeks a position in the army of his former nemesis! But the army is not what it once was before its defeat at Leo’s hands, so to maintain his new position, Leo must whip the forces back into fighting shape.

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)

titles.primary_zh: 女性向遊戲世界對路人角色很不友好
zh_aliases: 戀愛遊戲世界對路人角色很不友好
titles.ja: 乙女ゲー世界はモブに厳しい世界です
titles.ja_romaji: Otomege Sekai wa Mob ni Kibishii Sekai desu
titles.en: Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs

anilist:142074.synopsis_zh:
從現代日本轉生到“戀愛遊戲”世界的里昂，發現這裡女尊男卑，對男性很不友好。身為路人角色的他，為了擺脫自己因地位低下而被肆意決定的人生，決定活用從遊戲中得到的知識，保持路人角色的身份，取得“失落物品”來改變自己的命運...然而，里昂的爵位越升越高，與遊戲中角色的關係也越發拉近，他也離自己原定計劃的“悠哉路人生活”越來越遠....



[簡介原文]
『モブからだって、成り上がってやる――。』
とある剣と魔法の“乙女ゲー”世界に転生した社會人・ リオン。そこは超女尊男卑な世界で、例外はゲーム內で攻略対象だった王太子率いるイケメン軍団のみ。
しかし、虐げられ絶望するリオンにはある一つの武器があった。それは前世で妹に無理矢理攻略させられていたこのゲームの「知識」。
モブとして田舎でのんびり過ごすことを目標にしていたリオンだったが、ゲームの知識を使い、やりたい放題の女たちとイケメン軍団に図らずも反旗を翻してしまうのだった――。
anilist:142074.synopsis_en:
Office worker Leon is reincarnated into a particularly punishing dating sim video game, where women reign supreme and only beautiful men have a seat at the table. But Leon has a secret weapon: he remembers everything from his past life, which includes a complete playthrough of the very game in which he is now trapped. Watch Leon spark a revolution to change this new world in order to fulfill his ultimate desire…of living a quiet, easy life in the countryside!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
anilist:142074.source_doc_raw: 女性向遊戲世界對路人角色很不友好(12)

anilist:141774.synopsis_zh: 五丈原之戰中病死的諸葛孔明，以年輕之姿轉生到正在舉辦萬聖節遊行的現代日本東京都涉谷，並與創作歌手月見英子相遇。於是，為了幫助英子實現她的夢想，孔明發揮他的軍事才能，以軍師身份在音樂界活躍。
anilist:141774.synopsis_en:
Fate and reincarnation deliver brilliant military strategist, Kongming, from warring, ancient China to Japan’s modern party hot spot in Shibuya City, Tokyo. After a lifetime of battles and military skirmishes, Kongming wished with his last breath to be reborn in a world of peace and prosperity. It’s nearly two millennia later and he’s finding his way in a very different world than that of his past life. When he meets Eiko, an amateur musician with big dreams, the unlikely duo strikes up an even unlikelier friendship. Eiko has street smarts to help Kongming navigate this strange new world, and Kongming will use his strategic mind to help Eiko achieve stardom!

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)

An advanced online screening of the first episode was held on March 31, 2022, but the weekly TV release began on April 5, 2022.

titles.primary_zh: 古見同學有交流障礙症
titles.ja: 古見さんは、コミュ症です。

anilist:133965.synopsis_zh:
所謂的“交流障礙症”——
是不擅於與人交流的症狀，亦或有該症狀的人。
應該注意的是——這種情況只是自我覺得不擅長，不想和別人有接觸。
櫻花爛漫的高中1年級，有著極度的交流障礙症的古見遇到了“過於普通”的同班同學・只野。
面對人群會感到緊張的古見的夢想是“能夠交到100個朋友”。
在個性派所云集的高中，古見能實現她的夢想嗎？
想要傳達，但是卻傳達不到…心神不寧，忐忑不安，不由自主地冷笑。
但是有時卻如刺入胸膛？
沉默的美少女·古見的交流障礙症喜劇。
anilist:133965.synopsis_en:
Timid Tadano is a total wallflower, and that’s just the way he likes it. But all that changes when he finds himself alone in a classroom on the first day of high school with the legendary Komi. He quickly realizes she isn’t aloof—she’s just super awkward. Now he’s made it his mission to help her on her quest to make 100 friends!

(Source: VIZ Media)
anilist:133965.source_doc_raw: 古見同學有交流障礙症(12)

titles.ja: 先輩がうざい後輩の話
titles.ja_romaji: Senpai ga Uzai Kouhai no Hanashi

anilist:120646.synopsis_zh: 五十嵐雙葉，是入職絲卷商社剛到第二年，想要儘快獨當一面的新人。武田晴海，則是個性有些粗獷，但很會照顧人的前輩。雙葉雖然覺得武田前輩比較煩人，但有時也會覺得溫馨，後來還是覺得很煩人……就這樣搖擺不定。
anilist:120646.synopsis_en:
Being seen as a full-fledged business woman isn’t easy for Futaba Igarashi when her senpai, Harumi, treats her like a kid. Days for her are never typical, at work or outside of it, with all the antics going on in her life. As mishaps ensue, she’ll find herself growing closer with her loudmouth senpai. Maybe Futaba feels more than she lets on, but one thing’s for sure: she’s still annoyed!

(Source: Funimation)

anilist:113717.synopsis_zh:
國家的豐饒程度，擁有的強者數量，以及國王本人是否像勇者一樣強大，將這些綜合起來進行的排名就是“國王排名”。
主人公波吉，是國王排名第7名的伯斯王所統治的王國的第一王子。然而，波吉生來就失聰，身體孱弱得舉不起劍，不光家臣，就連民眾都蔑視他“不是當國王的料”。這樣的波吉交到了第一個朋友，卡克。
隨著與卡克的相遇，以及一點點小小的勇氣，波吉的人生邁出一大步——
anilist:113717.synopsis_en:
Unable to hear, speak, or wield a sword, Prince Bojji doesn’t seem like a typical heir to the throne—and his kingdom agrees. But his fateful encounter with Kage, a shadow on the ground, gives him his first true friend. The two set off on a grand adventure and, together, form a bond that can overcome any obstacle...even being king.

(Source: Funimation)

anilist:116589.synopsis_zh:
為了應對吉亞迪所開發出的完全獨立無人戰鬥兵器“軍團”的入侵，其鄰國聖格諾利亞共和國開發了無人戰鬥兵器毀滅之力。但是，無人戰鬥機只是空有名號，實際是沒有被認可為”人“的人們——86——駕駛，被當作道具來使用。
由”86“所組成的部隊“先鋒戰隊”的隊長少年・辛恩，在只能等待著死亡的令人絕望的戰場上為了某個目的而戰鬥著。在那裡，共和國軍隊的精英・蕾娜就任了新任指揮管制官。她小時候有著被86所救助過的經歷，因此想把被作為“人形豬”而遭到輕視的他們作為正常人類來對待。
只不過是為了戰鬥而被作為道具使用的少年以及被寄予了未來期望的精英才女，本不應當有所交集的兩人，在激烈的戰鬥中看到了未來——
anilist:116589.synopsis_en:
Called “Juggernaut,” these are the unmanned combat drones developed by the Republic of San Magnolia in answer to the attacks by the autonomous unmanned drones of the neighboring Empire of Giad, the “Legion”. But they’re only unmanned in name. In reality, they are piloted by the Eighty-sixers—those considered to be less than human and treated as mere tools.

Determined to achieve his own mysterious ends, Shin, the captain of Spearhead Squadron, which is comprised of Eighty-sixers, continues to fight a hopeless war on a battlefield where only death awaits him.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

titles.primary_zh: 現實主義勇者的王國重建記
zh_aliases: 現實主義勇者的王國再建記
titles.ja: 現実主義勇者の王国再建記
titles.ja_romaji: Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki
titles.en: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom

anilist:117612.synopsis_zh:
たったひとりの身內である祖父を亡くした相馬一也は、ある日、突然、異世界に勇者として召喚されてしまう。
召喚された先は、まるで中世ヨーロッパのようなエルフリーデン王國であった。
勇者どころか、ごくふつうの青年のソーマだが、持ち前の合理的精神と現代知識から、
次々と新しい政策を打ち出し、傾きかけていた王國の財政政治體制を立て直していく。
ソーマと共に歩むのは、エルフリーデン王國の王女リーシア、王國一の武を誇るダークエルフのアイーシャ、
憐悧な頭脳を持つハクヤ、大食いのポンチョ、歌姫のジュナ、動物と意思疎通できる少女トモエなど、多才で個性的な仲間たち。
現代知識で窮地の王國を再生する異世界內政 ファンタジー、『現実主義勇者の王國再建記』。いよいよ開幕！
anilist:117612.synopsis_en:
Suddenly summoned to a fantasy world and betrothed to the princess, Kazuya Souma is crowned the new king after providing the royal family with impressive advice. To rule the kingdom, he's taking the nontraditional (and very human) route of administrative reform. In a realm of dragons and elves, will this revolutionary's unique path prove effective?

(Source: Funimation)
anilist:117612.source_doc_raw: 現實主義勇者的王國重建記(26)

zh_aliases: 更衣人偶墜入愛河 第二季
titles.ja: その着せ替え人形は恋をする Season 2

anilist:4262.synopsis_zh:
以某次的相遇為契機，喜多川海夢和五條新菜透過Cosplay加深了交流。
他們還有許多想Cosplay的角色和想製作的服裝。

透過和同學們的交流，以及新的Cosplay同伴的相遇，近一步拓展了海夢和新菜的世界。
除此之外，新菜與令人不斷臉紅心跳的海夢間的戀情會有進展嗎―！？


ある日の出會いをきっかけに、コスプレを通して交流を深めていく喜多川海夢まりんと五條新菜わかな。
まだまだやりたいコスプレ、作りたい衣裝はいっぱい。

クラスメイトたちとの交流や、新しいコスプレ仲間たちとの出會いの中で、
海夢と新菜の世界はさらに広がっていく。
そして、新菜にドキドキのとまらない海夢の戀に進展はあるのか―！？
anilist:4262.synopsis_en:
This anime is based on an eroge game by Baseson, which was loosely based on the classic Chinese novel Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
Having lost her family to bandits during night raid, Kanu swears she will not let others share the same pain. She quickly becomes a well-known and feared by villains bandit hunter. During her journey she comes across others who wish to join her cause. One of them is a girl RinRin, who had similar experience with bandits in the past.

titles.en: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest

anilist:129191.synopsis_zh:
被譽為世界最強魔法師的「賢者」蓋亞斯，感受到自己與生俱來的紋章的效能已經到達了極限。
他為了變更紋章而採取的方法，則是透過轉生來獲得新的軀體！
他轉生到了遙遠的未來世界，得到了渴求已久的「最適合魔法戰鬥的紋章」，以及馬蒂亞斯這個名字。
然而在這個時代，這個紋章卻不知為何被稱為「失格紋」……！
時過境遷，當今世界魔法衰退，充斥著低水準的魔法理論。
兼具魔法戰鬥最強的「失格紋」與賢者智慧的少年馬蒂亞斯，將不斷打破這個世界的常識！
anilist:129191.synopsis_en:
His strength limited by the magical crest with which he was born, Matthias, the world’s most powerful sage, decides reincarnation is necessary to become the strongest of all. Upon his rebirth as a young boy, Matthias is thrilled to discover he’s been born with the optimal crest for magical combat on his first try! Unfortunately, the world he’s been born into has abysmally poor standards when it comes to magic, and everyone thinks he’s still marked for failure! Now it’s up to Matthias to prove everyone wrong…world’s strongest sage-style!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

titles.primary_zh: 天才王子的赤字國家重生術
zh_aliases: 天才王子的赤字國家振興術
titles.ja: 天才王子の赤字国家再生術
titles.ja_romaji: Tensai Ouji no Akaji Kokka Saisei Jutsu
titles.en: The Genius Prince's Guide to Raising a Nation Out of Debt

anilist:129190.synopsis_zh:
暴露在霸權國家威脅下的小國：納特拉王國。
年紀輕輕就揹負國家重擔的王子維恩在輔佐官妮妮姆的支援下，發揮自身的天賦，開始施展精明的手段。
可是，這個國家……已經徹底沒救了！
想要革新內政卻沒錢。想要向外奪取卻沒有軍力。靠譜的優秀人才全都流失到了國外。
真想趕緊把國家賣了跑路啊。
維恩的心願是賣掉國家，儘早退隱，過上悠閒自在的生活。若是能討好大國，應該就能把國家賣出去。然而外交與軍事卻向出乎意料的方向發展……
依靠智慧與臨機應變影響世界
天才王子運營弱小國家，就此開幕！
anilist:129190.synopsis_en:
Once upon a time in a far away land there lived a prince, a genius prince. The genius prince fought alongside his people and led them to a great many triumphs. However, truth be told, he just wants to let everything go and live in tranquility.

(Source: Funimation)
anilist:129190.source_doc_raw: 天才王子的赤字國家重生術(12)

titles.en: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Arc

anilist:142329.synopsis_zh: 結束了無限列車的任務，炭治郎前往下一個任務地點。與鬼殺隊最強之一的音柱·宇髄天元一同前往鬼所棲身的遊郭之中。新的戰鬥即將開幕。
anilist:142329.synopsis_en:
After visiting the Rengoku residence, Tanjirou and his comrades volunteer for a mission within the Entertainment District, a place where desires are sold and demons dwell. They journey alongside the flashy Sound Hashira, Tengen Uzui, in search of a monstrous foe terrorizing the town. Sworn to slay creatures of the night, the hunt continues.

(Source: Funimation)

Note:
- The first episode aired with a runtime of ~47 minutes.
- The last episode aired with a runtime of ~33 minutes.

anilist:131083.synopsis_zh:
看見應該看不見的東西時，看見不應該看見的東西時，換作是你會怎麼做呢……？
要是“那些東西”和你講話，亦或是朝著你走過來的話，你又會怎麼做呢……？
會拔腿就跑嗎？還是會學習可疑的法術？又或者是會拜託靈媒師，選擇戰鬥呢？女高中生‧四谷見子所採取的行動是——徹底的無視。
什麼也沒看見，什麼也沒察覺到。這是擁有著鋼鐵般的精神的女高中生靠著她的無視技能，迴避那些異形般的可怕傢伙們的故事。
anilist:131083.synopsis_en:
She can see dead people…she just chooses to ignore them. That’s Miko’s plan, anyway, but it doesn’t seem to be working for her in this love letter to the horror genre that will send shivers down your spine—and occasionally tickle your funny bone.

(Source: Funimation)

titles.primary_zh: 因為不是真正的夥伴而被逐出勇者隊伍，流落到邊境展開慢活人生
zh_aliases: 因為不是命中註定的同伴而被趕出了勇者的隊伍、從此以後過上了悠閒的隱居生活
titles.ja: 真の仲間じゃないと勇者のパーティーを追い出されたので、辺境でスローライフすることにしました
titles.ja_romaji: Shin no Nakama ja Nai to Yuusha no Party wo Oidasareta node, Henkyou de Slow Life suru Koto ni shimashita
titles.en: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside

anilist:126213.synopsis_zh:
「你不是真正的夥伴——」
已經不能在前線戰鬥的英雄·雷德，被隊伍裡的賢者判斷不再是戰力後逐出了勇者隊伍。
「唉——那段日子可真難熬啊」因為雷德離開了隊伍，賢者一行人陷入了大混亂中，而當事人卻一無所知的在邊境開了一家藥店，興致滿滿地度過每一天。
「我也可以在這家店工作嗎？需要包住！」曾經是夥伴的公主突然到來？！

“悠閒愉快地經營藥店”、“和冒失鬼公主的超甜生活”、沒有得到回報的英雄上演的美妙第二人生即將開幕！
anilist:126213.synopsis_en:
A heroic and mighty adventurer dreams of...opening a pharmacy?

Red was once a part of the Hero’s party, a group destined to save the world by fighting the Raging Demon Lord. But after being betrayed by his comrade, Red hopes to start anew by opening a small apothecary in a sleepy town on the frontier. While keeping his past life a secret is the goal, it won’t be easy...especially when a beautiful adventurer from his past asks to move in.

(Source: Funimation)
anilist:126213.source_doc_raw: 因為不是真正的夥伴而被逐出勇者隊伍，流落到邊境展開慢活人生(13)

titles.primary_zh: 無職轉生，到了異世界就拿出真本事
zh_aliases: 無職轉生～到了異世界就拿出真本事～ 第2部分
titles.ja: 無職転生 ～異世界行ったら本気だす～ 第2クール
titles.ja_romaji: Mushoku Tensei: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu

anilist:108465.synopsis_zh:
「俺は、この異世界で本気だす！」
34歳・童貞・無職の引きこもりニート男。
両親の葬儀の日に家を追い出された瞬間、トラックに轢かれ命を落としてしまう。
目覚めると、なんと剣と魔法の異世界で赤ん坊に生まれ変わっていた！
ゴミクズのように生きてきた男は、少年・ルーデウスとして異世界で本気をだして生きていく事を誓う。
フィットア領転移事件で魔大陸に転移後、冒険者パーティ「デッドエンド」を結成し、
魔大陸最南端の港町・ウェンポートに到著したルーデウスたち。
ルーデウスは「魔界大帝キシリカ」と出會い新たな力を手に入れる。
魔力災害に巻き込まれた家族や仲間の行方はー。
「人生やり直し」ファンタジー、再始動！
anilist:108465.synopsis_en:
When a 34-year-old underachiever gets run over by a bus, his story doesn’t end there. Reincarnated in a new world as an infant, Rudeus will seize every opportunity to live the life he’s always wanted. Armed with new friends, some freshly acquired magical abilities, and the courage to do the things he’s always dreamed of, he’s embarking on an epic adventure—with all of his past experience intact!

(Source: Funimation, edited)

Note: The anime pre-screened its 1st and 2nd episode starting on the 27th of December on the Nico Nico Live Broadcasting and D Anime Store services
anilist:108465.source_doc_raw: 無職轉生，到了異世界就拿出真本事(24)

anilist:132473.synopsis_zh:
過去被毀滅的死者之街——
在這樣一處冷僻的土地有一名活人小孩，名叫威爾。
養育這位少年的，是三名不死族。豪邁的骷髏劍客布拉德、端莊的神官木乃伊瑪莉以及乖僻的魔法師幽靈古斯。在三人的教育與疼愛中，少年日漸茁壯。一天，少年不禁產生疑惑：“……現在的“我”究竟是誰？”
不死族們隱藏於世界盡頭之街的秘密終被威爾解開。善良之神們的愛與慈悲，邪惡之神們的偏執與瘋狂。
明白一切之後，少年決心踏上了聖騎士之路。
anilist:132473.synopsis_en:
In the ruined city of the dead far from human civilization lives a single human child named Will. He is raised by three undead: Blood the heroic skeleton warrior, Mary the ladylike mummy priestess, and Gus the crotchety ghost wizard. The three of them teach the boy what they know and pour their love into him.

One day, the boy begins to wonder, "Who am I?" Will uncovers the mysteries of the undead hidden in this faraway land. He learns of the love and mercy of good gods, as well as the paranoia and madness of evil gods. And once he learns it all, the boy embarks on the path to becoming a Paladin.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

titles.primary_zh: 世界頂尖的暗殺者轉生為異世界貴族
titles.ja: 世界最高の暗殺者、異世界貴族に転生する
titles.ja_romaji: Sekai Saikou no Ansatsusha, Isekai Kizoku ni Tensei suru
titles.en: The World's Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in Another World as an Aristocrat

anilist:129898.synopsis_zh:
世界第一的暗殺者投胎成暗殺世家的長男重生了。作為能夠轉生到異世界的條件，他接下了女神給下達的唯一一項任務。
那就是“殺了被預言會帶給人類災厄的‘勇者’”。
這是曾經世界上最強暗殺者在新的人生中必須要完成的使命。在現代曾讓萬般暗殺方式變得可行的廣泛知識及經驗，還有暗殺者家族被譽為異世界最強的秘術與魔法。一切都相輔相成，使他逐步成為史上無人能及的暗殺者——
“有意思，真沒想到轉生後還要繼續從事暗殺工作啊”
得以轉生的“傳說中的暗殺者”向更高境界進發！突破極限的冒險幻想譚，現在開幕！！
anilist:129898.synopsis_en:
The world's number one assassin has been reincarnated as the eldest son of a family of aristocrat assassins. In exchange for being reincarnated in another world, a goddess has imposed upon him one condition. "Kill the Hero who is prophesied to destroy the world." 

This was to be the mission in his new life. The synergistic effect of the vast knowledge and experience he gained that made all manner of assassinations possible in the modern world, and the secret techniques and magic of the fantasy world's most powerful family of assassins turn him into the greatest assassin of all time.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
anilist:129898.source_doc_raw: 世界頂尖的暗殺者轉生為異世界貴族(12)

anilist:107663.synopsis_zh: 在往來宇宙已是司空見慣的近未來，9名少年少女踏上前去行星露營的旅程。他們懷著對宇宙旅行感到激動不已的心情出發，但等待他們的是出乎意料的事態……
anilist:107663.synopsis_en:
Itʼs the first day of Planet Camp, and Aries Spring couldnʼt be more excited! She, along with eight other strangers, leave for Planet McPa for a weeklong excursion. Soon after they arrive, however, a mysterious orb appears and transports them into the depths of space, where they find an empty floating spaceship…

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: The first and last episode aired with a runtime of ~48 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.

anilist:125369.synopsis_zh:
人生どん底のダメフリーター花垣武道（タケミチ）。
中學時代に付き合っていた人生唯一の戀人・橘日向（ヒナタ）が、最兇最悪の悪黨連合”東京卍會”に殺されたことを知る。
事件を知った翌日、駅のホームにいたタケミチは何者かに背中を押され線路に転落し死を覚悟したが、目を開けると何故か12年前にタイムリープしていた。
人生のピークだった12年前の中學時代にタイムリープし、戀人を救うため、逃げ続けた自分を変えるため、人生のリベンジを開始する！
anilist:125369.synopsis_en:
Subaru Sumeragi is a 16 year old, cheerful and extremely caring Onmyou medium (the head of his family, the Sumeragi clan) who confronts and helps take care of ghosts and spirits with the help of his twin sister, Hokuto, and his gentleman friend, Seishiro. Subaru does his best to help anyone he meets, but the entire atmosphere of the polluted city of Tokyo in the 90s, brings about a feeling of desperation that threatens to drag Subaru's spirit down.

(Source: Anime News Network)Note: The Tokyo BABYLON 2021 project was cancelled after several cases of plagiarism were discovered which led to a lack of trust in the production company. The project's production will restart from scratch.

titles.ja: キングダム 第3シリーズ

anilist:113108.synopsis_zh: 紀元前，在中國西方的秦國，年輕的千人將·信曾與已故的好友有著「天下的大將軍」這一共同的夢想，而至今仍以此為目標。 此時，秦國成功攻陷了軍事上最重要的據點山陽，並由此向中華統一又邁進了一步。但，對於可能改寫七國勢力圖的這一手感到危機感的趙國天才軍師·李牧，以楚國宰相·春申君為總大將，楚、趙、魏、燕、韓、齊六國興起合縱軍，開始進攻秦國！ 面對前所未有的危機，秦國集結所擁有的全部武力，迎擊合縱軍！！
anilist:113108.synopsis_en:
The third season of Kingdom.

Following the successful Sanyou campaign, the Qin army, including 1,000-Man Commander Xin, inches ever closer to fulfilling King Ying Zheng's dream of unifying China. With a major geographical foothold in the state of Wei now under its control, Qin sets its sights eastward toward the remaining warring states.

Meanwhile Li Mu—an unparalleled strategist and the newly appointed prime minister of the state of Zhao—has taken advantage of Zhao's temporary truce with Qin to negotiate with the other states without interruption. Seemingly without warning, Ying Zheng receives news that armies from the states of Chu, Zhao, Wei, Han, Yan, and Qi have crossed into Qin territory. Realizing too late the purpose behind Li Mu's truce with Qin, Zheng quickly gathers his advisors to devise a plan to address the six-state coalition army on their doorstep. For the first time in history, the state of Qin faces complete destruction and must use every resource and strategy at their disposal to prevent themselves from being wiped off the map.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

anilist:125206.synopsis_zh:
曾經是平凡高中生的深澄真，因為某種緣由被召喚到異世界成為了“勇者”。然而世界的女神卻因為“長得太醜了”而立刻剝奪了他的“勇者”稱號，發配到了世界盡頭的荒野上。在荒野上彷徨的真遇到了龍與蜘蛛、半獸人和矮人族等等非人種族。與原本的世界環境過於不同、不管是在魔法還是戰鬥中都發揮出超出常識的力量的真，能否透過各種各樣的邂逅，在這個世界生活下去……
被神和人族拋棄的男人的異世界改造奇幻劇開幕！
anilist:125206.synopsis_en:
Makoto Misumi was just an average teenager who happened to suddenly be summoned to another world as a "hero." But the goddess of this world called him ugly and took his hero status away from him then sent him to the ends of the world. In the wastelands, he meets dragons, spiders, orcs, dwarves and many other non-human races. Makoto manages to show promises in the use of magic and fighting, which he wouldn't have been able to do in his former world. He has numerous encounters, but will he be able to survive this new world? A fantasy where a guy who had been abandoned by gods and humanity tries to reset his life in this new world is about to begin!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

titles.primary_zh: 我立於百萬生命之上 第二季
titles.ja: 100万の命の上に俺は立っている 第2シーズン
titles.ja_romaji: 100-man no Inochi no Ue ni Ore wa Tatteiru 2nd Season
titles.en: I'm Standing on a Million Lives Season 2

anilist:127366.synopsis_en: The second season of 100-man no Inochi no Ue ni Ore wa Tatteiru.
anilist:127366.source_doc_raw: 我立於百萬生命之上 第二季(24)

anilist:126047.synopsis_zh: 故事始於一個與平常並無區別的早晨。最喜歡遊戲和金平糖的高中生白柳啟，因為一名自稱魅音的神秘少女而突然被捲入戰場之中。對著被聚集此處的人們，魅音如此說道，“各位的戶籍已經不存在了”，“你們將成為實驗的觀測器”還有“你們已經被賦予了能力”。啟決定要利用獲得的能力不斷贏得遊戲，最終擊潰這個組織。用誰都不可能猜到的能力，以及極其稀少的“腦”能力作為武器，新時代的頭腦派能力戰鬥開始。
anilist:126047.synopsis_en:
A new kind of battle of abilities for a new generation is about to begin! It all started on a regular morning like any other. Akira Shiroyanagi is a high school kid who loves nothing more than konpeito candy and games. One day, he ends up in a fight due to a mysterious girl named Mion. Mion then tells the people she had gathered that they no longer officially exist in any records. They were given powers and were about to be test subjects. Akira makes up his mind to use his powers to climb up the ranks and then crush this organization.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

titles.ja: 探偵はもう、死んでいる。

anilist:128712.synopsis_zh:
“你來做我的助手吧。”
有著被捲入事件體質的少年・君冢君彥，在高空一萬米的飛機中成為了自稱是偵探的天使般的美麗少女・希耶絲塔的助手。兩個人為了同世界各地的敵人戰鬥，三年來在世界各地飛來飛去，展開了令人目眩的冒險旅程。——不久之後，偵探就去世了。
動盪的日子已經過去了一年。已成為高中三年級學生的君冢也沉溺在了名為日常的溫水中，過著極其普通的學生生活。在這樣的君冢身邊出現了一個委託人。
“你是名偵探？”
以和同年級的少女夏凪渚相遇為契機，連線過去和現在的壯大故事再次開始了——
anilist:128712.synopsis_en:
Thwarting a hijacking with the beautiful, silver-haired detective, Siesta, transforms Kimihiko’s young life. Their success kicks off years of crime-solving and confronting syndicates around the world—until Siesta dies. Left with questions, Kimihiko moves on. But now, a new case may open healed wounds as it connects to an assassin, a world conspiracy, and his dead partner!

(Source: Funimation)

Note: The first episode aired with a runtime of ~46 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.

anilist:126546.synopsis_zh:
前世與現世交錯——擁有兩份記憶的少年面對命運！
小時候，母親被殺而成為孤兒的利歐在貧民窟裡艱難地生存。
有一天，利歐因夢見與青梅竹馬的重逢而想起了意外身亡的“天川春人的記憶”，隨之覺醒的“強大的魔力”，才讓他意識到自己是轉生到了劍與魔法的異世界。
而後，利歐偶然遇上公主被綁架事件，因他在解救公主一事上做出了貢獻，得以破例進入各地貴族子女雲集的名校就讀。
從階級社會的最底層成功越級的利歐，不斷經歷著各種相遇與別離，直面自己殘酷的命運。
anilist:126546.synopsis_en:
His past life and current life are intersecting--a boy with memories of two lives faces his destiny! After his mother was killed at an early age, the orphaned Rio fought his hardest to survive in the slums. One day, he awakens to the memories of Haruto Amakawa, who died in an accident while dreaming of being reunited with his childhood friend, and Rio realizing he has reincarnated in a world of swords and sorcery. Not only that, but after helping stop an attempt to kidnap a princess that he stumbled upon, he finds himself enrolled in a famous school where the children of the nobility gather… As Rio attempts to rise up from the bottom of a hierarchical society, he will have new encounters and say many goodbyes, as he fights to overcome fate.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

titles.ja: ひぐらしのなく頃に 卒
titles.ja_romaji: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Sotsu

anilist:131149.synopsis_zh:
都心から遠く離れ、色濃く殘る自然に囲まれた集落──雛見沢村。

かつて、ダムの底に沈むはずだった村は、
今もなお昔と変わらない姿で、
転校生・前原圭一を迎え入れる。

都會で暮らしていた圭一にとって、
雛見沢の仲間と過ごす賑やかでのどかな生活は、
いつまでも続く幸せな時間のはずだった。

一年に一度行われる村の祭り、綿流し。
その日が來るまでは…。

昭和五十八年、六月。
ひぐらしのなく頃に。

日常は突如終わりを告げ、
止まらない慘劇の連鎖が始まる──。
anilist:131149.synopsis_en: Sequel to Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Gou.

titles.primary_zh: 關於我轉生變成史萊姆這檔事 第二季
titles.ja: 転生したらスライムだった件 第2期
titles.ja_romaji: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken 2nd Season
titles.en: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 2

anilist:108511.synopsis_zh: 三上悟過著不起眼的人生，在隨機殺人魔肆虐下結束了三十七年生涯…… 看似如此。當他甦醒時，不僅眼睛看不見，就連耳朵也聽不到…… 面對一連串突發狀況，他意識到自己投胎轉世成「史萊姆」！儘管變成最弱魔物讓他頗有怨言，三上悟還是決定要快樂地過史萊姆生活，沒想到卻碰上天災級魔物「暴風龍維爾德拉」，命運就此出現巨大轉折──維爾德拉將他命名為「利姆路」，正要展開史萊姆式的異世界新生活時，卻被捲入哥布靈對牙狼族的紛爭之中，最後還莫名其妙當上魔物大王…… 能奪取對手能力的「捕食者」以及精通世界真理的「大賢者」，有這兩項特殊技能當武器，最強的史萊姆傳說正式展開！
anilist:108511.synopsis_en:
The second season of Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken.

Now that the Jura Tempest Alliance is growing even further, they will now be meeting the animal kingdom of Eurazania, reuniting with King Gazel, rising tensions between monsters and humans, and Rimuru encountering the strongest enemy he’s ever faced.

(Source: Funimation)
anilist:108511.source_doc_raw: 關於我轉生變成史萊姆這檔事 第二季(24)(48)

anilist:98707.synopsis_zh:
這是成長的故事——
寶石中最年少的磷葉石，僅有3.5的脆弱硬度，韌性也很弱，因而不適於戰鬥。此外，也沒有對其他工作的適應性。被看做是隻會出一張嘴，完完全全的吊車尾。這樣的磷葉石，在即將滿三百歲時終於被交付了第一件工作。那是，名為編纂博物志的工作。磷葉石對這不起眼的工作感到不滿，但他在透過自己的雙眼看見世界，經歷各種各樣事情的同時，接連被巨大的波瀾吞沒。之後，他終於獲得了夢寐以求的“強大”，卻並非是以自己所期望的形式——

這是友情的故事——
擁有比磷葉石更為特殊的體質的辰砂。僅僅是在那裡，身體就會散播毒液的辰砂，為了不給周圍人添麻煩，而在夜晚獨自將自己關在室內，並封鎖了心靈。某天，就在即將被月人擄走時被辰砂所救的磷葉石，和他做了“接下來就該我來救你了”的約定。磷葉石一邊為編纂博物志而奔走，一邊為了將辰砂帶往光明的世界而尋找著適合他的工作。究竟磷葉石的想法能否傳達給辰砂呢？兩人的約定究竟會不會有實現的一天呢——？

這是戰鬥的故事——
從月球飛來的神秘敵人“月人”。他們將寶石作為裝飾品，特別中意美麗的寶石，將寶石們一個接一個地擄走，真實身份不明。而且被擄走的寶石被加工成為武器，反過來加害於寶石。得到月人的不斷改良，變得更加強力。面對接連現身的月人，二十八位寶石能否贏得勝利？他們的真正目的是什麼？這場無止境的戰鬥，能否畫下終止符？
anilist:98707.synopsis_en:
In the mysterious future, crystalline organisms called Gems inhabit a world that has been destroyed by six meteors. Each Gem is assigned a role in order to fight against the Lunarians, a species who attacks them in order to shatter their bodies and use them as decorations.

Phosphophyllite, also known as Phos, is a young and fragile Gem who dreams of helping their friends in the war effort. Instead, they are told to compile an encyclopedia because of their delicate condition. After begrudgingly embarking on this task, Phos meets Cinnabar, an intelligent gem who has been relegated to patrolling the isolated island at night because of the corrosive poison their body creates. After seeing how unhappy Cinnabar is, Phos decides to find a role that both of the rejected Gems can enjoy. Houseki no Kuni follows Phos' efforts to be useful and protect their fellow Gems.

anilist:114535.synopsis_zh:
不死起初是一個被投放到人世間的“球”。
它具有“幻化為刺激源形態的能力”和“死後重生的能力”。雖然不死不斷變換著自己的姿態，先後從球體變成小石塊、狼以及少年，但卻像一無所知的新生兒一樣迷茫、徘徊。
逐漸地，不死從相知相遇的人們那裡學到了生存技能，體味到人間溫情，於是踏上了人類那樣的成長之路。
等待不死的是與宿敵·敲門人的壯烈戰鬥，與深愛之人的離別……不死忍受著痛苦摸索前進方向，在永恆的旅途中一步一步堅定地走下去。
anilist:114535.synopsis_en:
In the beginning, an "orb" is cast unto Earth. "It" can do two things: change into the form of the thing that stimulates "it"; and come back to life after death. "It" morphs from orb to rock, then to wolf, and finally to boy, but roams about like a newborn who knows nothing. As a boy, "it" becomes Fushi.

Through encounters with human kindness, Fushi not only gains survival skills but grows as a "person". But his journey is darkened by the inexplicable and destructive enemy Nokker and cruel partings with the people he loves.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

anilist:128546.synopsis_zh:
WIT STUDIO×長月達平×梅原英司

Nialand，將夢想、希望和科學融為一體的，人工智慧綜合主題樂園。
作為歷史上第一個自律學習型 AI，Vivy，該設施的 AI 歌姬，每天站在舞臺上唱歌。但是，它目前的能力還不足以得到人氣。
——其使命是「用歌聲給大家帶來幸福」
為了這個使命，vivy一直在園區的主舞臺歌唱，探究什麼是用心的唱歌。

某日，名為松本的AI出現在Vivy身邊。
松本自稱“來自100年後的未來”，其使命是「與Vivy一起修正歷史，並防止將在100年後發生的AI與人類的戰爭」。
執行著不同任務的2名AI，會把世界導向怎樣的未來？
這是＜我（Vivy）＞將＜我（AI）＞毀滅的故事――
AI『歌姬』Vivy的百年旅程即將開始。


“ニーアランド”、それは夢と希望と科學が混在したAI複合テーマパーク。
史上初の自律人型AIとして生み出され、施設のAIキャストとして活動するヴィヴィは日々、歌うためにステージに立ち続ける。しかし、その人気は今ひとつだった。
――「歌でみんなを幸せにすること」。
自らに與えられたその使命を果たすため、いつか心を込めた歌を歌い、園內にあるメインステージに立つことを目標に歌い続けるヴィヴィ。

ある日、そんなヴィヴィの元に、マツモトと名乗るAIが現れる。

マツモトは自らを100年後の未來からきたAIと話し、その使命は「ヴィヴィと共に歴史を修正し、100年後に起こるAIと人間との戦爭を止めること」だと明かす。

果たして、異なる使命を持つ２體のAIの出會いは、どんな未來を描き直すのか。

これは＜私＞が＜私＞を滅ぼす物語――

AIの『歌姫』ヴィヴィの、百年の旅が始まる。


WIT STUDIO×長月達平×梅原英司

エンターテイメントの名手たちが、引き寄せあった絆で紡ぐSFヒューマンドラマ、ここに開演。
anilist:128546.synopsis_en:
An AI named Matsumoto appears before Vivy, the world’s first autonomous humanoid AI. Matsumoto’s mission is to rewrite history together with Vivy, in order to stop the war between AI and humans that will happen one century later.

(Source: Funimation)

titles.en: So I'm a Spider, So What?

anilist:103632.synopsis_zh:
曾經是一名女高中生的“我”，突然轉生變成了幻想世界中的蜘蛛魔物。
而且，出生地點還是各種兇惡魔物所盤踞的大迷宮。
“我”以人類的智慧和非同尋常的積極心態為武器，使用蜘蛛的絲網以及陷阱打倒比自己等級高得多的敵人，從而存活下來……
身為種族鏈底端的，擁有最強精神力的這位少女的迷宮生存劇，現在開幕！
anilist:103632.synopsis_en:
I, the protagonist, was just an ordinary high school girl, but suddenly I was reincarnated as a spider monster in a fantasy world. Not only that, but I awakened in a dungeon filled with vicious monsters. Armed with only my human knowledge and my overwhelming positivity, I'm forced to use spiderwebs and traps to defeat far stronger monsters just to stay alive... So begins the labyrinth survival story of a girl with incredible mental strength living as one of the lowest-ranked beasts!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

titles.primary_zh: 持續狩獵史萊姆三百年，不知不覺就練到 LV MAX
zh_aliases: 打了300年的史萊姆，不知不覺就練到了滿級
titles.ja: スライム倒して300年、知らないうちにレベルMAXになってました
titles.ja_romaji: Slime Taoshite 300-nen, Shiranai Uchi ni Level MAX ni Nattemashita
titles.en: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level

anilist:112608.synopsis_zh:
非常平凡的上班族相澤梓，因為工作過度而過勞死。成為了不老不死的魔女亞梓莎轉生到了異世界。
鑑於前世的經驗，她在邊境的高原開始悠閒的慢活。打倒史來姆賺取金錢，像個魔女般製作藥物照顧山腳下的村莊。此外變無所事事。她就持續過著這樣的生活，被暱稱為「高原的魔女大人」。
時間來到300年後。持續打倒史來姆累積的經驗值，亞梓莎在不知不覺間成為LV99，也就是世界最強。這個傳聞傳開後，除了對自己有自信的冒險者外，前來決鬥的龍族少女，還有稱呼亞梓莎薇媽媽的怪物少女都一一出現了！



[簡介原文]
ごく普通のOL・相沢梓は働き過ぎが原因で過労死し、不老不死の魔女アズサとして異世界に転生した。前世での反省から、辺境の高原でのんびりスローライフを始めた彼女。
スライムを倒して小銭を稼ぎ、魔女らしく薬を作って麓の村のお世話をする。あとはとくに何もしない。そんな暮らしを続けるうち彼女は「高原の魔女さま」と親しまれるようになっていた――。
ところが300年後。スライムを倒し続けた経験値で、いつの間にやらレベル99＝世界最強となってしまっていたアズサ。その噂は広まり、腕に自信のある冒険者はもちろん、決闘を挑んでくるドラゴン娘や、アズサを母と呼ぶ謎のモンスター娘まで押し掛けて來るようになってしまい――！？
anilist:112608.synopsis_en:
An at-home comedy about a powerful girl who doesn’t work too hard!(⋈◍ ˃ᴗ˂ ◍)。✧♡

After dying of overwork in the real world, I’m reincarnated as an immortal witch, and I spend 300 years enjoying a relaxing life. At some point, though, I end up at level 99!
All those years spent killing slimes to make the money to pay the bills gave me a ton of experience points… Rumors of the level 99 witch spread, and soon I’m up to my ears in curious adventurers, duelist dragons, and even a monster girl calling me her mom! “This isn’t a dojo, so don’t come here to fight me…!”

I’ve never been on an adventure, but I’m the strongest in the world… What’s going to happen to my relaxing life?!

(Source: Crunchyroll)
anilist:112608.source_doc_raw: 持續狩獵史萊姆三百年，不知不覺就練到 LV MAX(12)

anilist:116588.synopsis_zh:
秘密結社キサラギ。 今や地球上の誰もが知る大企業は、自ら悪の組織と名乗ってさまざまな悪事に手を染め、
ヒーローたちを打ち倒し、ついに世界征服を成し遂げようとしていた。  しかし、世界を手に入れれば大勢の戦闘員たちは不要になってしまう。 このリストラ問題を解決すべく、キサラギの最高幹部たちは
新たな侵略先として宇宙に狙いを定める。  そして地球によく似た環境の惑星へ、 「戦闘員六號」と美少女型アンドロイドの「キサラギ＝アリス」を派遣するが、 現地の人々は“魔王軍”の侵略を受けていて――。
anilist:116588.synopsis_en:
Turns out, evil takes initiative! With world domination close at hand, the Kisaragi Corporation turns its sights on interstellar conquest, and who better to take over a magical world than two randomly assigned minions—Combatant Agent Six and his android partner Alice?

But Six’s path up the evil corporate ladder won’t be easy—a Demon Lord’s army is hatching its own nefarious plan!

(Source: Funimation)

titles.primary_zh: 如果究極進化的完全沉浸 RPG 比現實還更像垃圾遊戲的話
zh_aliases: 如果究極進化的完全沉浸RPG比現實更垃圾的話
titles.ja: 究極進化したフルダイブRPGが現実よりもクソゲーだったら
titles.ja_romaji: Kyuukyoku Shinka Shita Full Dive RPG ga Genjitsu yori mo Kusogee Dattara
titles.en: Full Dive: This Ultimate Next-Gen Full Dive RPG Is Even Shittier than Real Life!

anilist:126791.synopsis_zh:
不起眼的高中生結城宏偶然地入手了一款完全潛行RPG遊戲任務。與在封面寫著結合了廣大技術力所製作出的這款遊戲是“極度擬真現實”的宣傳標語不同，不管是圖形、NPC 的舉動、草木的香氣或是肌膚感受到的微風，全部都是非常講究的呈現出來，實在太過於真實，被稱作幾乎不可能過關超級麻煩的遊戲。
除了這件事以外，身體能力也和現實完全一樣。如果被毆打的話會痛，被砍傷的話傷口好幾天都不會治好。貼近真實的遊戲體驗，沒辦法保持輕鬆愉快的情緒遊玩，來攻略這款超有壓力的遊戲吧！
anilist:126791.synopsis_en:
Yuuki Hiroshi has just picked up Kiwame Quest, the realest VRMMO ever made. But this RPG is TOO lifelike; he can smell, taste, feel, and when he's hurt in it, his physical body is hurt too. Even worse, his abilities in this adventure suck as much as they do in daily life. This was supposed to be immersion, not reality. Consumed with winning, he swears he'll conquer this game—even if it kills him!

(Source: Funimation)

Note: The first episode received an online advance screening on March 31, 2021. Regular TV broadcast started on April 7, 2021
anilist:126791.source_doc_raw: 如果究極進化的完全沉浸 RPG 比現實還更像垃圾遊戲的話(12)

anilist:103871.synopsis_zh:
いつもの朝。いつもの音楽。いつもの自分。
7人の少女たちの安寧は、突如崩壊する。
死して蠢く、ゾンビによって……

否応なく踏み込んだ世界、そこは“最高×最悪のゾンビワールド”
少女たちの願いは、たった一つ。
「私たち、生きたい。」
これは、少女達が起こす奇跡の物語。
anilist:103871.synopsis_en:
A typical morning. The usual music. Their normal lives. The peace these seven girls experience will suddenly be destroyed. By the living dead... zombies. A reality that they never wanted a part of, an amazing and terrifying zombie world. They all share one wish: "We want to live." These girls will struggle through this saga, in order to achieve a miracle. MAPPA, Avex Pictures, and Cygames team up to bring you a juicy, 100% original anime. A timeless shocker for all audiences, a brand new style of zombie anime, will soon rise.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

titles.ja: ひぐらしのなく頃に 業
titles.ja_romaji: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Gou

anilist:114446.synopsis_zh:
遠離城市中心，被濃郁的自然環境所環繞的村落——雛見澤村。
原本早在過去就要沉入大壩底部的這個村落，如今仍然以同從前別無二致的景色，迎來了轉學生·前原圭一。
對於以前一直住在都市裡的圭一而言，和雛見澤的同伴共度的熱鬧而平和的生活，本該是永遠持續下去的幸福時光。
一年一度舉行的村中祭典，綿流。直到這一天到來為止……
昭和五十八年，六月。寒蟬鳴泣之時。
日常突然宣告結束，無止境的慘劇連鎖開始了——
anilist:114446.synopsis_en:
New kid Keiichi Maebara is settling into his new home of peaceful Hinamizawa village. Making quick friends with the girls from his school, he's arrived in time for the big festival of the year. But something about this isolated town seems "off," and his feelings of dread continue to grow. With a gnawing fear that he's right, what dark secrets could this small community be hiding?


(Source: Funimation)

titles.primary_zh: Re：從零開始的異世界生活 第二季
titles.ja: Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活 2nd season
titles.ja_romaji: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu 2nd Season
titles.en: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 2

anilist:108632.synopsis_zh:
我一定會拯救你的。
打倒了擔任「怠惰」的魔女教大罪司教，貝特魯吉烏斯·羅曼尼康帝后，菜月昴和愛蜜莉雅又再度相遇了。在跨越了痛苦的訣別，兩人終於和解，而新的篇章卻又開始了。
超乎想象九死一生的危機，以及冷酷無情的現實。少年將再次起身，面對殘酷的命運。
anilist:108632.synopsis_en: Even after dying countless times, Subaru finally ended the threat of the White Whale and defeated the Witch Cult's Sin Archbishop representing sloth, Petelgeuse Romaneeconti. But only shortly after overcoming a tragic ending and reuniting with his beloved Emilia, Subaru learns that Rem has been erased from this world, having fallen victim to the White Whale's Fog of Elimination in the midst of Subaru's death loop. With the White Whale now gone, Subaru and Emilia are forced to confront a reality they never dreamed would happen.(Source: Crunchyroll)
anilist:108632.source_doc_raw: Re：從零開始的異世界生活 第二季(25)

titles.primary_zh: Dr.STONE 新石紀 第二季

anilist:162670.synopsis_zh:
全人類被神奇的現象一瞬間石化後過了幾千年——
擁有超人般頭腦、天生的科學少年·千空甦醒了。
在文明遭到毀滅的石頭世界（STONE WORLD）裡，千空集結新夥伴的力量一起建立“科學王國”，最終目標是用科學的力量復原整個世界。
他和夥伴們攻克種種難關，讓生火、冶鐵、發電、製造玻璃、手機在荒蕪的世界裡成為了現實，從而跨越從石器時代到現代文明這二百萬年科學史的鴻溝。
但是，由靈長類最強的高中生獅子王司領導的“武裝帝國”卻步步為營。旨在淨化人類的司試圖透過使用強大的力量來阻止科學的發展。

STONE WARS，即將開戰！
anilist:162670.synopsis_en:
The second cour  of Dr. STONE: NEW WORLD.

Years ago, astronaut Byakuya left behind precious materials in the belief that his son, the scientifically-gifted Senkuu, would one day find them. In the present, the Kingdom of Science's Kohaku and Ginrou have infiltrated the harem of the Petrification Kingdom’s leader with the help of Amaryllis, a local girl. At first, their mission progresses without a hitch. Unfortunately, an error enacted by Kohaku and Ginrou leads Minister Ibara and the Island’s strongest warrior, Moz, to identify the intruding duo as enemies.

Even worse, Moz tails Amaryllis when she returns to inform Senkuu of the news, discovering the scientist's secret hideout. However, Moz's agenda does not align with Ibara's—he wants to dethrone the minister and keep the petrification device for himself. If Senkuu plays his cards right, he could gain a powerful ally and win the war once and for all.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)
anilist:162670.source_doc_raw: Dr.STONE 新石紀 第二季(11)

titles.ja: ブラッククローバー OAD

anilist:97940.synopsis_zh: JSAF2016上映的原創動畫，單行本限定版第11卷同捆DVD。
anilist:97940.synopsis_en:
In a world where magic is everything, Asta and Yuno are both found abandoned at a church on the same day. While Yuno is gifted with exceptional magical powers, Asta is the only one in this world without any. At the age of fifteen, both receive grimoires, magic books that amplify their holder’s magic. Asta’s is a rare Grimoire of Anti-Magic that negates and repels his opponent’s spells. Being opposite but good rivals, Yuno and Asta are ready for the hardest of challenges to achieve their common dream: to be the Wizard King. Giving up is never an option!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

anilist:113425.synopsis_zh:
覺醒了“愈”之勇者的素質，開始與勇者們一同踏上拯救世界冒險之旅的少年·克亞路。
然而，身為沒有戰鬥能力的回覆術士，等待著他的是能力遭到勇者們榨取，飽受虐待的每一天。
自由和尊嚴被剝奪，連自我都快要失去的克亞路，某天恢復了理智，並抵達了“回覆“的真實。
“回覆“並非僅僅是治癒。“回覆“是從根源動搖世界與人類的力量。
克亞路“回覆“了世界本身，下定決心從四年前開始“重啟”一切。並且，他也為能報復勇者們而激動不已……
“來吧，派對（復仇）要開始了——”
anilist:113425.synopsis_en:
In a dark world of monsters, adventurers and mages, some of the most gifted healers are subjugated to brute force even by the hands of their compatriots. But one mage, Keyaru, gains the ability to rewind time, turn the tables and right all wrongs.

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)

Note: This anime was aired at three broadcast censorship levels: a TV version, a streaming-exclusive "Redo" version, and an uncensored "Complete Healing" version, also translated as "Complete Recovery," shown on AT-X.

titles.primary_zh: 記錄的地平線 圓桌崩壞
titles.ja: ログ・ホライズン 円卓崩壊
titles.en: Log Horizon: Destruction of the Round Table

anilist:114862.synopsis_zh:
某日，數萬名玩家突然被困在了網遊《幻境神話》的世界裡！在這個怪物與魔法真實存在的異世界裡，被稱作“冒險者”的玩家們陷入了混亂，冒險者都市“秋葉原”也逐漸淪為不法之地。
不善交際的城惠，也是這樣的冒險者的一員。但決意改善這一切現狀的他，和盟友直繼、曉、喵太等人組成了公會“記錄的地平線”，並以自己的聰明才智為武器，呼籲冒險者們團結一心。冒險者們的自治組織“圓桌會議”就此成立，為秋葉原恢復了秩序與和平。
透過“圓桌會議”牽頭，冒險者們也開始了與遊戲世界的原居民“大地人”的交流。貴族代表柯文家的蕾妮希雅公主作為大使出任秋葉原，冒險者與大地人的貴族、商人、普通居民們的交流也愈加活躍。
自從冒險者們被傳送到這個世界的“大災難”以來，已經過了1年時間。在秋葉原表面上的和平與繁榮之下，卻藏著新種怪物“典災”的襲來、東西方貴族的權力鬥爭、冒險者之間的貧富差距與觀念差異等不安的火種。
而終於，冒險者們團結的象徵“圓桌會議”迎來了分崩離析的危機……
anilist:114862.synopsis_en:
The third season of Log Horizon.

It’s been a year since Shiroe and his friends were trapped in Akiba due to the Catastrophe. Their forging of the Round Table has brought order and prosperity to its people. But fracturing political alliances and the constant menace of the Genius monsters threaten to destabilize all they’ve fought for and built. Can faith be restored and they persevere, or is its destruction truly inevitable?

(Source: Funimation)
anilist:114862.source_doc_raw: 記錄的地平線 圓桌崩壞(12)

titles.primary_zh: 只有我能進入的隱藏迷宮
zh_aliases: 只有我進入的隱藏地下城
titles.ja: 俺だけ入れる隠しダンジョン
titles.en: The Hidden Dungeon Only I Can Enter

anilist:118375.synopsis_zh:
滿足自己的性慾、食慾、物慾，將世界最強的技能創作、賦予、編輯出來！！
藏匿了大量稀有魔物和珍奇寶物的傳頌之地——隱藏迷宮.
失業的貧困貴族三男·諾爾，幸運地開啟了這座隱藏迷宮的入口。在隱藏迷宮中，諾爾學會了創作，賦予和編輯技能的能力。除此之外，使用這項技能時，竟然需要“吃好吃的食物”還是“與容貌出色的異性進行親密接觸”，以此來儲存必要的點數……
anilist:118375.synopsis_en:
The Hidden Dungeon is a place of legend where rare treasures and items are hidden. Noir, the third son of an impoverished noble family who's lost the one job offer he had, was lucky enough to hear about this dungeon. He then acquires a skill that allows him to create, bestow, and edit skills... and in order to use it, he needs to accumulate points by carrying out such tasks as eating delicious meals and doing sexual things with alluring members of the opposite sex.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
anilist:118375.source_doc_raw: 只有我能進入的隱藏迷宮(12)

anilist:114085.synopsis_zh:
古來よりこの世の影に潛み、人に見つからぬよう、人と関わり合って生きる“怪物”（けもの）という存在。
彼らの多くは人間の世界に適応し、社會に交じり生活していた。
しかし現代では、人と必要以上に深く関わろうとするケースが多數報告されるようになっていた。

探偵事務所を営む隠神は、そんな“怪物”たちが起こす怪事件のうちの一つを追い、片田舎のとある村を訪れる。そしてそこで夏羽という少年に出會う——。
anilist:114085.synopsis_en:
Special detective Kohachi Inugami is sent to investigate a grisly phenomenon involving animal corpses near a remote mountain village. But after meeting a strange boy who agrees to help, he discovers cursed supernatural forces at work. Little by little, Inugami uncovers the truth behind the killings and the boy who may not even be human.

(Source: Funimation)

titles.primary_zh: 約定的夢幻島 第二季
titles.ja: 約束のネバーランド Season 2

anilist:108725.synopsis_zh:
——自由、是多麼美麗、而又多麼殘酷啊。

成功從Grace=Field House逃出的15個孩子。
等待在拋棄虛偽的樂園而勇敢追求自由的他們的面前是、未曾見過的動植物、
以及一路追趕而來的「鬼」……外面的世界是如此美麗，卻也如此殘酷。

但是孩子們並沒有放棄。
「密涅瓦」的訊息、諾曼留下的一支筆
根據這些引導，奔向明天。
去迎接留在House的「家人」，為了完成那個約定。
anilist:108725.synopsis_en:
The second season of Yakusoku no Neverland.

Fifteen children escape Grace Field House, a false paradise, hoping for a chance at freedom. Instead, they encounter plants and animals they have never before seen, and are chased by demons. The outside world is so beautiful, and yet is almost too cruel to face.

Even so, the children refuse to give up. They are guided in their search for better lives only by a message from Minerva and a pen Norman left behind in order to fulfill their promise to return to the House to save those of their family who are still trapped within.

(Source: Aniplex of America)

Note: Episode 1 streamed early on Amazon Prime on Jan 7, 2021. The regular TV broadcast started on Jan 8, 2021.
anilist:108725.source_doc_raw: 約定的夢幻島 第二季(11)

titles.primary_zh: 炎炎消防隊 貳之章
zh_aliases: 炎炎消防隊 二之章
titles.ja: 炎炎ノ消防隊 弐ノ章

anilist:105310.synopsis_zh:
この「國」は、何かを隠している──。
“地下（ネザー）”での激戦を終え、 シンラたちは「伝導者」の野望を知る。
その目的は、特殊な炎「アドラバースト」の 使い手を集めて弐佰伍拾年前の大災害を 再び起こし、
世界を滅ぼすことだった。
自らもアドラバーストを持つシンラは、 伝導者に追われる身ながら、 その策略を潰すべく奔走を続ける。
新たなアドラバーストを持つ少女との出會い、
そして、ひた隠しにされてきた皇國の要たる 天照＜アマテラス＞の大いなる秘密。
炎に狂わされ、炎に導かれし少年は、一歩ずつ、 真実へと近づいていく。
anilist:105310.synopsis_en: Year 198 of the Solar Era in Tokyo, special fire brigades are fighting against a phenomenon called spontaneous human combustion where human beings are turned into living infernos called "Infernals.” While the Infernals are first-generation cases of spontaneous human combustion, later generations possess the ability to manipulate flames while retaining human form. Shinra Kusakabe, a youth who gained the nickname Devil’s Footprints for his ability to ignite his feet at will, joins the Special Fire Force Company 8 which composes of other flames users as they work to extinguish any Infernals they encounter. As a faction that is creating Infernals appears, Shinra begins to uncover the truth behind a mysterious fire that caused the death of his family twelve years ago. (Source: Official Website)
anilist:105310.source_doc_raw: 炎炎消防隊 貳之章(24)

anilist:116005.synopsis_zh: 吸血鬼貴族卡迪斯·艾特拉馬·迪·萊傑羅在沉睡了八百年後，被一個叫UNION的組織用某種手段，讓他甦醒了過來。 時隔多年來到現代人類社會的他，第一次過上了嚮往的平凡生活，然而麻煩接踵而至，他不得不和找他算賬的人進行戰鬥……
anilist:116005.synopsis_en: For 820 years he had slumbered with no knowledge of mankind's advancement and scientific progress. The land which he once knew has become an unfamiliar place with new technology, attitudes, and lifestyles. Upon awakening, Cadis Etrama Di Raizel (aka Rai), seeks to familiarize himself with this era. He locates a loyal servant of his, Frankenstein, who is currently the principal of a South Korean High School. Rai decides that this school is the perfect place to help him learn about the modern world, enrolls, and begins associating with a group of good-natured students in order to 'blend in'. But this new world is no safer than the old; and the dignified, bewildered, technologically inept Rai finds himself embroiled in adventures both ridiculous and dangerous.

anilist:117343.synopsis_zh:
“我能夠讀懂人心！但是我有點不太會看氣氛！請多關照！”
位於孤島上的奇妙學園。出現在學生中島七男面前的是轉校生柊奈奈。奇妙學園是擁有各種能力的少年少女所聚集的設施。有能夠操縱火焰或冰的人、有能在空中自由飛翔的人、有能將空氣化為利刃實施攻擊的人。學生們為和被稱為“人類之敵”的怪物戰鬥而接受訓練。但是，這座島上卻隱藏了很多秘密，可怕的陷阱開始露出獠牙。連續發生了怪異事件。潛藏在學園中的殺人鬼。一個又一個消失的同學們。超出預料的發展。竭盡智力和能力極限的頭腦戰。以及友情。在激烈戲劇點綴之下，與“人類之敵”的死鬥開始！
anilist:117343.synopsis_en: It is the year 20XX. Earth has been assaulted by monsters known as 'the Enemy of Humanity'. In order to deal with this threat, special schools comprised of teenagers with extraordinary abilities were formed. These people, who came to be known as 'the Talented', have abilities that defy the rules of reality. Among these superpowered individuals was an outlier, someone who was sent to one of these schools despite having no innate special abilities whatsoever. This is the story of our protagonist, who attempts to defeat the Enemies of Humanity through the use of intelligence and manipulation.

anilist:116566.synopsis_zh:
全·員·惡·人
犯罪者們的犯罪動作劇開幕！
遙遠的過去，關東和關西之間爆發戰爭，世界分裂了。
關西成為關東的屬國，並實現了獨立的發展。
但相對地，其政治與警力衰退，犯罪橫行。
這些犯罪者，被稱作惡棍——。
本作品的舞臺，是高度發達卻又高度扭曲的社會。
在這樣的社會中，惡棍們將會如何以自己的風格生存呢。
齊聚一堂的惡棍們的美學，彼此發生碰撞。
anilist:116566.synopsis_en:
Many years ago, a Great Civil War ravaged Japan, leaving the country fragmented between two regions: Kansai and Kanto. In Kansai, a group of six Akudama carry out missions given to them by a mysterious black cat, while evading the police. But a dangerous journey is about to unfold when a civilian girl becomes twisted into the Akudama’s way of life and witnesses their criminal drives.

(Source: Funimation)

Note: On May 28, 2021, a director's cut of the final episode was released which included approximately 5 minutes of new content.

titles.primary_zh: 魔法科高中的劣等生 來訪者篇
zh_aliases: 魔法科高校的劣等生 追憶篇
titles.ja: 魔法科高校の劣等生 追憶編
titles.en: The Irregular at Magic High School: Visitor Arc

anilist:112300.synopsis_zh:
魔法が技術として確立され、約一世紀が過ぎた二〇九五年四月。
魔法師を育成する國立魔法大學付屬第一高校、通稱“魔法科高校”に二人の兄妹が入學した。
一人は魔法師として致命的な欠陥を抱える劣等生の兄・達也。
もう一人は完全無欠の魔法師として讃えられる優等生の妹・深雪。
時に戀人同士と間違われるほど仲睦まじい二人だが、ほんの數年前までは、まるで女主人と使用人のように冷え切った関係だった。
その関係が変わった背景には、ある出來事があった。
三年前の沖縄。
深雪にとって忘れられない出來事によって、二人の心と、その運命が大きく変わっていく。
シリーズ累計2000萬部を突破したスクールマギクスの始まりの物語《追憶編》が幕を開ける。
anilist:112300.synopsis_en:
The second season of Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei.

Miyuki Shiba’s classmate Kitayama Shizuku is on her way to study abroad. For magicians, this is normally impossible, since allowing the genes of someone who can use magic outside their home country’s borders is tantamount to giving up national secrets. But it’s allowed to happen in one case—exchange programs.

And that’s how Angelina Kudou Shields, known as Lina, has arrived in Japan from the USNA to study at First High. Around the time Lina arrived in Japan, magicians began getting attacked by a mysterious being who leaves his victims drained of blood. Will Tatsuya and Miyuki Shiba be able to discover the identity of the “Vampire”?

(Source: Funimation)
anilist:112300.source_doc_raw: 魔法科高中的劣等生 來訪者篇(13)

titles.en: The Day I Became a God

anilist:118419.synopsis_zh:
在她成為神的那天，世界開始走向終結——
高中最後的暑假，在成神陽太的眼前，突然有一天，自稱“知曉一切的神”的少女雛出現了。
“30天后，這個世界就會結束。”
陽太對告知這樣的訊息感到困惑，但是看到神一樣的預知能力，確信那個力量是真的。
與超常的力量相反，天真爛漫、天真無邪的小雛，不知為何決定寄居在陽太的家中，兩人共同生活。
向著“世界末日”，喧鬧的一個夏天開始了。
anilist:118419.synopsis_en:
Youta Narukami is a student focused only on his college entrance exams. During his last summer break of high school, he is approached by a girl named Hina who says she is the god of omniscience. She tells him that in thirty days, the world will end. At first Youta doesn't believe her, but after she demonstrates supernatural predictive abilities, he becomes convinced her power is genuine. Hina, meanwhile, decides for some reason to stay at his house, and they begin a tumultuous vacation facing the end of the world together.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Note: The first episode received an early screening on October 3rd, 2020. The regular TV broadcast started on October 11th, 2020.

anilist:114340.synopsis_zh:
享受著悠閒自在的宅生活的美少女優奈是，

沉迷VRMMORPG《World Fantasy Online》的網遊廢人。

某天和往常一樣登入後，跟平常的情況有些不一樣。
難道……這是遊戲的裡面？還是異世界？
隨後，來到這片土地上的優奈的裝備
固定成了《熊外套》《熊手套》《熊靴》——嗯？
くま……？　クマ……？　熊……？　ベアー……？
（依次為日文“熊”的平假名、片假名、漢字和英文“bear”的片假名寫法[譯註]）

“這是什麼情況啊——————!?”

熊女孩，爆炸性誕生了！
而且這隻熊不是普通的熊。
是深藏著世界最強水平的魔法和技能的，
一隻不得了的超級熊！
獲得了世界都能征服的
強大力量的優奈的目的——那是!?
在這個世界，也能盡情地快樂自由隨心所欲地生活！

最強無敵的熊女孩所帶來的，熊的冒險和熊的日常的故事，開始了♪
anilist:114340.synopsis_en:
Yuna's not your typical 15-year-old. First, she's crazy rich from playing the stock market. Second, she's a recluse obsessed with a VRMMO game, and she's really good at that too. Her life is pretty much perfect—until she wakes up one day inside the game she loves and back at level one. She has to start over, but this time, she has a powerful bear suit that's guaranteed to take her places!

(Source: Funimation)

Note: The first episode was streamed on Abema TV on September 19, 2020. The regular TV broadcast started on October 7, 2020.

titles.en: Sleepy Princess in the Demon Castle

anilist:111428.synopsis_zh:
過去，在人與魔相互來往、共存的時代。
魔王抓走了人類的公主，囚禁在自己的城堡中——。
被囚禁的棲夜莉絲公主，在牢籠之中低語。
「…除了睡覺…無事可做」 
她偷偷逃出牢獄，為追求更優質的安眠而在魔王城中……探索！？
自由任性的人質公主，隨心所欲地將魔物們一起拉下水！！新感覺睡眠奇幻喜劇！
anilist:111428.synopsis_en:
Sshhh! Princess Syalis is trying to get a good night's sleep. Some shut-eye. Forty winks. Catch some Z's. Long ago in olden times when people and demons lived together in—well, disharmony, really—a demon king kidnaps a human princess and imprisons her in his castle. Bereft, the princess's subjects beat their chests in anguish…until a hero arises to spearhead Project Rescue Our Princess! While waiting for her knight in shining armor, what's an imprisoned princess to do...? Teddy-bear guards with bat wings are all very well, but her dungeon cell is bo-o-o-ring! So, she decides to wile away the long hours by sleeping. Now if only she could get comfortable…and didn't suffer from insomnia...

(Source: VIZ Media)

titles.en: By the Grace of the Gods

anilist:115740.synopsis_zh:
在黑心企業任職系統工程師的39歲單身上班族竹林龍馬，在自己的單人公寓裡走到了生命的盡頭。被召喚至天界的龍馬，在創造神、愛之女神、生命之神的拜託之下，以小孩子的模樣轉生到了異世界！？在深邃的森林開始獨自生活的8歲的龍馬，一邊埋頭研究利用魔法來馴養的史萊姆，一邊謳歌著新的人生。
接受周圍非常溫柔的人們的幫助，過著快樂的每一天，龍馬悠閒的異世界慢生活幻想故事，開幕！
anilist:115740.synopsis_en:
Only 39 years into a life full of bad luck, Ryouma Takebayashi passes away in his sleep! Taking pity on him, three divine beings show compassion by reincarnating him as a young boy to a magical, new world.

Now he spends his time researching and caring for slimes. But after healing an injured traveler, Ryouma decides to set out with his new friends on a journey to use his power to help others.

(Source: Funimation)

anilist:117757.synopsis_zh:
——“攀登體育運動”。
那是一種運用頭腦和肉體，用自己的身體一個人攀登牆壁的競技。
拼圖遊戲天才笠原好偶然遇到了校內有名的攀巖牆！
簡直就像是五顏六色的“岩石拼圖”……
那樣命運的相遇，讓好的人生為之一變！
和花宮女子高中攀巖部的夥伴一起朝著頂點進發吧……
熱血的正式攀巖故事，現在開始！
anilist:117757.synopsis_en:
The story centers around girls who compete in sport climbing, particularly climbing artificially constructed walls. First-year high school student Konomi Kasahara discovered this sport at Hanamiya Girls' High School after training her mind with puzzle games during junior high school.

(Source: Anime News Network)

titles.primary_zh: 在地下城尋求邂逅是否搞錯了什麼 第三季
zh_aliases: 在地下城尋求邂逅是否搞錯了什麼
titles.ja: ダンジョンに出会いを求めるのは間違っているだろうか
titles.ja_romaji: Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka III
titles.en: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? III

anilist:112124.synopsis_zh:
迷宮都市尤拉麗——是一座擁有雄偉地下迷宮（通稱“地下城”）的巨大都市。
想成為冒險者並且嚮往像英雄冒險譚中那樣的“與異性命運的邂逅”的貝爾·克朗尼，在這個地方遇見了一位小小的“神明”赫斯緹雅，而她正四處尋找自己“眷族”的成員。
吃了不少“眷族”閉門羹的貝爾在聽了其勸誘後，立馬就決定加入。
這是少年所走過的，女神所記錄的——【眷族物語（Familiar Myth）】——
anilist:112124.synopsis_en:
The third season of Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka.

When Bell encounters a frightened little girl in the dungeon, he doesn’t think twice to help. But this simple act of kindness has consequences. The girl is a monster and proof that monsters can be eerily human. And not everyone can accept this...

(Source: HIDIVE)
anilist:112124.source_doc_raw: 在地下城尋求邂逅是否搞錯了什麼 第三季(12)

titles.en: Wandering Witch: The Journey of Elaina

anilist:112609.synopsis_zh:
在某個地方有一位旅人。她的名字叫伊蕾娜。
她是年紀輕輕就成為了最上位的“魔女”的才女。
憧憬著小時候讀過的旅行的故事，
順其自然地持續著隨心所欲的長途旅行。
在廣大的世界裡自由地穿行 ，遇見莫名其妙、可笑的人，
或是見證到某人的美麗的日常，
她作為旅人，也沒有什麼目的，
重複著和各種各樣的國家和人的相遇。
以及相同數量的——

“請別管我。我就是個旅人，
必須趕路了。”
這樣的魔女伊蕾娜所編織的離別的物語。
anilist:112609.synopsis_en:
Inspired by her favorite book, Elaina ventures out to see the world she's read so much about. Like a leaf on the wind, she travels from one country to another, looking to sate her inquisitiveness and searching for new experiences. She's confronted by humanity in all its forms, whether strange, bizarre, or emotional. Exploration and curiosity drive her journey. Where to next, Elaina?


(Source: Funimation)

titles.ja: 100万の命の上に俺は立っている
titles.ja_romaji: 100-man no Inochi no Ue ni Ore wa Tatteiru
titles.en: I'm Standing on a Million Lives

anilist:116242.synopsis_zh:
重視合理、喜歡單獨行動的中學3年生四谷友助，某天穿越到了遊戲風格的異世界——
他與同樣穿越到異世界的同班同學新堂衣宇、箱崎紅末一起行動，作為第3名玩家，開始挑戰賭上性命的遊戲任務。四谷捨棄感情論，對所有要素一視同仁，有時甚至將同伴的性命當作棋子來使用。這樣的他能否從襲來的魔物、棘手的事件以及暗中活躍的強敵手中避免隊伍全滅，併成功通關這個遊戲呢？
anilist:116242.synopsis_en:
Aloof and logical middle school third-year Yuusuke Yotsuya is transported to a game-like alternate world. He becomes a third player and takes on a dangerous quest with his classmates Iu Shindo and Kusue Hakozaki, who were transported there earlier. The cold Yuusuke eschews emotionalism and examines all elements with detachment, sometimes even toying with the lives of his companions. Can he protect his party from attacking monsters, difficult incidents, and powerful scheming enemies and win the game?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

titles.primary_zh: 神推偶像登上武道館我就死而無憾
titles.ja: 推しが武道館いってくれたら死ぬ
titles.en: If My Favorite Pop Idol Made It to the Budokan, I Would Die

anilist:104391.synopsis_zh: 住在岡山縣的繪里飄，是為了小型地下偶像“Cham Jam”的成員·舞菜而獻上人生的狂熱偶像宅。繪里飄身上穿的，是高中時代的紅色運動衫。繪里飄所揮舞的，是鮭魚粉色的熒光棒。繪里飄所推的，只有舞菜一人而已。將全部收入貢獻給推，24小時想著推的事情，聲嘶力竭呼喊著推的名字，這一姿態在偶像宅之間被稱為傳說，人人對此感到欽佩。“有朝一日舞菜站在武道館的舞臺上的話……我就死而無憾！”如此斷言的傳說中的女人·繪里飄的偶像宅活動，今天也在繼續……！
anilist:104391.synopsis_en: Passionate music-lover Eripiyo only wants to see her favorite underground pop group, ChamJam, make it to the big stage at Budokan. Because they’ve enriched her life by their very existence, Eri is willing to dedicate everything she has to see this dream fulfilled – even her health. At their last performance she got a crazy nosebleed. Hey, no one said being a super-fan was easy!(Source: Crunchyroll)
anilist:104391.source_doc_raw: 神推偶像登上武道館我就死而無憾(12)

titles.primary_zh: 果然我的青春戀愛喜劇搞錯了。完
zh_aliases: 我的青春戀愛物語果然有問題 完
titles.ja: やはり俺の青春ラブコメはまちがっている。完
titles.ja_romaji: Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Come wa Machigatteiru. Kan
titles.en: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax!

anilist:108489.synopsis_zh:
看似在過去的心理陰影及獨自的彆扭思考迴路之下謳歌著“獨自生活”的比企谷八幡，偶然地被生活指導擔當教師平冢靜帶著加入了「侍奉部」。他和同社團所屬的令人窒息的完美美少女·雪之下雪乃，以及班級上位階級所屬的時髦女子·由比濱結衣一同，從解決班上的人際關係問題到給學生會幫忙，度過著解決各種事件的每一天。
季節流轉，時至春天。八幡與結衣，接受了雪乃最後的委託。在準備3月的畢業典禮過程中，還被彩羽請求協助畢業舞會……
——追求真物的八幡，與3人的關係逐漸改變。究竟他的高中生活將迎來怎樣的結局！？
anilist:108489.synopsis_en:
The third season of Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Come wa Machigatteiru.

As the members of the Service Club band together to host a school prom, Hachiman, Yukino and Yui will have to put their feelings into words and truly learn to understand each other at long last… if the Service Club can even stay afloat, that is!

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)
anilist:108489.source_doc_raw: 果然我的青春戀愛喜劇搞錯了。完(12)

anilist:101239.synopsis_zh: 車谷空，是一個對籃球擁有無與倫比熱情的15歲少年。不但擁有極高的天分而且十分努力。身高卻只有149cm，但車谷空向母親發誓『在高中最初的籃球的大會優勝』而進入到籃球部，誰知這所學校男子籃球部人數不齊，是不良們聚集的巢穴。原本籃球部的花園百春和花園千秋也整日渾渾度日，社團活動一度瀕臨垮臺。阿空竭盡自己所能復興籃球隊，花園兄弟也因阿空精湛的籃球技術重新練習籃球，醜小鴨們決定開闢屬於自己的那片籃球天空。
anilist:101239.synopsis_en:
He may be short in stature, but Sora Kurumatani can soar and score on the basketball court! With a passion for the sport he inherited from his mother, Sora vows to her that he’ll take top prize at a high school basketball tournament… but there’s one problem. His new school’s basketball club has turned into a hangout for delinquents! Will Sora’s sheer tenacity and amazing three-point shooting change their minds and get the club up and running again?

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)

anilist:114888.synopsis_zh:
擁有大量資產的神戶家大少爺・大助前往赴任的地方是僅接受在警視廳引起問題的人的“現代犯罪對策本部準備室”，通稱“現對本部”。在那裡，大助與重視人情的男人·加藤春組成了搭檔。面對連人的性命都以價錢衡量的大助，加藤以“世上並非只有金錢”反駁。阻擋在這對立的2人面前的是各種各樣的事件和謎團。
超越常識的搜查現在開始——
anilist:114888.synopsis_en:
Based on Yasutaka Tsutsui's novel, Fugou Keiji.

The story centers around millionaire Daisuke Kambe, the heir to one of the wealthiest families in Japan, who is assigned as a detective to the Modern Crime Prevention Task Force (aka MCPTF), at the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department. Taking full advantage of his vast family wealth, he spares no expense in solving complex crimes, and has the tendency to evaluate everything including individual human lives in terms of their monetary value. Haru Katou, a detective with a compassionate heart who believes that money isn’t everything, is chosen as Kambe’s partner but is repulsed by his materialistic attitude. Having diametrically opposing personalities, witness how the two join forces to tackle seemingly unsolvable crimes and mysteries!

(Source: Fuji Creative Corporation)

Note: Although Tsutsui's novel was published between 1975 and 1977, the anime plays out in the modern era.

titles.ja: THE GOD OF HIGH SCHOOL ゴッド・オブ・ハイスクール

anilist:116006.synopsis_zh:
自稱最強の高校生「ジン･モリ」。
彼の人生は、最強の高校生を決める大會、「ゴッドオブハイスクール」に招待されることで一変する。
優勝すればどんな願いも葉えられるという・・・それぞれの願いを胸に出場する強敵手たち。
闘いの果てに待ち受けるものとは？
ハンパない高校生たちのハチャメチャバトル開幕!!
anilist:116006.synopsis_en: It all began as a fighting tournament to seek out for the best fighter among all high school students in Korea. Mori Jin, a Taekwondo specialist and a high school student, soon learns that there is something much greater beneath the stage of the tournament.(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.ja: 食戟のソーマ 豪ノ皿
titles.ja_romaji: Shokugeki no Souma: Ni no Sara

anilist:21518.synopsis_zh:
在自家的餐館「幸平」磨鍊料理水平的幸平創真，在父親的推薦下，進入了超級精英料理學校「遠月茶寮料理學園」。他在與競爭對手們展開食戟、與夥伴進行鑽研之下，身為料理人逐漸成長著。時光流逝，升入二年級的創真終於抵達學園的頂點，遠月十傑評議會“第一席”的寶座——。
此時，遠月學園收到了世界級料理競賽「THE BLUE」的請柬。「THE BLUE」是年輕的料理人們賭上自己的名聲展開競爭的正統派美食大賽——但，這一次卻和以往的趣向不同，盡是一些脫離常規的題目！？新的對手出現，瀰漫著波瀾起伏預感的「THE BLUE」將會如何進展……！？決定揹負次代料理界之人的食戟，開幕！
anilist:21518.synopsis_en:
The second season of Shokugeki no Souma.

At the Totsuki Culinary Academy, the first rule is survival of the fittest, and if you don't have what it takes to become a master chef, you need to get out of the kitchen before you get burned. With the wheat of first-year students separated from the chaff, cocky former diner cook Yukihira Souma is one of the handful of kitchen whizzes still standing. As the next round of the Autumn Elections gets underway, can he survive a brutal bento boxing match with the chemistry-obsessed granddaughter of the Academy's director? And which of the other contenders; Megumi, Ryou, Akira, Hisako, Takumi or sinister dark-horse Subaru; will advance to fight for the gold medal?

(Source: Sentai Filmworks))

titles.primary_zh: 魔王學院的不適任者～史上最強的魔王始祖，轉生就讀子孫們的學校～
titles.ja: 魔王学院の不適合者 ～史上最強の魔王の始祖、転生して子孫たちの学校へ通う～
titles.ja_romaji: Maou Gakuin no Futekigousha: Shijou Saikyou no Maou no Shiso, Tensei shite Shison-tachi no Gakkou e Kayou
titles.en: The Misfit of Demon King Academy: History’s Strongest Demon King Reincarnates and Goes to School with His Descendants

anilist:112301.synopsis_zh:
歷經兩千年的時光，甦醒了的暴虐魔王——
但他在培育魔王候補的學院中的適性卻是——《不適任》！？
儘管具備能毀滅人類、精靈，甚至是眾神的力量，暴虐魔王“阿諾斯·波魯迪戈烏多”卻厭倦了永無止盡的鬥爭，夢想著和平的世界進行轉生。然而在兩千年後，轉生後的他所迎來的，卻是適應和平生活而變得過於弱小的子孫們，以及各種衰退至極的魔法。
阿諾斯雖然進入了對被視作魔王轉世之人進行集中教育的“魔王學院”，但學院卻無法看出他的實力，使得他被刻上不適任者這一烙印。不僅如此，傳說中的魔王還變成了和自己完全不同的其他人。
在眾人都瞧不起他的環境裡，他將唯一親切對待自己的少女米夏納為部下， 作為不適任者（魔王），在魔族的等級制度上邁向巔峰！！
“不論天理、命運還是奇蹟，在我的眼前只有俯首受戮一途而已。”
anilist:112301.synopsis_en:
Anos, the Demon King of Tyranny, has defeated humans, spirits, and gods alike. But even demon kings get tired of all the fighting sometimes! Hoping for a more peaceful life, Anos decides to reincarnate himself. When he wakes two thousand years later, though, he finds the world has become too peaceful--his descendants have grown weak and magic is in serious decline. Intending to reclaim his rightful place, he enrolls in Demon King Academy, where he finds that his magical power is off the charts. Literally. And because they can't measure his power, the faculty and other students regard Anos as a misfit. With the support of Misha, the one student he manages to befriend, the misfit (Demon King) begins his climb up the demon ranks!

(Source: Square Enix Manga & Books)
anilist:112301.source_doc_raw: 魔王學院的不適任者～史上最強的魔王始祖，轉生就讀子孫們的學校～(13)

anilist:110353.synopsis_zh:
面對突然出現的未知生命體“葛多爾”，人類突然面臨滅亡危機，而後經過了漫長的歲月。倖存下來的人們為了擺脫“葛多爾”的威脅和侵害，建造了高度為3000M的巨大移動要塞“DECA-DENCE”，過上了平穩的日子。
住在“DECA-DENCE”裡的分為兩種人，日夜與“葛多爾”戰鬥的戰士“齒輪（Gear）”以及不具有戰鬥能力的“油輪（Tanker）”。非常憧憬與“葛多爾”戰鬥的戰士“齒輪”，夢想著自己也能成為“齒輪”的“油輪”少女·夏芽，在某天與態度冷淡的“DECA-DENCE”修理工·鏑木相遇。
沒有放棄夢想的積極少女與放棄了夢想的現實主義男子。乍看之下性格似乎完全相反的兩人之間的相遇，終將對這個世界的未來產生重大影響。
anilist:110353.synopsis_en:
Many years have passed since humanity was driven to the brink of extinction by the sudden emergence of the unknown life forms Gadoll. Those humans that survived now dwell in a 3000 meter-high mobile fortress Deca-dence built to protect themselves from the Gadoll threat.

Denizens of Deca-dence fall into two categories: Gears, warriors who fight the Gadoll daily, and Tankers, those without the skills to fight. One day, Natsume, a Tanker girl who dreams of becoming a Gear meets surly Kaburagi, an armor repairman of Deca-dence.

This chance meeting between the seemingly two opposites, the girl with a positive attitude who never gives up on her dreams and the realist who has given up on his, will eventually shake the future course of this world.

(Source: Funimation)

titles.primary_zh: 刀劍神域 Alicization War of Underworld
titles.ja: ソードアート・オンライン
titles.ja_romaji: Sword Art Online: Alicization - War of Underworld
titles.en: Sword Art Online: Alicization - War of Underworld

anilist:108759.synopsis_zh: 2022年，人類實現了現實世界和假想空間的融合，電子製造商開發了名為《刀劍神域（Sword Art Online）》的線上電子遊戲。SAO甫一面世便大受好評，限量一萬份的名額在發售當天的短時間內便被搶購一空。透過聯網，玩家可以身臨其境進入充滿想象力和異域風情的遊戲世界——浮游城市艾恩葛朗特。玩家在這裡可以生活、練武、升級、經商、探險，與真實世界別無二致，卻擁有無上的樂趣。曾是少數封測玩家的桐人也是這一萬名幸運者中的一員。最初的興奮過後，玩家們卻發現根本無法順利登出遊戲，更為恐怖的是，一旦玩家的HP歸零，現實世界中他們的肉體也將死亡。他們被SAO的開發者茅場晶彥困在遊戲中，順利逃脫的方法似乎只有一個，那就是完成困難重重的攻略任務……
anilist:108759.synopsis_en:
Kirito, Eugeo, and Alice. Six months have passed since the two disciples and an Integrity Knight brought down the pontifex, Administrator. With the fighting over, Alice has been living in her hometown of Rulid Village. Beside her is Kirito, who has not only lost his arm and soul, but also his dear friend. As Alice devotes herself to looking after Kirito, she too has lost the will to fight she once had as a knight.

Nevertheless, the time for the final stress test – one which will engulf the entire Underworld with tragedy – draws relentlessly closer.

Meanwhile, in the deepest areas of the Dark Territory, the Dark God Vecta has resurrected, as if to have waited for this very moment. Leading an army of dark forces, they begin their invasion into the human empire in hopes of attaining the Priestess of Light. The human empire force led by the Integrity Knight Bercouli prepares for a war of an unimaginable scale against the army of the Dark Territory. Even then, Alice is nowhere to be seen, nor the two heroes that saved the realm...

(Source: Official Website)
anilist:108759.source_doc_raw: 刀劍神域 Alicization War of Underworld(47)

titles.primary_zh: 異種族風俗娘評鑑指南

anilist:110270.synopsis_zh:
ここは人間だけではなく、エルフ、獣人、悪魔に天使と、あらゆる異種族が混在し、暮らしている世界。そこには當然、あらゆる異種族のスケベなお店もあるわけで…。

足しげくムフフなサービスをしてくれるお店に通う人間の冒険者・スタンクは、ある日種族間の（性的な意味での）感性の違いで悪友のエロエルフ・ゼルと衝突する。

決著の方法は……嬢のレビュー!?　あらゆる異種族娘のサービスをクロスレビュー方式で採點し、他の仲間達への“お役勃ち”情報として提供していくスタンクたちの活躍は、まさに性戦士のごとし！

今日もレビュアーズたちは新たな快楽を求めて旅勃って行く……。
anilist:110270.synopsis_en:
Beauty truly is in the eye of the beholder! From elves to succubi to cyclopes and more, the Yoruno Gloss reviewers are here to rate the red-light delights of all manner of monster girls...The only thing is, they can never agree on which species are the hottest!

(Source: Yen Press)
anilist:110270.source_doc_raw: 異種族風俗娘評鑑指南(12)

anilist:100500.synopsis_zh:
女大學生津場木葵擁有從過世的祖父那裡繼承來的、能看見妖怪的能力。
她突然被抓到了妖怪棲息的隱世的老字號旅館“天神屋”。
感到困惑的葵得知了祖父留下的龐大欠款，
以及她作為抵押必須嫁給鬼神大老闆這一約定。
無法接受的葵為了反抗婚事、起死回生，
而向妖怪們宣言她會在天神屋工作來償還欠款……。
anilist:100500.synopsis_en:
The series centers on a female college student named Aoi, who inherited the ability to see spirits from her late grandfather. Aoi prides herself on her cooking, and one day she's feeding some agricultural spirits when suddenly a god and the master of the "Tenshinya" (Heavenly Inn) appears and takes Aoi away. He says that due to her grandfather's debts, she must become his bride. Aoi hates this idea and instead declares that she will pay back her grandfather's debt by working at the Tenshinya. 

(Source: Anime News Network)

anilist:98747.synopsis_zh:
將自古以來威脅人世的異形存在·荒魂，以御刀祓除的神薙之巫女。以制服佩刀為主要裝束的她們，被稱作“刀使”。正式名稱則是隸屬警察組織的特別祭祀機動隊。她們在身為得到佩刀許可的超法規國家公務員的同時，還是在位於全國五處的中高一貫制訓練學校就讀的女學生。平常過著普通校園生活的她們，一旦身負職務，便會手持御刀，發揮種種超常之力，為守護人們而戰。
這年春天。自全國五校遴選出來的刀使們齊聚一堂，切磋各自技術的常例大賽將要舉辦。以大賽為目標的眾多刀使們為此而勤於修煉，而在她們之中，有一位懷著尤其強烈的心情磨鍊個人技術的少女。她所舉起的御刀之刃，面向的前方是——。
anilist:98747.synopsis_en:
