anilist:106625.synopsis_zh: 春季的高中排球宮城縣預選中，在一番激鬥後取勝，終於實現在全國大賽中出場這一夙願的烏野高中排球部。就在他們為全國大賽做準備的時候，傳來了影山受到全日本青年強化合宿召集的訊息。而月島也受到宮城縣一年級選拔強化合宿的召集。同為一年級，對於差距感到不安的日向，擅自前去參加宮城縣一年級選拔強化合宿，但……以全國大賽正賽為目標，日向、影山以及烏野高中排球部開始了更加艱鉅的挑戰！
anilist:106625.synopsis_en: The fourth season of Haikyuu!!The Karasuno High School Volleyball Club finally won their way into the nationals after an intense battle for the Miyagi Prefecture Spring Tournament qualifiers. As they were preparing for the nationals, Kageyama is invited to go to All-Japan Youth Training Camp. At the same time, Tsukishima is invited to go to a special rookie select training camp for first-years in Miyagi Prefecture. Hinata feels panic that he’s being left behind as one of the first-years and then decides to show up at the Miyagi Prefecture rookie select training camp anyway... (Source: Crunchyroll)

anilist:113936.synopsis_zh:
全人類被神奇的現象一瞬間石化後過了幾千年——
擁有超人般頭腦、天生的科學少年·千空甦醒了。
在文明遭到毀滅的石頭世界（STONE WORLD）裡，千空決定要用科學的力量復原整個世界。而與此同時甦醒過來的有，以有著過人體力的兒時玩伴·大木大樹為首的夥伴們，從零開始創造文明——
從石器時代到現代文明，一定要趕上這科學史的200萬年差距！
前所未聞的創世冒險譚，就此開幕！
anilist:113936.synopsis_en:
The second season of Dr. STONE

Armed with the power of science and a genius intellect, Senkuu is determined to save humanity. However, Tsukasa’s empire goes on the offensive to halt the progress of science. Bolder choices are made as these two start a war that rocks the Stone World. 
(Source: Crunchyroll)

anilist:100876.synopsis_zh:
良家子女聚集的名門學校，私立百花王學園。君臨這所被賭博所支配的學園頂點的是，支配弱者的人生、甚至對政界財界都擁有影響力的絕對支配者，學生會。然而，學生會長桃喰綺羅莉，突然宣言了學生會的解散及總選舉。
選舉的規則是一人一票。全體學生都被給予了登上學園頂點的機會。這是追求混沌與愉悅的綺羅莉一念之下帶來的選舉戰。不止如此，與此同時新的威脅也隨之而來。那就是，百喰一族——綺羅莉與夢子也位列其中的人們。蛇喰夢子以及與她有著深厚友情的鈴井涼太、早乙女芽亞里、皇伊月這4人，在這次策劃的總選舉中，即將展開賭上各自信念的戰鬥。
是在弱肉強食的學園中成為“餌食”，還是吃掉其他人成為生態系的“捕食者”。千鈞一髮的選擇會使得內心無比動搖的“究極選舉死鬥”就此開始！
anilist:100876.synopsis_en:
At Hyakkao Private Academy, Yumeko Jabami’s star rises just as the student council’s reputation starts to dim. In the shadows of the council’s dwindling power, discord reigns supreme. In a bold effort to rebalance the social scales, student council president Kirari Momobami intends to place her bet on the election for the council’s next president. Everyone starts with a single chip, and at the end of 30 days, the whoever holds the most becomes the president of the Momobami Clan. But chips aren’t the only things students can wager as they fight tooth and nail to ascend to the council presidency, and Yumeko Jabami intends to clean house no matter the prizes she must risk in the betting pool.

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)

titles.primary_zh: 關於我轉生變成史萊姆這檔事
titles.ja: 転生したらスライムだった件
titles.ja_romaji: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken 3rd Season
titles.en: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 3

anilist:156822.synopsis_zh:
史萊姆生活，開始了。
上班族的三上悟在道路上被歹徒給刺殺身亡後，回過神來發現自己轉生到了異世界。
不過，自己居然是“史萊姆”！
他在得到利姆露這個名字後開始了自己的史萊姆人生，隨著與各個種族相處交流的過程中，他定下了一個目標——那就是“建立一個任何種族都能愉快地一起生活的國家”！
anilist:156822.synopsis_en:
The third season of Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken.
Rimuru has officially become a Demon Lord after defeating Clayman. Following Walpurgis, the Demon Lords' banquet, Rimuru's domain is expanded to include the entire Great Forest of Jura. Anticipating a flood of representatives from all races showing up to pay their respects, Rimuru decides to throw a festival to commemorate the opening of Tempest, using it as an opportunity to gain new citizens and present Demon Lord Rimuru to the world. Meanwhile, in the Holy Empire of Lubelius, home base of the monster-hating cult of Luminism, Holy Knight Captain Hinata receives a message from Rimuru. But the message is actually a fabricated declaration of war sent by some unknown party. Upon learning that Hinata is heading for Tempest, Rimuru makes a decision... Thus begins a new challenge for Rimuru, striving to distinguish friend from foe in his pursuit of the ideal nation where humans and monsters can prosper together. 
(Source: Crunchyroll)
anilist:156822.source_doc_raw: 關於我轉生變成史萊姆這檔事(24)

anilist:287.synopsis_zh: 地下深くから完璧な狀態で発掘された、恐竜を捕食してきたという太古の戦士。人類の常識を覆す存在が科學の力で現代に復活し、刃牙はその驚異的な野生の力と本能に強烈に引き付けられてゆく。
anilist:287.synopsis_en: Baki Hanma is a young fighter who yearns to follow in the footsteps of his father, Yujiro, and become the strongest fighter in the world. Through that he trains tirelessly and fights constantly to hone his skills and develop his body to achieve these goals. Many intense battles lay ahead of Baki as he goes about his quest to be the best and ultimately take the title of "King" from his father.

titles.primary_zh: 七大罪 第二季 戒律的復活
zh_aliases: 七大罪 默示錄的四騎士 第二季
titles.ja: 七つの大罪 黙示録の四騎士 第2期
titles.ja_romaji: Nanatsu no Taizai: Imashime no Fukkatsu
titles.en: The Seven Deadly Sins: Revival of the Commandments

anilist:99539.synopsis_zh:
『七つの大罪』続編譚！！
「聖戦」から16年後の物語！！

“神の指”と呼ばれる辺境の地で祖父と暮らす、心優しき少年・パーシバル。
しかし、世界はその安寧を許すことはなかった。
ある謎の騎士・イロンシッドとの出會いが彼らの運命を変え、明らかになる驚愕の秘密。
少年は果て無き旅路へと足を踏み出す。
『七つの大罪』を知っていても、知らなくても楽しめる！！
全世界待望の痛快冒険ファンタジー！！
anilist:99539.synopsis_en:
Melodias, Hawk, and Elizabeth retook the Kingdom of Leones from the Holy Knights. The festival went off without a hitch and the crew enjoyed their well-earned peace. And yet, another threat looms on the horizon. The Ten Commandments, a group of elite demon clan warriors, have their sights set on the kingdom.

(Source: Anime News Network)
anilist:99539.source_doc_raw: 七大罪 第二季 戒律的復活(24)

anilist:99476.synopsis_zh: 在上一年的全國大賽中取勝的主人公·小野田坂道所屬的總北高中。組建隊伍的前輩們紛紛畢業、引退，作為新世代的隊伍開始進發的他們，在互相刺激、支援、提升的過程中，順利打入以連霸為目標的全國大賽。之後，決戰之時到來。以奪回王座為目標的對手箱根學園、擁有怪物選手御堂筋的京都伏見以及全國的強豪們齊聚一堂，以優勝為目標展開激烈交鋒！所有選手各自心懷的想法。身為直線賓士的競速選手，身為征服山路的攀登者，以及身為將隊伍導向勝利的王牌……通向各自榮譽的終點線——“GLORY LINE”，最先透過的人究竟會是誰——？
anilist:99476.synopsis_en: The fourth season of Yowamushi Pedal.

titles.ja_romaji: Shokugeki no Souma: San no Sara - Tootsuki Ressha-hen
titles.en: Food Wars! The Third Plate: Totsuki Train Arc

anilist:100773.synopsis_zh: 《食戟之靈》描述男主角幸平創真夢想在國中畢業後能夠繼承父親經營的幸平餐館，卻在父親指示下來到東京都內的料理名校遠月學園中就讀。料理技術高超的創真，卻在插班考試中被擁有神之舌的少女薙切繪里奈評為不及格!?在學園長幫助下，創真依然成功入學，並立誓要讓繪里奈認同他所作的料理。
anilist:100773.synopsis_en:
The second half of the third season of Shokugeki no Souma.

A dark age of cooking befalls Tootsuki Culinary Academy. With the Elite Ten's devastating coup d'état, Azami Nakiri is now the director of the prestigious school. Students must now conform to Azami's ideology of "true gourmet food" and are forbidden to express creativity, or else face expulsion.

However, Souma Yukihira and the members of the Polar Star Dormitory refuse to accept these changes. Aided by other rebellious first-years, including the tenth seat, Erina Nakiri, Souma and his allies band together to fight off supporters of Azami's regime. But corrupt instructors and the menacing Central organization stand in their way, and so they must work together, harder than ever before, to survive every underhanded plot designed to banish them from the school.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

titles.primary_zh: 魔法少女☆伊莉雅 第三季

anilist:20845.synopsis_zh: 在與巴澤特經歷一場惡戰之後，伊莉雅她們好不容易才回到平穩的日常當中，但就在此時，凜和露維雅卻發現了潛藏在地底的第8張職階卡片！為了回收這第8張卡片，伊莉雅她們不得不與巴澤特合作，但回收卡片的困難程度卻超出了她們的想象……
anilist:20845.synopsis_en:
The second part of Fate/kaleid liner Prisma☆Illya 2wei!.

Illyasviel von Einzbern's life has become ridiculously complicated since the Kaleidostick Ruby convinced her to become a magical girl and join the quest for collecting the seven Class Cards. Since then, almost every day has brought a new surprise, from gaining new friends and partners like Miyu Edelfelt, to encountering her own magical twin! One would think Illya deserves a little time off, right? No such luck: a trip to the beach quickly turns into a magical quest, and Illya finds herself caught in a string of magical feuds, encounters with love potions, an excursion into the world of "boys love" comics (plus the women who read them), and half a dozen other delirious diversions. However, that's only the warm-up for what might be her final mission: recovering the long-lost Eighth Card!

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)
anilist:20845.source_doc_raw: 魔法少女☆伊莉雅 第三季(10)

anilist:20467.synopsis_zh: 某天夜裡，伊莉雅被突然飛進浴室的魔法紅寶石的巧妙言辭欺騙，而變成了魔法少女。她聽從紅寶石原來的主人凜的指示，開始回收“職階卡片”。伊莉雅和作為對手的另一位魔法少女·美遊一起，在經歷了艱苦的戰鬥之後終於成功回收了7張職階卡片。伊莉雅等人也迴歸了平穩的日常。之後，在回收任務結束的幾個星期後，伊莉雅和美遊從凜等人之處收到了新的任務。讓魔力流入地脈使之安定，本應是如此簡單的任務，但卻因為出了差錯而發生了大麻煩！而這就是新的故事的開端……
anilist:20467.synopsis_en:
The second season of Fate/kaleid liner Prisma☆Illya.

With great powers come great responsibilities, and that includes cleaning up the aftermath of your previous adventures. Which means that, instead of getting a break after saving the world, newly changed magical girls Illya and Miyu have to help deal with the side-effects caused by the sealing of the Ley Cards. Still, that shouldn't be too hard, right? Wrong! Not only are the ley lines failing, but to make matters worse, Illya somehow ends up with a magical clone… and that sinister clone has plans of her own! Worse yet, since the "dark" version of herself is drawing its power from the same source as our heroine, Illya's own powers are being reduced proportionately. These are definitely not the kind of problems that the average girl should have to deal with.

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)
anilist:20467.source_doc_raw: 魔法少女☆伊莉雅 第二季(10)

anilist:109963.synopsis_zh: 《食戟之靈》描述男主角幸平創真夢想在國中畢業後能夠繼承父親經營的幸平餐館，卻在父親指示下來到東京都內的料理名校遠月學園中就讀。料理技術高超的創真，卻在插班考試中被擁有神之舌的少女薙切繪里奈評為不及格!?在學園長幫助下，創真依然成功入學，並立誓要讓繪里奈認同他所作的料理。
anilist:109963.synopsis_en:
The fourth season of Shokugeki no Souma.

The ultimate Regimental Food War continues as the culinary rebels led by Souma and the members of Kyokusei square off against epicurean elitist Azami and the Toutsuki Ten. At stake – the future of dining across Japan. Because if the rebels fail, Azami intends to impose his own tastes and techniques on the entire restaurant industry!

But the fine dining control freak has made a serious mistake in threatening the futures of Souma’s friends and family, as while the rebels may seem less experienced overall, this is ultimately a clash of skill, dedication, and, most of all, taste. That may be a recipe for disaster for the seasoned veterans!

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)

anilist:110458.synopsis_zh: 本作的故事主要圍繞追逐夢想的五名女生——宮森葵、安原繪麻、坂木靜香、藤堂美沙、今井綠展開，是一部描寫以白箱的完成為目標而奮鬥的她們，每天遇到的麻煩以及策劃工作時碰到的糾葛與挫折，還有製作組在製作作品時的團結和衝突的動畫業界的日常的群像劇作品。
anilist:110458.synopsis_en:
The war between the Kingdoms of Light and Dark has raged on since time began. But the new Prince of Darkness is destined to change that.

In the wake of a monster attack, an elderly noble confronts the lone surviving boy. Impressed, he chooses the boy to become his heir to the Throne of Darkness. Meanwhile, in the iridescent clouds above, the Queen of Light and her army are at war with the monsters. But the new Prince of Darkness realizes that Light and Dark must unite and destroy the evil if the world is to survive.

(Source: Funimation)

titles.ja: うしおととら 第2期

anilist:21241.synopsis_en:
The second season of Ushio to Tora (TV).

Long ago, a ferocious monster terrorized the land, until a samurai, wielding the legendary “Beast Spear”, sealed him away. 500 years later, a middle school student named Ushio Aotsuki accidently uncovers the monster in a hidden cellar under his family’s temple. The unsealed monster and the spear attract many other supernatural creatures to the temple and Ushio is forced to release the monster in order to defeat them. Ushio names the monster “Tora” and unwillingly work together to battle other spirits and demons.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
anilist:21241.source_doc_raw: 潮與虎 第二季(13)(完結)

anilist:189046.synopsis_zh: 從便利店回來的路上突然被召喚到異世界的少年，菜月昴。在無可依賴的異世界，無力的少年所唯一擁有的力量……那就是死後便會使時間倒轉的“死亡迴歸”的力量。為了守護重要的人，並取回那些無可替代的時間，少年向絕望抗爭，挺身面對殘酷的命運。
anilist:189046.synopsis_en:
The fourth season of Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu.

To save his stricken allies, Subaru faces a deadly desert to find the Sage at Pleiades Watchtower.

titles.ja: ダンガンロンパ 希望の学園と絶望の高校生 THE ANIMATION
titles.ja_romaji: Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha EXCEEDS Gun Blaze Vengeance

anilist:185875.synopsis_zh: 故事以「私立希望之峰學園」作為舞臺，該學校的入學要求有兩個：1.必須是現役高中生。2.必須在其獨特的領域具有超一流的水平。由政府公認辦學，可以說能夠從這間學校畢業的話人生幾乎是等同於成功了。而主人公苗木誠和有著各式各樣不同風格與擅長領域的14名超高校級學生一起參加入學典禮的時候，卻看到一個自稱是學園長的活動布偶熊表示：「一旦進來，就必須要一輩子都待在這裡才行。如果想要畢業離開的話，只要互相殘殺就好了！」就這樣，因為這個不合理的理由，這群被關在這個絕望學園的高材生們，陷入除了殺人之外就是被殺的陰謀當中，加上破壞學生之間信賴關係的卑劣「學級裁判」制度，更讓整個真相陷入撲朔迷離當中……
anilist:185875.synopsis_en:
Thirty years ago, the world was nearly destroyed by the sudden appearance of unknown "invasive alien species."

Humans and these “invasive species” continue to vie for living space, and while humanity’s safety is currently barely secured, the world could be destroyed at any moment. Living in fear of death and destruction, people go about their daily lives as if trying to avert their eyes from danger and disaster.

In this world, the United Nations Hazardous Species Investigation Agency, "EXCEEDS," has begun operations to ward off crises and disasters caused by invasive species.

The story begins on the island nation of "Mizuho" in the Far East. Shina Hisase is a young invasive species extermination hunter living on a remote island. What incident will befall Shina, who wishes only to live quietly with her younger sister Setsuna, her sole remaining family member?

Note: The first episode aired with a runtime of ~60 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.
anilist:185875.source_doc_raw: 槍彈辯駁3 未來篇(12)(完結)

anilist:171513.synopsis_zh:
海崎新太（27歲）在作為新畢業生進入的公司工作了3個月就辭職了。
之後他的就職活動也不順利。
雙親寄來的生活費也中斷了，不得已只好回到鄉下。
能夠傾聽他煩惱的朋友和女友全都沒有……
窮途末路的海崎面前出現了一位神秘人物·夜明瞭。
夜明向海崎提出，要他參加以尼特為物件的社會復歸程式“ReLIFE”。
其內容是，利用神秘的秘藥，僅僅讓外表回覆年輕，並在一年內以高中生的身份去讀高中——。
anilist:171513.synopsis_en:
Yamai Zenjirou is your everyday office worker in modern Japan. One morning, he suddenly finds himself summoned to a tropical world where dinosaurs roam the land. He is told that this is the kingdom of Capua and the person who summoned him - its monarch, Queen Aura - wants him to marry her and leave his old life behind for a life of carefree extravagance as her prince consort. The reasons for her offer are many and varied, but she needs an heir, and she wants him to be the one to provide it! If he accepts, he'll never have to work again, lazing around in luxury with no worries other than securing the kingdom its next monarch. Certainly, sleeping with the buxom beauty is far from a hardship, but is everything really as it seems? He'll also need to give up everything he knows on Earth. Is he ready to drop it all at a moment's notice for her sake? And how well will he be able to navigate the politics, people and culture of this new world if he does?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

anilist:569.synopsis_zh: 由於聯合軍的陰謀，先帝戈薩十五世陛下駕崩，年少繼位的阿薩琳十六世在大臣的極力推動下，發動了對聯合宇宙軍的全面戰爭。與此同時，聯合宇宙軍也在全力備戰，招募士兵。在誘人的美女徵兵廣告前，傑斯迪·植木·泰勒動心了，於是他來到徵兵處，面對入伍動機詢問，他給出了以下經典回答：軍隊這種地方，吃飯不要錢，制服和生活日常用品全部都……不要錢！又不用擔心房租，要取得各種執照也輕易，再加上搭乘宇宙戰艦的話，到達敵方以前整天可以在冷氣密封倉裡睡覺，同時可以坐著做工作，沒有比這更輕鬆的行業啦！不是嗎？同時呀閣下！退役後又有退休年金可以過悠閒的生活，這實在令人嚮往呀！如此回答，基本上沒人會讓這種人加入軍隊的，然後，泰勒的演講開始了！
anilist:569.synopsis_en:
Justy Ueki Tylor had his life all planned out: join the military, get a cushy desk job, and then retire with a big fat pension check. The perfect plan... until he wandered into a hostage situation and somehow managed to save an admiral! Now Tylor - a man who wouldn't know what discipline was if it bit him on the backside - has been made Captain of the space cruiser Soyokaze.
The crew of this run-down ship is the craziest rag-tag team of misfits you're ever likely to see, and they're not too fond of their complacent new leader. But they'd better learn to work together, because they're about to go head to head with the mighty Raalgon Empire. For better or for worse, the Earth's fate has been placed in the hands of a man who's either a total idiot - or an absolute genius!
(Source: RightStuf)
anilist:569.source_doc_raw: 無彩限的幻影世界OVA(01)(14)(完結)

anilist:114043.synopsis_zh: 《食戟之靈》描述男主角幸平創真夢想在國中畢業後能夠繼承父親經營的幸平餐館，卻在父親指示下來到東京都內的料理名校遠月學園中就讀。料理技術高超的創真，卻在插班考試中被擁有神之舌的少女薙切繪里奈評為不及格!?在學園長幫助下，創真依然成功入學，並立誓要讓繪里奈認同他所作的料理。
anilist:114043.synopsis_en:
The fifth and the final season of Shokugeki no Souma.Yukihira Souma has been helping out his family diner, honing his skills. With his father's recommendation, he decides to enroll into "Totsuki Saryo Culinary Institute", a school for the most elites of the culinary world. During his time there, he has grown so much as a chef through studying hard with friends and competing against rivals in shokugeki battles.

Souma has now moved up a grade and he has finally grasped what he has always hoped for; the first seat at the Totsuki Ten Masters Council.

In the meantime, an invitation to a world-class cooking competition known as "BLUE" arrives to Totsuki. "BLUE" is one of the most authentic gastronomic tournaments for young chefs seeking fame. However, there's been a change to this year's system and themes are all out of ordinary!(Source: Official Website)
anilist:114043.source_doc_raw: 食戟之靈 第二季(13)(完結)

anilist:21128.synopsis_zh: 在此岸與彼岸的交界處，八百萬神明和服侍他們的死靈——神器，以及被稱為妖的魑魅魍魎一同生活著。某天，普通的女初中生一岐日和意外遇到了居無定所、沒有工作、自稱是“神”的青年夜鬥。其實此話不假，夜鬥是個沒有神社供奉、缺少香火的落魄神明，因為性格缺陷，導致手下的神器紛紛跳槽。懷抱“受萬民景仰”這個偉大願望的他，只好隻身在此岸與彼岸間徘徊，為五元（日語中“五元”與“有緣”同音）的香油錢折腰，接受上至斬妖除魔，下至修東修西的各類委託。然而像這樣一個粗心大意、性情不定，而且不能很好地聽人祈願、沒有人知道的神明卻有一個能力，那就是將此岸與彼岸以及其夾縫——世上各種雜七雜八的東西斬斷。
anilist:21128.synopsis_en:
The second season of Noragami.

Life for minor god Yato isn't getting any easier. He's still broke, shrineless, and his partner-slash-sword-regalia has zero respect for him. Worse yet, Bishamon, one of the deadliest war gods, is after his life. Blaming him for the death of her past regalia, she won't stop until she kills him. But there's more to that story than she could ever realize. And as if that's not bad enough, there's someone working against her behind the scenes! Can Yato take on a god as powerful as Bishamon? Or will things take a more dangerous turn?

Between all of this godly drama and even more dangerous battles, Yato still needs to figure out how to help Hiyori. But all options lead to losing her, and he's not willing to make that choice – no matter what.

Five yen doesn't even begin to cover his trouble!

(Source: Funimation)
anilist:21128.source_doc_raw: 流浪神差ARAGOTO 第二季(13)(完結

titles.ja_romaji: Ao no Exorcist: Yuki no Hate-hen

anilist:176311.synopsis_zh: 青之驅魔師所寫的世界由兩個空間組成，並像鏡般連為一體。人類居住的物質界為本作舞臺，另外還有惡魔居住的虛無界。平常基本上無法接觸或穿梭於兩界之間。可是惡魔能憑依於相當的物質從而進入人類的世界。撒旦乃眾魔之神，為了從人間撿回一個能抑制他的箱子，而誕下了奧村磷——他跟一人界女子的兒子。可是撒旦的密謀未能得到到磷的認同。及後撒旦更殺掉了磷的監護人養父，並要帶磷返去虛無界。這使磷開始了驅魔師之旅，就為了打敗他的生父撒旦。
anilist:176311.synopsis_en:
Sequel to Ao no Exorcist: Shimane Illuminati-hen. 

Uncover the dark side of the Knights of the True Cross and the mystery of the "Blue Night"!

Brothers Rin and Yukio head to Lake Towada in Aomori to search for Shura, who had suddenly disappeared. There, they find Shura’s birthplace – the place where Shiro became her guardian. As their search continues, Rin and Yukio discover the fate that awaits Shura.

Meanwhile, Lightning, one of the Arch Knights, arrives at the Japan Branch of the Knights of the True Cross and begins his investigation into the Illuminati. Lightning deduces that everything began on the “Blue Night,” as he gradually steps into the dark side of the Knights of the True Cross….

(Source: Aniplex USA)
anilist:176311.source_doc_raw: 青之驅魔師-劇場版(完結)

titles.primary_zh: 青之驅魔師 第二季

anilist:185880.synopsis_zh: 青之驅魔師所寫的世界由兩個空間組成，並像鏡般連為一體。人類居住的物質界為本作舞臺，另外還有惡魔居住的虛無界。平常基本上無法接觸或穿梭於兩界之間。可是惡魔能憑依於相當的物質從而進入人類的世界。撒旦乃眾魔之神，為了從人間撿回一個能抑制他的箱子，而誕下了奧村磷——他跟一人界女子的兒子。可是撒旦的密謀未能得到到磷的認同。及後撒旦更殺掉了磷的監護人養父，並要帶磷返去虛無界。這使磷開始了驅魔師之旅，就為了打敗他的生父撒旦。
anilist:185880.synopsis_en:
Sequel to Ao no Exorcist: Yuki no Hate-hen. 

Yukio parts ways with Rin and makes his way to the Illuminati. In order to face Yukio, who is seeking strength and the truth, Rin decides that he must learn the secret of their birth.
With Mephisto’s guidance, he embarks on a journey to the past.

Rin traces the footsteps of their adoptive father, Shirou Fujimoto, and birth mother, Yuri Egin.
But the path they took in life was harsher than Rin could have ever imagined….

Why were children born between the Demon God Satan and a human? What was the Blue Night? And when Rin learns everything, what will be his answer?

(Source: Official Site)
anilist:185880.source_doc_raw: 青之驅魔師 第二季(12)(完結)

titles.primary_zh: 無頭騎士異聞錄 DuRaRaRa!! 轉

anilist:20880.synopsis_zh:
東京，池袋。
嚮往都市生活的少年龍之峰帝人接受從小一起玩到大的好友紀田正臣邀約離開家鄉來到東京進入池袋來良學園上學。
而在池袋有幾個絕對不能招惹的人物，尤其是被譽為“最強”的平和島靜雄和經營情報屋的折原臨也這兩個人。另外，池袋有一個正體不明的暴力組織，名叫“Dollars”。
然而，就在上京的第一天，因為對池袋複雜的關係而感到不安的帝人就親眼目睹了騎著黑色摩托在街頭穿行的都市傳說“無頭騎士”——塞爾提·史特路爾森。
於是，隨著池袋接連發生了砍人魔事件，平和島靜雄、折原臨也、Dollars、無頭騎士、砍人魔、黃巾賊等陸續浮出水面，圍繞著“誰是池袋最強”的話題，池袋正面臨著崩壞中，一連串不正常但爽直的故事開始了。
anilist:20880.synopsis_en:
The third part of Durarara!!x2

As Mikado Ryuugamine continues to purge the Dollars from within in accordance with his warped sense of justice, Masaomi Kida hopes to bring his friend back to his senses by bringing the Yellow Scarves together once more. Little do they know that a far more dominant force is about to enter their struggle for power, one that their friend Anri Sonohara is all too familiar with.

Meanwhile, the group that has gathered at Shinra Kishitani's apartment realizes that they are on the brink of something life-changing, an event that will throw Ikebukuro into a spiral of confusion. Their anxiety is realized when reports of Celty's head being found in public start to appear all over the news as Kasane Kujiragi begins to make her move.

Gone are the brief periods of tranquility as the current turmoil sets the stage for one final performance in this thrilling conclusion to the story of Ikebukuro's finest.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)
anilist:20880.source_doc_raw: 無頭騎士異聞錄 DuRaRaRa!! 轉(12)(完結)

東京，池袋。
嚮往都市生活的少年龍之峰帝人接受從小一起玩到大的好友紀田正臣邀約離開家鄉來到東京進入池袋來良學園上學。
而在池袋有幾個絕對不能招惹的人物，尤其是被譽為“最強”的平和島靜雄和經營情報屋的折原臨也這兩個人。另外，池袋有一個正體不明的暴力組織，名叫“Dollars”。
然而，就在上京的第一天，因為對池袋複雜的關係而感到不安的帝人就親眼目睹了騎著黑色摩托在街頭穿行的都市傳說“無頭騎士”——塞爾提·史特路爾森。
於是，隨著池袋接連發生了砍人魔事件，平和島靜雄、折原臨也、Dollars、無頭騎士、砍人魔、黃巾賊等陸續浮出水面，圍繞著“誰是池袋最強”的話題，池袋正面臨著崩壞中，一連串不正常但爽直的故事開始了。
anilist:20652.synopsis_en:
“6 Months Later…We haven’t changed at all… or it seems….” Half a year after the turmoil that rocked the entire city of Ikebukuro— Peace has once again returned to the city and people are living each day normally. The high school students enjoy their days of youth as the strongest and most dangerous man of Ikebukuro works diligently. The informant plots a new scheme and the headless rider is pursued by the cops as she rides through the night…But soon this normal will be cut short by the abnormal. Slowly but surely, the unknown will seize the city and face an all new storm.

(Source: Aniplex)
anilist:20652.source_doc_raw: 無頭騎士異聞錄×2 承(12)(完結)

anilist:20705.synopsis_zh: 故事主要發生在虛構的大陸『布里塔利亞』上的國家『里昂妮絲王國』，王國的聖騎士們為了準備傳說中的聖戰而進行軍備強化，然而聖騎士團的諸多暴行使得整個國家民不聊生，甚至發動政變囚禁了國王。擔憂著國家現狀的第三王女『伊麗莎白』，將救國的希望寄託於十年前因涉嫌顛覆王國而被通緝的騎士團『七大罪』從而獨自踏上尋找的旅程。註定無果的旅程中，疲憊不堪的伊麗莎白誤入某個酒店，被酒店的主人、一名金髮少年救下，這名少年正是『七大罪』的團長梅利奧達斯。在將公主從追兵的危機中解救出來後，他們踏上了拯救國家未來的旅途
anilist:20705.synopsis_en:
In the story, the prideful archangel Lucifer disobeys God and is cast into the lowest level of hell as a fallen angel. On her way to hell, Lucifer happens to meet a high school girl on Earth named Maria, who helps her. In hell, Lucifer meets Leviathan, and Leviathan explains to Lucifer about The Seven Deadly Sins, the seven demon king rulers of hell. After The Seven Deadly Sins seal Lucifer's powers, Lucifer goes on a journey with Maria and Leviathan to defeat them.

(Source: Official Website)

titles.ja_romaji: Nanatsu no Taizai: Funnu no Shinpan
titles.en: The Seven Deadly Sins: Dragon's Judgement

anilist:116752.synopsis_zh: 故事主要發生在虛構的大陸『布里塔利亞』上的國家『里昂妮絲王國』，王國的聖騎士們為了準備傳說中的聖戰而進行軍備強化，然而聖騎士團的諸多暴行使得整個國家民不聊生，甚至發動政變囚禁了國王。擔憂著國家現狀的第三王女『伊麗莎白』，將救國的希望寄託於十年前因涉嫌顛覆王國而被通緝的騎士團『七大罪』從而獨自踏上尋找的旅程。註定無果的旅程中，疲憊不堪的伊麗莎白誤入某個酒店，被酒店的主人、一名金髮少年救下，這名少年正是『七大罪』的團長梅利奧達斯。在將公主從追兵的危機中解救出來後，他們踏上了拯救國家未來的旅途
anilist:116752.synopsis_en:
Time is running out. The curse imposed on Elizabeth will kill her in few days. To lift the curse Meliodas and Ban have travelled to the Demon Realm to challenge Meliodas' father, the Demon King.

Meanwhile, Merlin, Escanor, and Archangel Ludociel are set to slay Meliodas' brother Zeldris. Elsewhere, Meliodas' other brother Estarossa has kidnapped Elizabeth, and it falls to King, Diane, Gowther, and Hawk to rescue her.

anilist:21300.synopsis_zh: 為了使火星變得適合人類居住，21世紀中期有兩種生物被人類實驗性的放到了火星，其中之一就是改良“疊層岩”後得到的藻類，另外一種是以藻類為食並且有很強繁殖能力的昆蟲——蟑螂。被人類疏遠、厭惡、殺害的那種昆蟲，他們現在對人類展開了反擊！！
anilist:21300.synopsis_en:
The second season of Terra Formars.

In Terra Formars Revenge, the crew members of the Annex I continue to fight against Terraformars—the large humanoid cockroaches that evolved from the ones sent to Mars centuries ago. However, far from discovering the cure for the lethal Alien Engine Virus that has been plaguing Earth, the Annex I team have learned that some squadrons have agendas from their own countries. Now, the squadrons must not only fight against the Terraformars for their survival, but also each other in the never-ending battle for international dominance.

titles.ja: 干物妹! うまるちゃん

anilist:20987.synopsis_zh:
我的妹妹小埋16歲，完美的妹妹，完美的高中生，但在家裡卻是個超懶的幹物妹。
然而妹妹在家的一切她生活中的朋友並不知道，居住在同一棟樓的天然少女，以及無意間來到我家的冷酷少女，她們會發現小埋的真實面目嗎？
anilist:20987.synopsis_en:
Umaru is a renowned beautiful 16-year-old girl, living with her elder brother Taihei. She's a perfect little sister: Popular, smart, kind-hearted, everybody admires her. So who would believe Umaru keeps a certain secret? Sleeping, gaming, watching TV, eating junk food, drinking cola… that's almost all she does at home, leaving all the housework to her brother.

(Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

titles.ja: 東京喰種トーキョーグール √A

anilist:100240.synopsis_zh:
「 悲劇、2周目。｣

人間の死肉を喰らう怪人“喰種”が潛む街――東京。
大學生のカネキは、ある事故がきっかけで“喰種”の內臓を移植され、半“喰種”となる。

人を喰らわば生きていけない、だが喰べたくはない。
人間と“喰種”の狹間で、もがき苦しむカネキ。
どちらの世界にも「居場所」が無い、
そんな彼を受け入れたのは“喰種”芳村が経営する吃茶店「あんていく」だった。
そしてカネキは自らが“喰種”と人間、
ふたつの世界に「居場所」を持てる唯一人の存在であると知る。
互いが歪めた世界を正すため、
カネキは“喰種”と人間の想いが交錯する迷宮へと立ち入るが…。

――僕は“喰種”だ――

全てを守れる「強さ」を欲したカネキが取った究極の選択は、
自らの人間的な部分を葬り“喰種”として生きることだった。
走り出してしまった決意。暴走する優しさ。
「強さ」の果てに、カネキが見たものとは…？

原作者・石田スイが紡ぎ出す、もうひとつの「東京喰種」が幕を開ける。
anilist:100240.synopsis_en:
Two years have passed since the CCG’s raid on Anteiku. Although the atmosphere in Tokyo has changed drastically due to the increased influence of the CCG, ghouls continue to pose a problem as they have begun taking caution, especially the terrorist organization Aogiri Tree, who acknowledge the CCG’s growing threat to their existence.
The creation of a special team, known as the Quinx Squad, may provide the CCG with the push they need to exterminate Tokyo’s unwanted residents. As humans who have undergone surgery in order to make use of the special abilities of ghouls, they participate in operations to eradicate the dangerous creatures. The leader of this group, Haise Sasaki, is a half-ghoul, half-human who has been trained by famed special class investigator, Kishou Arima. However, there’s more to this young man than meets the eye, as unknown memories claw at his mind, slowly reminding him of the person he used to be.

anilist:21407.synopsis_zh: 本作的主角是千葉縣立總北高中的新生小野田坂道，他是一名熱愛動畫、遊戲和秋葉原的御宅族。這樣的他由於在初中時代沒有遇到擁有相同喜好的同學，所以他打算在進入高中以後一定要加入動漫畫研究部。只不過，想加入的社團卻因為成員不足而活動休止了。面對如此狀況，小野田坂道開始意氣消沉了。另一方面，同樣也是新生、初中時代活躍於各大腳踏車比賽的今泉俊輔，某日在訓練的時候見到小野田坂道騎著腳踏車爬上陡坡的過程，故事由此正式展開。
anilist:21407.synopsis_en:
After defeating the formidable opponent Hakone Gakuen in the national tournament "Inter-High," senior members of Sohoku High -- Kinjo, Makishima, and Tadokoro -- are about to retire, and the team reorganizes with first-year members (Onoda, Imaizumi, and Naruko) under the leadership of Teshima as team captain and Aoyagi as vice captain. Meanwhile, Hakone Gakuen is reorganizing and recruiting as well in order to retake the championship, while Kyoto Fushimi High is now led by "monster racer" Midousuji.

(Source: Anime News Network)
anilist:21407.source_doc_raw: 飆速宅男 第三季(25)(完結)

anilist:20723.synopsis_en:
The second season will focus on Inter High bicycle race continuing from the first season of the series! High school students pushing themselves to the limit as they bet everything on their bicycles!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

anilist:20876.synopsis_en: The relationship antics continue as Chitoge starts to realize that she is actually in love with Raku. Kosaki's younger sister Haru, who wants to protect her sister from the supposedly-depraved Raku, gets added to the mix. Other highlights include the introductions of Hana (Chitoge's mother) and Paula McCoy (Seishiro's assassin rival) and Kosaki's brief stint as a magical girl.(Source: Anime News Network)

anilist:19613.synopsis_zh: 故事的主人公藤原拓海是個普通的高中男生，擁有無與倫比的飛車天賦。從中一開始，每天早上駕駛那輛AE86在秋名山上飛馳，練成了華麗(注意：是華麗)的駕駛技術。必須注意，他的車技之所以高明，是有賴於每天凌晨必須將父親做的豆腐送到秋名山山頂的飯店。無論颳風、下雨、下雪，五年間車技竟然突飛猛進。黑白顏色的AE86是一輛只有130匹馬力的日本“國寶級”舊款跑車，但憑著藤原拓海超凡的技術和天分，先後擊敗同樣是天才少年Red Sun車隊的高橋啟介；駕駛令人望而生畏的黑色R32的中裡毅；採用死亡膠布賽(用膠布粘綁住右手，使方向盤無法扭到空手時的最大限度)戰勝了NightKids的第二把交椅；更在秋名山的山道中擊敗Red Sun第一把交椅，駕駛著代表高貴的FC3S的高橋涼介。當然，拓海的成長不止這些，“他的技術就像藝術一樣”，我們最熟悉的就是AE86那華麗的甩尾(汽車用語。指車疾速行駛時疾速拐彎，車輪橫向滑動的狀態。)以及排水道跑法。秋名山下坡最快的AE86神話正式開始。
anilist:19613.synopsis_en: After defeating every racing team in the prefecture, everything comes down to one last race. Takumi Fujiwara has never lost a race, but when his opponent is also using an AE86, it turns into a battle of the AE86. Will Project D succeed in the final and most difficult race of Initial D?

anilist:15059.synopsis_en: Taking place in the sacred land of street running Kanagawa, once more Takumi Fujiwara will show his driving skills on his now legendary Hachi-roku.

titles.ja: 未ル わたしのみらい

anilist:166373.synopsis_zh:
人と自然の対峙と調和
遠い先の未來に人類によって作られたロボット「MIRU」。武器を持たず、時空を超えタイムリープし、様々な時代に訪れる。
時代も場所もパラレルな世界でありながら、どの時代にもいる、必死に生きている人達に出會い、その人々の悩み、苦しみに寄り添い、新たな人生への一歩を後押しする。
人類は「MIRU」と出會う事で、希望に向かって歩き始める。
なぜそのロボットは作られたのか、ディストピアに向かう地球の未來を救えるのか？
「MIRU」そのものも完璧ではなく、人との出會いによって悩み、學んでいく。
人類は新たな友「MIRU」を得て明るい未來への一歩を踏み出していく、歩幅の小さい一歩だが、その一歩が 「バタフライエフェクト※」のように大きな変化を生み、再生に向けた一歩になっていく。
「未來は自分たちの手でつくれる」そんな思いを込めたアニメです。
anilist:166373.synopsis_en:
"未ル(Miru): Paths To My Future", an anthology anime series by five animation studios.

A Story of Encounters between Humanity and a Robot.

Born in a distant future, MIRU, a weaponless robot, travels across time to support people from different eras.
MIRU meets individuals from different times and places, people who, despite their struggles, live their lives with determination.

Through their encounters with MIRU, people take small yet meaningful steps forward. These steps, like the "Butterfly Effect," create waves of change, moving toward a brighter future.

"The future is in our hands."

A story that reminds us of the power in every small beginning.

(Source: It's Anime powered by REMOW)
Contains:
1) Episode 079:「スターダストメモリー」 "Stardust Memory"
2) Episode 101: 「The King of the Forest」
3) Episode 217: 「この世の波風さわぎ」"Londonderry Air"
4) Episode 630: 「Re: MIRU」
5) Episode 926: 「待ってて、今行く」 "Wait, I'll Be There"

titles.ja: 逆境無頼カイジ Ultimate Survivor

anilist:10271.synopsis_zh:
故事從一艘黑夜中的賭船開始……
　　男主角伊藤開司，渾渾噩噩，一事無成，因為好心替人做了擔保而揹負上了數百萬債務。為償還欠款，開司接受慫恿上了一艘名為“希望之船”的渡輪，為的是參加一次神秘賭局——一旦獲勝，就能將欠款一筆勾銷。登上渡船後開司才發現，參與者多是如自己一般的失敗青年。然後主辦方便開出了賭局的規則：參與者須以標著“石頭，剪刀，布”的撲克為道具，奪取對手身上的星星標誌，賭局結束時，撲克牌未用完或星星少於三顆者將失去資格，而參賽初所能向主辦方借貸的鉅款，也成為讓他們盈利或逃生的重要因素……
　　絕境下，開司極限究竟何在？！

　　動畫版相當於原作第一部的內容。主要聲優和STAFF中許多人曾參與了原作者的另一部作品《闘牌伝説アカギ》的動畫版製作。
　　雖然作品中的過激言行被放送局自主規制而壓抑了作品的演出，但福本作品中非常有特點的表現手法如「ざわ…」等都由BGM和背景圖以及效果音予以了出色的演出。動畫最後設有「カイジ箴言」一欄目，出演者為阪本麻美。
anilist:10271.synopsis_en:
Several months after the events of the first season, Kaiji, with his appendages reattached and his debt now run up to 9.5 million yen, is still desperately seeking the elusive big score that will cancel all of his markers. Unbeknownst to him, Hyodo’s company, the Teiai Corporation, is actively searching for Kaiji, and have sent Kaiji’s old “friend” Endoh, who entered him in the high stakes games in the past, to find him. 
The two meet when Kaiji chances to walk in front of Endoh’s car at a stop light, and thinking that he has found the answer to his prayers, Kaiji gets in the car with him. While Kaiji and Endoh are “happy” to see one another, and both want to see Kaiji’s debt repaid, their means to that goal couldn’t be more different.
Instead of leading Kaiji to the big score, Endoh delivers him drugged and docile to the Teiai Corporation’s secret underground labor camp where Kaiji will have an opportunity to repay his debt… with 15 years of hard labor. 
(Source: Sea Slugs)

titles.ja_romaji: Shingeki no Kyojin: The Final Season

anilist:110277.synopsis_zh: 悠長的歷史之中,人類曾一度因被巨人捕食而崩潰。倖存下來的人們建造了一面巨大的牆壁,防止了巨人的入侵。不過,作為“和平”的代價,人類失去了到牆壁的外面去這一“自由”。主人公艾倫·耶格爾對還沒見過的外面的世界抱有興趣。在他正做著到牆壁的外面去這個夢的時候,毀壞牆壁的大巨人出現了！
anilist:110277.synopsis_en:
It’s been four years since the Scout Regiment reached the shoreline, and the world looks different now. Things are heating up as the fate of the Scout Regiment—and the people of Paradis—are determined at last. However, Eren is missing. Will he reappear before age-old tensions between Marleyans and Eldians result in the war of all wars?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

anilist:20958.synopsis_en:
Eren Jaeger swore to wipe out every last Titan, but in a battle for his life he wound up becoming the thing he hates most. With his new powers, he fights for humanity's freedom facing the monsters that threaten his home. After a bittersweet victory against the Female Titan, Eren finds no time to rest—a horde of Titans is approaching Wall Rose and the battle for humanity continues!

(Source: Funimation)

anilist:20614.synopsis_zh: 小學時期，四位隸屬游泳學會的成員於畢業前的大會奪得冠軍，留下難忘的回憶後分道揚鑣。時移世逆，於高中生活變得黯然無光的一位成員七瀨遙，於某天突然遇上昔日的戰友松岡凜。遙一邊懷舊的同時向凜提出挑戰，結果被對方壓倒性擊倒。以此為契機，遙決定跟目前同校的橘真琴和葉月渚重新集結，加上新成員龍崎憐，成立巖鳶高中的首個游泳部。充滿躍動感的男子高中生，帶著份外矚目的上半身，展開了這個關於游泳、青春與羈絆的故事……
anilist:20614.synopsis_en:
Even though it has been a year since the Iwatobi High School Swim Club has been created, new members have yet to join the club. Now that Haruka Nanase and Makoto Tachibana are senior students, along with their younger friends Nagisa Hazuki and Rei Ryuugazaki, they have to find a way to attract new members. If not, the club will be forced to close the following year due to a lack of membership.

Meanwhile, with impending graduation, it is also time for the seniors to decide their plans for the future. Unlike their friend Rin Matsuoka, the new captain of Samezuka Academy Swim Club who is determined to fulfill his dream of being a professional swimmer, Haruka and Makoto are unsure about what career path they want to take.

Further problems arise when an old friend of Rin's, Sousuke Yamazaki, comes to the city to study at Samezuka Academy; the recently scouted swimmer's arrival causes tension in the relationship among him, Rin, and Haruka.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
anilist:20614.source_doc_raw: Free男子游泳社-第二季(13)(完結)

titles.primary_zh: 果然我的青春戀愛喜劇搞錯了。續
zh_aliases: 我的青春戀愛物語果然有問題 續
titles.ja: やはり俺の青春ラブコメはまちがっている。続
titles.ja_romaji: Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Come wa Machigatteiru. Zoku
titles.en: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU TOO!

anilist:20698.synopsis_zh:
因過去的心理陰影而以獨自的彆扭思考迴路謳歌著“獨自生活”的比企谷八幡，由於意外的事件而被生活指導擔當教師平冢靜帶去“侍奉部”並加入其中。他和同社團所屬的令人窒息的完美美少女·雪之下雪乃，以及班級上位階級所屬的時髦女子·由比濱結衣一同，從解決班上的人際關係問題到文化祭實行委員的運營，度過著解決各種案件的每一天。
時至秋日，八幡等二年級學生前去修學旅行。此時，侍奉部接收到了一個委託。
隨著新登場的一色彩羽的加入，他們的關係更加錯綜複雜。
——八幡空虛的價值觀也有了少許變化，在這些經驗過後，他的高中生活又將迎來新的展開。
anilist:20698.synopsis_en:
The second season of Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Come wa Machigatteiru.

Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Comedy wa Machigatteiru. Zoku picks up immediately after the events of the first season, continuing the adventures of the Volunteer Service Club—the dispassionate Hachiman Hikigaya, the cheerful Yui Yuigahama, and the competitive Yukino Yukinoshita—as it dedicates itself to helping any student with issues that they may face.

With the rift among his own group widening, Hachiman begins to realize that his knack for quickly getting to the root of other people's troubles is a double-edged sword: sometimes the best solution is not necessarily the most appropriate one.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)
anilist:20698.source_doc_raw: 果然我的青春戀愛喜劇搞錯了。續(13)(完結)

anilist:6773.synopsis_zh:
新學期剛開始，高中生·坂井悠二一如往常過著“日常生活”。然而有一天，他冷不防遭遇紅世之王手下的侵襲。受到一名能夠把人的存在化為靈火，並吸取靈火的神秘男子法利亞格尼的攻擊。悠二的“日常”生活因此整個脫節，然而就在同一時間，一名少女出現在他面前。少女為了保護悠二不被法利亞格尼襲擊，開始與悠二一同生活。悠二滿懷感激向少女道謝，不料少女卻如此低喃：“你已經不存在了。”我已經死了？存在喪失者·悠二為何還能夠思考呢……



[簡介原文]
ら渡り來た彼ら“徒”は、人がこの世に存在するための根源の力、“存在の力”を奪うことで自身を顕現させ、在り得ない不思議を起こす。思いの儘に、力の許す限り、滅びのときまで。 彼らに“存在の力”を喰われた人間は、いなかったことになる。 これから伸び、繋がり、広がるはずだったものを欠落させた世界の在り様は、歪んだ。“徒”の自由自在な跳梁（ちょうりょう）に伴い、その歪みは加速度的に大きくなっていった。 やがて、強大な力を持つ“徒”たる“紅世の王”らの中に、そんな狀況への危懼を抱く者が現れ始めた。大きな歪みがいずれ、この世と“紅世”雙方に大災厄を齎（もたら）すのではないか、と。 そして、一部の“紅世の王”らは同胞を狩るという苦渋の決斷を下した。 彼らの尖兵、あるいは武器となったのは、“徒”への復讐を願い誓った人間──己が全存在を“王”の器として捧げ、異能の力を得た人間──討滅者“フレイムヘイズ”。 その日、日常を浸食した“徒”により全てを失い、自身がトーチという仮初めの存在であると知らされた少年と、「贄殿遮那のフレイムヘイズ」と呼ばれる少女が出會った。 これは、“ミステス”坂井悠二と『炎髪灼眼の討ち手』シャナの物語である。
anilist:6773.synopsis_en:
Continuing from the events of the last series (Shakugan no Shana II), both Shana and Kazumi stand at their respective locations waiting for Yuji to meet with one of them, only to discover that Yuji has disappeared, with not even the slightest evidence of his existence left behind. All is not lost however, as the letters the two of them sent to him still give hope of Yuji's continued existence. As Shana and company search for answers on Yuji's whereabouts, they soon find the truth staring back at them when Yuji reappears in front of them as the leader of Bal Masqué. Left with little choice, Shana must now confront her most unlikely adversary on the battlefield in her toughest challenge yet.

(Source: Anime News Network)

anilist:2787.synopsis_zh:
夏天結束後，新學期開始了。
許多事物沒有任何變化，但是同時也有不少事情逐漸發展著。
池和吉田，緒方和田中之間產生了些許微妙的關係。
還有在我身旁，飄逸著長髮的夏娜。
但是，這一切似乎有著一絲奇怪的違何感。
在我們所不知道的地方，紅世之徒再次展開了行動……



[簡介原文]
バル・マスケとの戦いを終え、平和を取り戻した御崎市。
シャナと悠二は町にとどまり、穏やかな日々を過ごす。
だが、悠二を、寶具「零時迷子」を狙い新たな“徒”が現れる……。
anilist:2787.synopsis_en:
The heated bond between Shana and Yuji is tested as their paranormal adventures continues. The Flame Haze fends off supernatural foes by night. By day, she contends with a classmate who's also after Yuji's heart. Emotions flare as a suspicious transfer student who resembles a recently defeated Denizen clings to Yuji. His training rises in intensity when they catch wind of a revered warrior in search of her lost lover—who will stop at nothing to extract the power keeping Yuji alive! 
(Source: FUNimation)

anilist:20991.synopsis_zh:
警察無法完全應對的世界規模治安危機，導致了一種新職業——武偵的出現。武偵，即在法律框架內(不排除少數例外)，解決個人或組織的委託，彌補警察的不足，維護社會和平的武裝偵探。而本故事，就發生在那樣一個時代的武偵培養學園——東京武偵高。
　　一直嚮往普通人的平靜生活，期望儘快從東京武偵高轉走的少年——遠山金次，有個自初中(神奈川武偵高附屬中學)畢業後一直隱藏的秘密。然而，渴望平靜的他，卻在一場駭人的腳踏車劫持事件中，邂逅了自此將改變他人生軌跡的人物——神崎·H·亞里亞。 
　　金次的秘密究竟是什麼？神崎·H·亞里亞究竟是何方神聖？金次將被這嬌小可愛但性格兇暴的粉發少女帶往何方？
anilist:20991.synopsis_en: A young girl idolizes the world-renowned S-ranked butei Kanzaki H. Aria and plans to follow in her footsteps. However, her test grades her out as only an E-rank! All is not lost, however, as Aria agrees to give her some pointers. Can Aria help this newcomer become a first-rate butei?

titles.ja: マギ The kingdom of magic

anilist:18115.synopsis_zh:
改編同名動畫為小學館創業90週年紀念企劃作品，2012年10月7日開始播放。日本授權中國大陸樂視網即日播出。

於播效完畢後決定製作續篇，其後確定於2013年10月6日起播放第二季，並改動副標題作識別；第一季為依循漫畫的“The labyrinth of magic（魔法的迷宮）”，第二季迷宮改為“The kingdom of magic（魔法的王國）
anilist:18115.synopsis_en:
After celebrating their victory against Al-Thamen, Aladdin and his friends depart the land of Sindria. With the end of the battle, however, comes the time for each of them to go their separate ways. Hakuryuu and Kougyoku are ordered to go back to their home country, the Kou Empire. Meanwhile Aladdin announces he needs to head for Magnostadt—a mysterious country ruled by magicians—to investigate the mysterious events occurring in this new kingdom and become more proficient in magic. For their part, encouraged by Aladdin's words, Alibaba and Morgiana also set off in pursuit of their own goals: training and going to her homeland, respectively.

Magi: The Kingdom of Magic follows these friends as they all go about their separate adventures, each facing their own challenges. However, a new threat begins to rise as a great war looms over the horizon...

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

titles.primary_zh: 玉子市場 劇場版-玉子愛情故事

anilist:10232.synopsis_zh:
描寫了非常喜歡拍照的高中1年級生澤渡楓和，圍繞著她的人們的日常和小小的夢想的故事。
澤渡楓是一個喜歡攝影的高中一年級生。她搬到了瀨戶內海一個被青山和大海所包圍的寧靜小鎮——廣島縣竹原市。這是她去世的父親童年生活的地方。這裡有陳舊的街道，美麗的海景和善良的居民，當然，還有澤渡楓交到的新朋友們。在楓所拍攝的她所鍾愛的這座城市的照片裡，偶爾會看到玉響的存在。玉響是楓在拍攝時感受到幸福時候的光芒。幸福好像在一瞬間變成了具體的形狀……而且這些照片總是能給大家帶來幸福的感受。
anilist:10232.synopsis_en:
As a little girl, Fuu Sawatari’s father taught her to love photography. They took pictures everywhere they went. But after he passed away, seeing those photographs only served as a reminder of her loss, so she locked them away to be forgotten. Years later, her brother Kou finds their father’s picture album, and as he flips through its pages, the pictures remind Fuu of all the happy memories of her father that she will carry with her forever.

Now, as the shy Fuu enters her first year of high school, she once again takes up her father’s old camera, determined to take wonderful pictures that will bring joy and happiness to others.

(Source: Nozomi Entertainment)
anilist:10232.source_doc_raw: 玉子市場 劇場版-玉子愛情故事(完結)

titles.ja: 喜羊羊与灰太狼之智趣羊学堂 地球嘉年华

anilist:5341.synopsis_zh:
移動的地球嘉年華來到了青青草原。為了獲得嘉年華的終極大獎——百科全書，小羊們和灰太狼進入嘉年華挑戰裡面的遊樂專案，收集遊戲票根。

在嘉年華里，小羊們遇到了導遊地球儀姐姐。在地球儀的帶領與指引下，他們坐上過山車上天入海，體驗水迴圈的過程；他們也到氣象屋裡探險，認識了風雨雷電雪等氣象家族；他們還搭上四季巡遊花車，幫助春夏秋冬四季順利過渡。

灰太狼為了比小羊們收集更多票根，總是爭著去挑戰遊樂專案，卻都失敗。而小羊們積極開動腦筋，頻頻奪得頭籌。

在玩樂的過程中，羊狼漸漸學到了豐富的自然科學和地理知識，更加深入瞭解地球的構造與執行。隨著小羊們與灰太狼手上的票根越來越多，最終成功兌換了百科全書，亦收穫了許多珍貴的知識與回憶。
anilist:5341.synopsis_en: Kraft Lawrence, an experienced traveling merchant, and his sharp tongued wolf goddess companion, Holo, continue on their journey to return to Holo's home in the north called Yoitsu.  A tender relationship blossoms between the two as they make deals and travel between cities.

titles.ja: 中二病でも恋がしたい！
titles.ja_romaji: Chuunibyou demo Koi ga Shitai! Ren
titles.en: Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions - Heart Throb -

anilist:18671.synopsis_zh: 富樫勇太於初中畢業的時候，決定同時為自己舉辦中二病畢業的儀式。打算順利渡過高中生活的他，在開學日以最後的中二語錄完全封鎖這段黑歷史。可惜天意弄人，勇太遇上了現任中二病患者暨同班同學小鳥遊六花，更被對方看出中二病的殘餘症狀。六花於是以此威逼勇太與她“立下契約”。對方的行為舉止惹來了不少同學、家人、甚至青梅竹馬的注目，使勇太在享受“現充”的生活同時，又充滿著難言之隱……
anilist:18671.synopsis_en:
Due to various events, Yuuta and Rikka are living together. This secret co-habitation is so exciting for the two lovebirds! Or so it should be...

Is having a chuuni girlfriend too high of a hurdle for Yuuta, who never even went out with a normal girl?! Yuuta worries about how to advance his relationship with Rikka. And then everyone else, Nibutani, Kumin, and Dekomori, have powered up by advancing a grade. Furthermore, the cause of his chuunibyou outburst in middle school, the girl who calls herself Sophia Ring Saturn the 7th, Satone Shichimiya appears...

This is the long-awaited second season of the adolescent romantic comedy revolving around chuunibyou that makes you laugh and cry.


(Source: Animax)
anilist:18671.source_doc_raw: 中二病也要談戀愛II(12)(完結)

titles.ja: ファイ・ブレイン ～神のパズル
titles.ja_romaji: Phi Brain: Kami no Puzzle 2nd Season
titles.en: Phi Brain ~ Puzzle of God: The Orpheus Order

anilist:12753.synopsis_zh:
本作是以解謎為題材的原創動畫，Phi-Brain是指擁有黃金比大腦之人，而主人公Kaito作為Phi-Brain的候補者之一，為解開傳說中的“神之謎題”而展開一場冒險。

熱愛解謎的私立√（Root）學園高一學生大門Kaito，在偶然的機遇下挑戰了潛藏在學園近郊地下遺蹟中的“不可解之謎”，那是由神秘的智囊集團POG所製造的、招致生命危險的“賢者之謎”。被真相激怒的Kaito漂亮地攻克了賢者之謎，意外地從中獲得了“Solver(解答者)”的指名。於是Kaito與青梅竹馬的少女Nonoha以及其他擁有解答者身份的同伴們一起，以存在於世界各地的“賢者之謎”為舞臺，與POG展開解謎對決。
anilist:12753.synopsis_en:
The second season of Phi Brain: Kami no Puzzle.

The puzzles get tougher and even more deadly as Kaito Daimon continues his battle against the power hungry Givers of the POG. And with one team member already switching sides, will Kaito have what it takes to keep solving the deadly puzzle traps put before him and reach the fabled Puzzle of God? More importantly, will he be able to solve the puzzles AND maintain his sanity? 
(Source: Sentai Filmworks)

anilist:14397.synopsis_zh:
從小時候起，綾瀨千早的理想就只有一個——輔佐姐姐綾瀨千歲稱為日本第一的模特，為了實現這個理想，千早可謂是不擇手段。但是，一個名為綿谷新的轉學生徹底打碎了她的幻覺。“不是自己的事就不算夢想！”被綿谷一語點醒的千早決定將理想轉移到綿谷教會她的“小倉百人一首競技歌牌”上，一個全新的，為了自己的理想而不斷奮鬥的千早新鮮出爐了！
       作為青梅竹馬，完美少年真島太一一直暗戀著千早，可不知如何表達感情的他卻總是忍不住的要欺負心愛著的千早。眼看著千早和綿谷因為歌牌越走越近，太一決定加入他們的“歌牌部”，同時也開始了千早的爭奪戰。時光飛逝，三人早已因為歌牌而結下了深厚的友誼，畢業在即，三人約定，只要歌牌存在一天，他們就終會再見面。
anilist:14397.synopsis_en:
Now in their second year of high school, Chihaya and her friends share all the fun and worries that come with welcoming underclassmen to the team as they face tough rival schools. The passion of the Mizusawa Karuta Club burns hotter than ever, but with the same refreshing, youthful mood carrying over from the first season.
(Source: Crunchyroll)

titles.ja: 結婚するって、本当ですか
titles.ja_romaji: Kekkon Suru tte, Hontou desu ka

anilist:165790.synopsis_zh: 首都圏の旅行代理店、JTCの企畫部に勤める拓也と莉香は、共に人付き合いが苦手で目立たないが、充実した一人生活を送っていた。ところが、アラスカ支店開設により1年後に獨身者が優先で海外派遣されることになり、困った莉香は拓也にとある計畫を持ちかけて……。ほとんどしゃべったこともない2人が、たったの365日後に結婚することに！？
anilist:165790.synopsis_en:
Takuya and Rika work at the same travel agency in Tokyo and are both happily introverted and single. But their company is opening a new branch in Alaska next year, and employees without a spouse will be recruited to work there. Desperate to avoid the move, and though they’ve hardly spoken before, they decide to fake an engagement. Can these quiet coworkers become a convincing couple?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

titles.ja: 結婚するって、本当ですか

anilist:2285.synopsis_zh: 首都圏の旅行代理店、JTCの企畫部に勤める拓也と莉香は、共に人付き合いが苦手で目立たないが、充実した一人生活を送っていた。ところが、アラスカ支店開設により1年後に獨身者が優先で海外派遣されることになり、困った莉香は拓也にとある計畫を持ちかけて……。ほとんどしゃべったこともない2人が、たったの365日後に結婚することに！？
anilist:2285.synopsis_en:
DICE (DNA Integrated Cybernetic Enterprises) is a large organization established to deal with problems in the Sarbylion galaxy. DICE F-99 is the only unit comprised entirely of children.
When a problem arises, DICE is called to the rescue. And when their special training and skills aren`t enough, they rely on their Dinobreakers, which can transform from Vehicle Mode to Dino Mode, to help get the job done!
Always on call, always on alert - DICE is ready for action! 
(Source: AniDB)

titles.ja: タイムボカンシリーズ タイムパトロール隊オタスケマン
titles.ja_romaji: Time Bokan Series: Time Patrol-Tai Otasukeman

anilist:8553.synopsis_zh: シリーズ第４弾。タイムトラベルを管理するという今まで以上に本格的なSF設定の中、意外でシリアスな結末が用意される。シリーズの魅力をさらに広げた意欲作だ。歴史の流れが変わらないように頑張るタイムパトロール隊。だが謎の怪人トンマノマントは、配下オジャママンに指示を出し、自分が思うままの歴史の修正を図った。これに挑むのはパトロール隊のヒカルとナナがひそかに変身したオタスケマンだが、事件には意外な真実が…。
anilist:8553.synopsis_en:
Burning with ambitions to become the most beautiful woman, the most renowned scientist, and the greatest hero the world has ever known, three villains, Atasha, Sekobitchi and Duwarusuki, unite. The trio are Time Patrollers, the keepers and protectors of the annals of history. But, this is only a cover for the trio, as the villains are league with a nefarious leader, who is trying to alter the course of history to suit his desires, and, under his instructions, the trio travel in time with the aim of tampering with recorded history. Only Hikaru and Nana, disguised as the Otasukemen, stand between the villains and their goals. 
(Source: Wikipedia)

anilist:3225.synopsis_zh: 南春香是一個外表出色個性優秀的完美學生。在學校裡，性格開朗溫和的她是許多人愛慕的物件，保坂就是其中的一員。學校裡流傳著許多和春香有關的傳說，她更是以“第一代首領”的名號著稱。在妹妹南夏奈和南千秋的眼中，春香是一個母親般的存在。夏奈是個四肢發達的運動型少女，個性活潑又有些迷糊的她是大家的開心果。可是在千秋眼中，夏奈是個十足的笨蛋，但這也恰恰是千秋表達愛意的特殊方式——毒舌。雖然外表冷漠行事老成，但千秋也有著意外細膩和幼稚的一面。南家的三個姐妹，各有各的特色，但三個人都是那麼的善良和可愛，在小小的城市中，她們正展開著輕鬆又快樂的日常生活。
anilist:3225.synopsis_en: The second season of Minami-Ke. It picks up where the first season left off, and just like the first season, it's about the daily lives of the three Minami sisters, Haruka, Kana and Chiaki, and their school friends.

anilist:14511.synopsis_en:
The everyday lives of the Minami sisters continue. Chiaki, the youngest, continues to call people idiots while worshipping her eldest sister. Kana, the middle, still can't figure out that Fujioka's feelings for her are a crush, not a grudge. Haruka, the eldest, still unknowingly avoids Hosaka's advances to invite her to the volleyball team, and after a long day of excitement, the sisters enjoy sitting at the table at their home.
(Source: Anime News Network)

zh_aliases: Code Geass 反叛的魯路修R2
titles.ja: コードギアス 反逆のルルーシュR2
titles.en: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion

anilist:1575.synopsis_zh:
“東京決戰”一年後，布里塔尼亞少年魯路修在11區（原日本國）過著平凡的學生生活。但是，魯路修與弟弟羅洛的一次出行，遇到了黑色騎士團的餘黨。在與少女C.C再次結成契約之後，塵封的記憶擺在了魯路修的面前。
　　身為帝國王子的魯路修，為了建立人人平等的世界、讓妹妹娜娜麗幸福的世界，而使用GEASS，令人絕對服從的力量，帶領黑色騎士團向帝國宣戰。帶上假面化名ZERO的他，卻在一年前的“東京決戰”中被好友朱雀擊敗，被帝國皇帝抹去了記憶。
　　現在，恢復記憶的魯路修不僅要面對帝國的強大軍事力量，更要面對虛假的弟弟羅洛、失蹤的妹妹娜娜麗、不知敵友的中華聯盟、內部出現分歧的黑色騎士團。面對內憂外患，魯路修走上了GEASS之力的詛咒——孤獨的王之路。
anilist:1575.synopsis_en:
On August 10th of the year 2010 the Holy Empire of Britannia began a campaign of conquest, its sights set on Japan. Operations were completed in one month thanks to Britannia's deployment of new mobile humanoid armor vehicles dubbed Knightmare Frames. Japan's rights and identity were stripped away, the once proud nation now referred to as Area 11. Its citizens, Elevens, are forced to scratch out a living while the Britannian aristocracy lives comfortably within their settlements. Pockets of resistance appear throughout Area 11, working towards independence for Japan.
 Lelouch, an exiled Imperial Prince of Britannia posing as a student, finds himself in the heart of the ongoing conflict for the island nation. Through a chance meeting with a mysterious girl named C.C., Lelouch gains his Geass, the power of the king. Now endowed with absolute dominance over any person, Lelouch may finally realize his goal of bringing down Britannia from within!
(Source: Bandai Entertainment)

anilist:10378.synopsis_zh:
她來自大海，人稱“烏賊娘”。她最討厭人類，決定游上岸佔領陸地！
烏賊娘想盡辦法展開侵略行動，卻意外和人類成為好朋友！？
看到不斷被人類汙染的海洋，讓住在海底的“烏賊娘”非常不滿，決定要上岸來懲罰自私的人類！而她首先便決定佔領位於海水浴場的海之家“檸檬”，以便作為她侵略陸地的據點。想不到侵略行動還沒展開，烏賊娘就被迫在“檸檬”打工還債，她真的能如願征服人類嗎？
anilist:10378.synopsis_en:
The nefarious Squid Girl is back to continue her self-appointed mission to invade the surface world. Or that's what she would do, if she could just stop getting distracted by squidding movies, reading squidly manga, and making friends as only a squid could make them. Squid Girl must overcome not only danger found at every turn, but her own squidly good nature as well.

(Source: Anime News Network)

titles.en: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You Season 2

anilist:9656.synopsis_zh: 故事圍繞著一個外表看起來陰暗到會被周圍人稱為“貞子”的女高中生黑沼爽子展開，描述她透過努力逐漸消除周圍人的誤解，並得到友情與愛情的故事。有著濃黑長髮，慘白皮膚的黑沼爽子的座右銘是“日行一善”，喜歡幫助他人，所以一直擔任班級委員，由於小學時不小心得到了“貞子”這個綽號，導致周圍人以為和她接觸會受到詛咒而不敢與她交朋友。上高中後，在受到過自己幫助的同學風早的帶動下，逐漸融合到班級中，被改稱為“座敷童子”，認為“看到貞子笑的話會有好運”。爽朗王子與“貞子”女生的校園輕喜劇登場啦……
anilist:9656.synopsis_en:
The second season of Kimi ni Todoke.

Sawako Kuronuma and her friends have just begun their second year of high school and they are in the same class together again. To make matters more interesting a male student newly transferred into their class is seated right next to Kuronuma and has taken an interest in her. What hurdles will Sawako and Kazehaya face next?
Note: Includes episode 0, "Kataomoi/A Crush".

anilist:310.synopsis_zh:
上杉達也と和也は雙子の兄弟。お隣の淺倉家に生まれた南とは、小さな頃からいつも一緒。あまりにも仲良く、元気なのに手を焼いた（？）親たちは共同出費で子供たちのために、３人で學び遊べる家まで建ててしまった。ところが、彼らも中學生に入る頃から、この"男２人+女１人"という狀況の持つ意味を、それなりに意識し始めた。周囲は明るく可愛い南、成績優秀の和也を似合いのカップルと思っている。それに反し、兄の達也はだれもが認める"出がらし"。成績、スポーツ共に、和也に比べて數段見劣りするのだ。だが努力することは嫌いでも、その隠れた才能を見抜いてるのが和也。しかしいつも達也に反発しながらも、內心は彼にまんざらではないようすの南に、和也も気が気ではなくなって・・・。

  日常的な情景の中に、青春の繊細な心の動きを織り込んで描く、あだち充の"タッチ・ワールド"。明るくさわやかなその世界は、時が経つにつれ、甘酸っぱい想い出と共に、くっきりと心の中に蘇ってきます。魅力溢れるキャラクター、エピソードを完璧に収録した永遠の名作、ついに待望のプレイボールです。
anilist:310.synopsis_en: This is a heart-warming story with three little ghost called There, Here and Where. They are not scary like usual ghosts but pretty and mischievous like human children. Of course they sometimes surprise people by disappearing or flying, but they are loved as children's friends.

anilist:11371.synopsis_zh: 「テニスの王子様」は、週刊少年ジャンプにて連載された許斐剛原作の漫畫作品。2009年3月よりジャンプSQにて『新テニスの王子様』として第2シリーズの連作が行われている。また、テレビアニメは、2001年よりテレビ東京系列他にて放送。その後もOVAやミュージカルといった展開が行われるなど、現在も高い人気を得ている。2011年9月3日からは『劇場版 テニスの王子様 英國式庭球城決戦！』の公開も予定されている。
anilist:11371.synopsis_en:
Middle school students fought fiercely against one another in a national tournament. Now, 50 chosen representatives return to fight again as high school students! 
The stage is the U-17 (Under Seventeen) Japanese Representative Training Camp. Middle school students have been invited for the first time to a camp known to produce the best Japanese tennis players. National champions from Seigaku, Hyotei, Rikkai, Shitenhoji... With all the rivals from the national tournament attending, everyone eagerly awaits their reunion. 
At first, the middle schoolers do not expect much from their high school opponents. However, the training camp is not so easy! Athletes with skills incomparable to those they previously faced and their mysterious coach appear before them. Faced with numerous demanding challenges, can the middle schoolers survive in this meritocratic training camp?
(Source: Crunchyroll)

titles.en: Stella Women's Academy, High School Division Class C3

anilist:17821.synopsis_zh: 電撃文庫の“さわやかローリング・スポコメディ”『ロウきゅーぶ！』のアニメ第2期製作が決定した。そして、そのタイトルが『ロウきゅーぶ！SS』であることが発表される
anilist:17821.synopsis_en:
Yura Yamato has just arrived at the high school division of Stella Women's Academy, when Sonora Kashima invites her to join a club called "C³". Sonora is the third-year student who became the new head of this club for military survival games. The other members include two second-year students (part-Japanese Karila Hatsuse and G36K-wielding Honoka Mutsu) and two other new students (Rento Kirishima whose family runs a Japanese sweets shop and the really short Yachiyo Hinata).
(Source: Anime News Network)

zh_aliases: 我的妹妹哪有這麼可愛！
titles.ja: 俺の妹がこんなに可愛いわけがない
titles.ja_romaji: Ore no Imouto ga Konna ni Kawaii Wake ga Nai.

anilist:13659.synopsis_zh:
由伏見司創作的輕小說「我的妹妹哪有這麼可愛」僅僅推出了六卷，但銷量已經突破了150萬部，絕對是現今電擊文庫中人氣飆升得最快的新貴。作品本身以萌妹作為招徠，配上傲嬌、御宅、吐糟男等喜劇元素，可謂一部王道作品應該有的她都有了。但「我的妹妹哪有這麼可愛」的魅力絕不僅於此，本身和妹妹的關係勢成水火般互相漠不關心，竟然因為一張「和妹妹談戀愛吧♪」的成人遊戲DVD的關係，和妹妹之間的冰山便開始慢慢地融解，現在更發展成兄妹曖昧的關係，其破壞力絕對是在大家的想像之上。

既然作品以萌妹作為招徠，當中的的兩大萌角桐乃及黑貓也分別請來了現今萌妹系的代表聲優竹達梓喵及花澤撫子來扮演。這種萌妹組合本身的“毒”性已經非常高，而負責音樂的還是創作了不少高萌性音樂的神前曉，看來「我的妹妹哪有這麼可愛」的動畫將會使不少宅們出現嚴重的中毒現象了。

「我的妹妹哪有這麼可愛」本身的故事和「乃木坂春香的秘密」有若干程度相似，都是女主角害怕自己的“御宅”被人鄙視，之後秘密給男主角知道後的喜劇作品，但不同的是少了無謂的閃光，多了桐乃對自身興趣喜怒哀樂的描寫，確實成就了校園、愛情、生活感情的小喜劇。希望大家看過「我的妹妹哪有這麼可愛」的動畫之後，便能感受她的魅力所在。

CAST：
高坂桐乃：竹達彩奈
高坂京介：中村悠一
黑貓：花澤香菜
沙織･巴吉納：生天目仁美
田村麻奈實：佐藤聰美
新垣綾瀨：早見沙織
來棲加奈子：田村由香裡
梅露露(星野庫拉拉)：田村由香裡
anilist:13659.synopsis_en:
The second season of Ore no Imouto ga Konna ni Kawaii Wake ga Nai

Kirino is back from her trip to America, but the fun doesn't stop here! In the second season of Oreimo, Kyousuke continues to give Kirino life consultations. This time, romance lurks on the horizon for both siblings...
anilist:13659.source_doc_raw: 我的妹妹不可能這麼可愛II(14)(完結)

titles.ja: 俺の妹がこんなに可愛いわけがない
titles.ja_romaji: Ore ga Suki nano wa Imouto dakedo Imouto ja Nai

anilist:100382.synopsis_en:
Suzuka Nagami is a beautiful third-year middle school student who has excellent grades and is the student council president. She wrote a novel about a little sister who dotes on her older brother, and the the novel wins a light novel award. After they discuss the matter, her older brother Yū is the one who debuts as a proxy light novel author instead of Suzuka, under the pen name Chikai Towano.

(Source: Anime News Network)
anilist:100382.source_doc_raw: 我的妹妹哪有這麼可愛(15)(完結)

zh_aliases: 棒球大聯盟 第一季
titles.ja: メジャー 第1シリーズ

anilist:112302.synopsis_zh: 《棒球大聯盟》（MAJOR）是滿田拓也的少年漫畫作品，從1994年在週刊少年Sunday（小學館）上連載中的棒球漫畫，臺灣由青文出版社代理漫畫出版，連載於元氣少年。另有以原作改編的電視動畫，電視動畫的標題是片假名的“メジャー”。
anilist:112302.synopsis_en:
"One day, we're going to make the strongest battery ever!" Based on the promise to reunite with Hikaru again, Daigo has moved on to Fuurin Academy Middle School. Daigo is the captain for the baseball club, but with all the older students gone, the team is all girls, including Mutsuko. With a group of peculiar newcomers, the new Fuurin Academy baseball club is off to a new start!

How strong are these baseball girls?! It's the beginning of the "middle school chapter" of the endlessly passionate baseball tale!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

anilist:12365.synopsis_zh:
芳文社漫畫雜誌月刊《まんがタイムきららForward》人氣連載作品，講述能看見他人夢境的高中生藤原夢路，某天遇到了從“幻界”徘徊到“現界”的少女瑪莉。瑪莉因為一些事故而導致了失憶而被逼留在“現界”。夢路決定幫助瑪莉尋回記憶並重返“幻界”，一場以夢境與現實的交界為舞臺，他們兩人與夢魔間的戰鬥便正式開始了。
原作牛木義隆是東方同人漫畫創作的大手，而本作OPED也將由主攻東方的同人音樂大團IOSYS製作。

anilist:12365.synopsis_en:
Moritaka Mashiro and Akito Takagi have come a long way since they started making manga in middle school, but trials still await them as they head towards their goal of getting an anime adaptation for one of their manga. As they continue to grow as artists and as people, they will be faced with new friends, new rivals, and new hurdles to overcome.
(Source: Anime News Network)

anilist:10030.synopsis_en:
After the decision to serialize Moritaka and Akito has been made, they are introduced to Miura, their new manager. At first, the two thought it was a joke, but Hattori gives them a pep talk before leaving. While Miura doesn't seem like a bad person, he is given to rudeness and seems to be worried about the duo's future. In addition, the duo are given three assistants to work on their manuscript, and with the assistance of Ogawa, an experienced assistant, their work progresses well. 
At the start of the new year, Moritaka and Akito both attend Shonen Jack's New Year Party. There, they meet Hiramaru Kazuya, said to be a genius of a whole different level from Eiji.

titles.ja_romaji: Kore wa Zombie desu ka? of the Dead
titles.en: Is this A Zombie? of the Dead

anilist:10790.synopsis_zh: 平凡的高中生相川步，在莫名其妙的因緣下被捲入震驚社會的連環殺人案身亡，但他竟然死而復生了。原來在事件發生之前與步偶然邂逅的死靈法師“優”，將他變成了不死身而復活。再加上來自魔法世界的少女戰士春奈，與另一個吸血忍者少女瑟拉芬，甚至演變成步跟她們全住在一起的局面。
anilist:10790.synopsis_en:
Aikawa Ayumu was revived as a zombie by the cute necromancer Eucliwood Hellscythe. After the zany, madcap adventures in the first season of Is This a Zombie? ended, Ayumu thought his life might finally get back to normal, or as normal as it can be for a zombie. However, destiny has other plans for him. Some guys just can't catch a break. 
(Source: FUNimation)

anilist:2076.synopsis_zh:
主人公金田一一是名偵探“金田一耕助”的孫子，功課不好，體育不行，有點好色，走到哪，哪就會發生命案，在推理時卻像變了一個人似的，解開了一個又一個謎題，經典臺詞是：“我以我爺爺--金田一耕助的名義發誓……謎底已經解開了，兇手就在我們中間。” 。
金田一的青梅竹馬七瀨美雪，是不動高中的資優生兼學生會會長，長得好看、身材好、功課也好，人緣更是好得沒話說，可她就喜歡那個吊兒郎當的金田一。
anilist:2076.synopsis_en:
Kindaichi Hajime may look dumb, but he is one of the smartest you will ever see. He encounters mysteries after mysteries with his good friend, Miyuki, and he swears to solve them in the name of his grandfather, which was a great detective.

(Source: Anime News Network)
anilist:2076.source_doc_raw: 金田一少年事件簿(完結)

zh_aliases: 只有神知道的世界 第二季
titles.ja_romaji: Kami nomi zo Shiru Sekai II
titles.en: The World God Only Knows II

anilist:10080.synopsis_zh: 故事將繼續講訴桂木桂馬在笨蛋惡魔艾露西的幫助下狩獵驅魂的故事，艾露西在地獄的好朋友白婭也將露面。
anilist:10080.synopsis_en:
Katsuragi is back, and together with Elsie the hunt for loose souls continues on. This time however, they are joined by Elsie's friend and fellow Demon, Haqua.

(Source: Anime News Network)
anilist:10080.source_doc_raw: 只有神知道的世界II(12)(完結)

anilist:8407.synopsis_zh: 被美麗的自然所包圍的小鎮，空美町。住在那裡的櫻井智樹是一名將“和平第一”作為標語的普通學生。不過，自從某日從天空中掉下一位名為伊卡洛斯的女孩，他平靜的日常生活開始脫軌了。自稱“娛樂用萬能天使”的她，將降落後見到的第一位人類，也就是智樹稱呼為“主人”，並有著能實現他一切願望的不可思議的能力。入手一千億現金，成為透明人，讓時間停止，總之什麼都可以！滿足了一個健全男子的全部慾望的智樹，最後的願望是！？
anilist:8407.synopsis_en:
Sakurai Tomoki has settled into his life with the two angeloids, Ikaros and Nymph, and is enjoying himself immensely.  However, he keeps having weird dreams and asks all of his friends to help him investigate the cause.
Nymph conjures up a device that enables people, but not angeloids, to enter other people's dreams.  The device malfunctions at first but eventually they get to what was supposed to be Tomoki's dream but discover that something is very wrong with it.
Later, a meteor comes crashing down from the skies at the site of the large cherry blossom tree where Tomoki first discovered Ikaros.  An extremely well endowed blonde angeloid with a huge sword emerges from the meteor and sets off in search of Tomoki!

anilist:9510.synopsis_zh:
改編自櫻井紀雄的同名漫畫作品，《超元氣3姐妹》故事以丸井家就讀小學六年級的三胞胎姐妹為中心，長女「三葉」是一個稍嫌早熟的虐待狂少女，以女王自居的她，認為所有的人都要對他服從。次女「雙葉」是個有點色色的少女，頭腦簡單四肢發達的她，最喜歡的東西就是女人的胸部。三女「一葉」則是個有點不可思議的陰沉型少女，常被人誤認是靈異少女，但是在家中的料理及家事都是由她負責。 

作品描述不只長的完全不一樣，連個性也南轅北轍的三胞胎，在日常生活中與身邊的人們所發生的搞笑趣事。

titles.ja: 荒川アンダー ザ ブリッジ×ブリッジ
titles.ja_romaji: Arakawa Under the Bridge x Bridge
titles.en: Arakawa Under the Bridge x Bridge

anilist:9074.synopsis_zh:
“能和我談一場戀愛麼？”
舞臺是荒川河畔。在那裡相遇的精英青年・市之宮行（通稱リク）與自稱是金星人的無家美少女・ニノ，笨拙的兩人的戀愛有時古怪、有時又令人心痛……。以這樣的兩人為中心，描繪荒川居民不斷捲起騷動的日常。
元祖電波系新感覺溫馨戀愛喜劇再度開幕！
anilist:9074.synopsis_en:
In the dry riverbed of Arakawa River, undefeated elite Ichinomiya Kou (aka Ric) met the lovely homeless girl Nino, a self-declared Venusian. Their awkward love stirs up trouble among the other strange inhabitants of the riverbed.

(Source: Anime News Network)

anilist:20819.synopsis_zh: 由於家境困難而開始在家庭餐廳打工的東田大輔。但那裡卻是有著料理白痴的外場主管、一切都以金錢衡量的服務員等等，沒什麼正經人的家庭餐廳……！？
anilist:20819.synopsis_en:
The third season of Working!! 

The eccentric employees of everybody's favorite family restaurant will be going wild once again!

(Source: Aniplex USA, edited)

anilist:6956.synopsis_zh: 由於家境困難而開始在家庭餐廳打工的東田大輔。但那裡卻是有著料理白痴的外場主管、一切都以金錢衡量的服務員等等，沒什麼正經人的家庭餐廳……！？
anilist:6956.synopsis_en:
Set in a family restaurant in Hokkaido, the northern prefecture of Japan, 16-year-old high school student Souta Takanashi works part-time along with his strange co-workers: Popura Taneshima, a high school girl who's a year older than Souta, yet easily mistaken for an elementary/middle schooler, and Kyoko Shirafuji, the 28-year-old store manager who doesn't bother to do any work at all. 
(Source: NIS America)

anilist:21262.synopsis_zh:
『けものフレンズ』の監督で知られるヤオヨロズ所屬のアニメーター・たつきが、2017年8月15日に自身のTwitterアカウント(@irodori7)上で公開した自主製作によるオリジナル短編アニメーション。

同年10月23日、続編と思われる新作アニメーションが同じくTwitterにて投稿された。さらに同年12月28日にはYoutubeのアカウント「irodoriginal」にて、上記の2話を合わせ更に新たなシーンを追加した『傾福さん フル版』と題した動畫が投稿される。また、本動畫の説明文にてはじめて製作スタッフ・キャストについて明記された。
anilist:21262.synopsis_en:
Third and “Final Season” of the Monogatari Series, part 3/5. Contains the arcs Ougi Formula, Sodachi Riddle, Sodachi Lost and Shinobu Mail from the Owarimonogatari light novels.

During the month of October of his third year in high school, Koyomi Araragi is introduced to a transfer student named Ougi Oshino by his underclassman Suruga Kanbaru. Ougi tells Koyomi that she has something she wishes to consult with him. When she draws the map of Naoetsu High School, she finds something peculiar on there. This discovery reveals a tale that wasn’t meant to be told, and this makes Koyomi’s high school life totally different. This is the story that brings to light “what” makes Koyomi Araragi. This is the story that reveals the “beginning” of everything.

(Source: Aniplex)

Note: The first episode aired with a runtime of ~48 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.

anilist:21745.synopsis_zh:
美しき吸血鬼に出逢った春休みの後、 
空から女の子が降ってくる少し前。 

ゴールデンウィーク最初の日、 
主人公・阿良々木暦は委員長・羽川翼とともに 
車に轢かれた、尾のない貓を埋葬する。 

些細でありふれたはずの出來事。 
しかし、ここから"悪夢の九日間"が幕を開ける。
anilist:21745.synopsis_en:
Third and “Final Season” of the Monogatari Series, part 4/5. Contains the arcs Mayoi Hell, Hitagi Rendezvous, and Ougi Dark from the Owarimonogatari light novels.

Koyomi wakes up to see Mayoi Hachikuji before him, the girl who supposedly had gone to the afterlife. She tells Koyomi that they are currently in Avichi, the lowest levels of hell. Koyomi is dubious of how Mayoi knew about the exact timing of his death and which hell he would drop into, when Mayoi tells him that she was there to pick him up by the request of a certain individual.

(Source: Aniplex)

titles.primary_zh: 親吻姊姊kiss x sis OAD
titles.ja: トンデラハウスの大冒険
titles.ja_romaji: Time Kyoshitsu: Tondera House no Daibouken

anilist:3075.synopsis_zh:
前作『アニメ親子劇場』に続く、聖書の世界を舞臺にしたSF時間旅行もの。
　少年・安土ゲンは、ガールフレンドの夏山カンナ、そしてカンナの弟ツク坊とともに、森の中の怪しい洋館に入った。そこで3人が出會ったのは、異才の科學者・待夢博士。博士は助手のロボット・カンデンチンとともにタイムマシンを製作中だった。だが落雷の影響で、未完成のままタイムマシンが作動。一同は館ごと、異次元空間に突入してしまう。やがて彼らが漂著したのは、紀元後1世紀の世界。彼らはイエス・キリストとその弟子たちと出會い、その生涯を追うことになるが。
　舊約聖書の世界を主題にした前作『アニメ親子劇場』から、設定やキャラクターも重新整理。內容の方も、今度は新訳聖書の世界を主體とする。番組製作は前作と同じくタツノコプロ。この後、シリーズ第3弾にあたる『パソコントラベル探偵団』が製作放映されている。
anilist:3075.synopsis_en:
The series began in the middle of a game of hide and seek, as a young boy named Justin Casey (Gen) finishes counting and begins searching for his friends Angela (usually called "Angie") and Corkey Roberts (Kanna and Tsukubo Natsuyama). As he searched for the brother and sister in the wooded area, a storm occurred all of a sudden. Justin managed to sneak up on the two before the rain started pouring, forcing them to run for cover. They would eventually find a house in the wooded area, previously unseen according to Justin. At first glance it appeared nobody was home after entering the house, until they discovered a robot named Solar Ion Robot (Kadenchin), or the acronym SIR. They would soon meet the owner of the house, Professor Humphrey Bumble (Dr. Tokio Taimu), who introduced the children to his greatest creation, a time machine. Professor Bumble's attempt at recreating Benjamin Franklin's famous lightning experiment with the use of a kite flying outside the house to get the machine working only led up to SIR's temporary change in personality before sending the entire house on course for the past. The children never realized how long the journey back home would be due to Professor Bumble's misguidance and errors in time travel, but in the meantime they witnessed and participated (with little or no consequences) in numerous events in the Bible's New Testament, from John the Baptist's birth to the rise of the Apostle Paul."
(Source: Wikipedia)
anilist:3075.source_doc_raw: 親吻姊姊kiss x sis OAD(10)(完結)

anilist:8311.synopsis_zh:
在一片終日不見光明的大陸“琥珀之地”上，有一個神聖的職業——信蜂。在這片人工太陽照耀不到、蔓延著黑暗的危險之地，信蜂賭上性命也要為國民遞送重要的“信件”。 
葛修就是一名優秀的信蜂，這天他要送遞的“信件”是一名叫拉格的少年。拉格的母親於某日被一群陌生人強行帶走，拉格的母親將他作為信件，送往外海小鎮的嬸嬸家。運送途中，拉格為葛修那顆堅強而溫柔的心所吸引。因為崇敬葛修，拉格決心要成為一名優秀的信蜂。12歲時他透過考試成為信蜂，卻意外發現葛修已經不再是信蜂，而且失去了“心”，下落不明。拉格踏上信蜂之路，遞送著人們“心”和“希望”的信件，他要找到葛修……
anilist:8311.synopsis_en:
After Niche carries the wounded and stunned Lag back to the Bee Hive, the Letter Bee finally begins to piece the puzzle together. Now he knows what's happened to Gauche, why the Marauders are so focused on stealing mail and the actual intent of the group controlling both, Reverse. However, when he's forbidden to reveal the truth, Lag is soon forced out of the artificial sunlight and back into the world of perpetual night. And soon Reverse's plot to take down the Letter Bees and overthrow the Amberground government begins to accelerate. If things weren't already bad enough, the giant insect creatures called gaichuu are apparently evolving into something new; there may be traitors working within the Hive; and Niche's sister, who's definitely not human friendly, shows up to turn family drama into a full-scale siege! It all spells serious trouble for the Letter Bees, but if anyone can weather the storms and gloom of night, Lag and his team are the ones who'll deliver.
(Source: FUNimation)

anilist:112640.synopsis_zh:
舞臺是充滿獸耳•獸尾•有翼族的古裝•異族•戰國時代，據說在服飾、固有名詞等方面參考了現在生活在北海道中北部的阿伊努民族。

劇情以受傷倒在路邊的面罩男哈庫奧羅接受素未謀面的獸耳少女艾露露的治療為起點，經歷了哈庫奧羅領導人民起義反抗暴政、領導衛國鬥爭、解放他國受壓迫民眾的戰爭到保衛全世界大致四個階段。大陸的歷史以及哈庫奧羅究竟是誰、這些異民族又是如何產生等問題在戰爭的擴大化中逐步得到解決。

人設由甘露樹包攬，萌度十足。劇情從結尾看是泣系，從內容看是架空歷史，設定豐富，整體看起來已經夠獨特的民族風最後染上超未來要素讓人眼前一亮。
anilist:112640.synopsis_en:
Chaos has taken hold of the land as a conniving general has unlawfully seized the throne of the mighty Yamato Empire. The only ones that stand in his way are a couple of familiar faces who must rally different kingdoms together and fight against the powerful Imperial army.

(Source: Atlus)

anilist:21218.synopsis_en:
When I came to, I realized I was standing in the middle of a vast, snowy plain I knew nothing of. I didn't know how I got there. And to add to that, I couldn't remember anything, not even my name. I stood there, dumbfounded at my absurd situation. But then, as if to spite me further, a gigantic monster suddenly appeared, an insect-like creature that began to bear down on me. I tried desperately to run, but it cornered me into a hopeless situation. It was then that the girl appeared. Her name was Kuon. It was this beautiful girl, who bore an animal's ears and tail, who saved my life.

(Source: Anime News Network)

anilist:5114.synopsis_zh:
愛德華德和他的弟弟阿爾芬斯十分思念在他們還小的時候亡故的母親，實行了鍊金術中最大的禁忌——可以將死者復活的人體煉成。 可是煉成失敗，愛德華德失去了左腿，阿爾芬斯則失去了全身。愛德華德好不容易才以犧牲自己的右臂為代價將弟弟的靈魂煉成，並定著在一副鎧甲上，可是其代價未免太大了。愛德華德和阿爾芬斯一起，為了找回所失去的一切，開始踏上了尋找擁有極大力量的“賢者之石”的旅程。 
　　 
　　右臂和左腿用鋼製義肢“機械鎧”來替代的他，被人們稱為“鋼之鍊金術師”…
anilist:5114.synopsis_en:
"In order for something to be obtained, something of equal value must be lost."

Alchemy is bound by this Law of Equivalent Exchange—something the young brothers Edward and Alphonse Elric only realize after attempting human transmutation: the one forbidden act of alchemy. They pay a terrible price for their transgression—Edward loses his left leg, Alphonse his physical body. It is only by the desperate sacrifice of Edward's right arm that he is able to affix Alphonse's soul to a suit of armor. Devastated and alone, it is the hope that they would both eventually return to their original bodies that gives Edward the inspiration to obtain metal limbs called "automail" and become a state alchemist, the Fullmetal Alchemist.

Three years of searching later, the brothers seek the Philosopher's Stone, a mythical relic that allows an alchemist to overcome the Law of Equivalent Exchange. Even with military allies Colonel Roy Mustang, Lieutenant Riza Hawkeye, and Lieutenant Colonel Maes Hughes on their side, the brothers find themselves caught up in a nationwide conspiracy that leads them not only to the true nature of the elusive Philosopher's Stone, but their country's murky history as well. In between finding a serial killer and racing against time, Edward and Alphonse must ask themselves if what they are doing will make them human again... or take away their humanity.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

anilist:8129.synopsis_zh: 考上東京私立大學的杜崎拓，在大學生活的第一個暑假，於月臺上見到一名很像高中同學武藤裡伽子的女孩。之後為了參加同學會，在回到故鄉高知的路上，拓想起了高中時代的回憶。與轉學生裡伽子的相遇、夏威夷的畢業旅行、與裡伽子兩人的東京之旅、和友人爭執因而鬧翻的文化祭。隨著這些略帶苦澀的記憶，拓開始回顧起裡伽子的存在。
anilist:8129.synopsis_en:
Plain, timid and obsessed with jellyfish, Tsukimi is a far cry from her idea of a princess. Her tepid life as a jobless illustrator comes complete with roommates who harbor diehard hobbies that solidify their status as hopeless social rejects. These wallflowers run a tight, nun-like ship, but their no-men-allowed-not-no-one-not-no-how bubble is unwittingly burst after Tsukimi brings home a rescued sea jelly and a beauty queen... who's actually a guy.

When the threat of losing their cozy convent inspires this glamour boy to turn the neurotic entourage into a portrait of success, will Tsukimi take her chance to bloom, or will she end up a hot mess?

(Source: Funimation)

titles.ja_romaji: Saijo no Osewa: Takane no Hanadarake na Meimonkou de, Gakuin Ichi no Ojou-sama (Seikatsu Nouryoku Kaimu) wo Kagenagara Osewa suru Koto ni Narimashita
titles.en: Rich Girl Caretaker: I'm Secretly the Caregiver of the Most Popular Girl in This Rich Kid School

anilist:201514.synopsis_zh:
在私立碧陽學園。學生會成員的選舉，有一套特殊的制度。
不舉行一般的選舉，只是單純地用《人氣投票》來選取學生會成員。
因此，每年被選出的基本上是《可愛的女孩》。這是因為美男子會遭到男性學生的不滿，而美少女對男女學生來說，都是喜歡的物件。
可是，用人氣和外表來確定這樣重要的人選，這樣合適嗎？
在發生了異議之後，妥協的結果是選取《優秀者》。在各年級學習成績頂尖的學生，只要本人願意，就有機會加入學生會。
於是，有學生開始猛學，卻沒能得到進入學生會的機會……。
但是，有一個男學生，堅持了自己的信念，終於打破了常規！
杉崎鍵。他夢想著自己能進入《除了自己之外全是美少女的團體》，他以此為目標，開始猛學，於是終於在年末的考試中取得了第一名。
他抵達的目標，是個性鮮明的、美少女雲集的學生會。
LOLI娘學生會會長・櫻野真紅。
冰冷而理性的前輩・紅葉知弦。
少年風的傲嬌・椎名深夏。
可愛的夢幻妹妹・椎名真冬。
最終，杉崎能過上理想的後宮生活麼？
anilist:201514.synopsis_en:
A poor high school boy, Itsuki Tomonari, got caught up in a kidnapping attempt on Hinako Konohana, a young lady from one of Japan's largest conglomerates. On the surface, Hinako appears to be a brilliant and beautiful young woman, but in reality, she is a lazy girl with no life skills. However, due to family reasons, Hinako has to play the role of the "perfect young lady" at school. Wanting to protect her, Itsuki took on the job of caring for her. Eventually, Hinako began to spoil Itsuki with all her might -- "I don't want...... Itsuki to leave my side right now." This is a love story that begins beyond the master-servant relationship featuring a princess with a beautiful facade.

(Source: HJ Bunko, translated)
anilist:201514.source_doc_raw: 學生會的一己之見II(09)(完結)

anilist:967.synopsis_zh: 平凡的高中生瀨能名津流，有一天早上醒來發現自己變成了超正點的美少女！從班上的偶像沙倉楓借來的詭異玩偶口中得知自己被選作名為“肯普法”的戰士，並且將和世界上的“肯普法”戰士戰鬥……
anilist:967.synopsis_en:
Nuclear war has devastated the planet, turning one fertile ground into a barren, inhospitable landscape on which mankind struggles desperately to stay alive. Society has collapsed and a fight for control wages between vicious dictators, super-powerful mutants, and biker gangs that terrorize the streets.

In a world so cruel and bleak, only the chosen one can restore civilization to its former self. Kenshiro - master of the Hokuto Shinken fighting technique; a martial art so awesomely brutal that only a single being can be entrusted with its full power!

(Source: Manga Entertainment)

anilist:158036.synopsis_zh:
2010年11月22日（星期一）
日本各地被投下了10枚導彈，然而卻出現了沒有一人犧牲的局面，人們稱此次事件為“愚蠢的星期一”，並很快地被人們所淡忘。
事件過後3個月
前往美國進行畢業旅行的森美咲，在白宮前被捲入衝突事件，被一個日本人救下。那人名叫瀧澤朗，他失去記憶，一絲不掛，手裡握著手槍和被衝入82億日元的電子貨幣的手機……。
瀧澤朗是什麼人？謎一般的手機的實體是什麼？瀧澤朗失去的記憶又是什麼？
anilist:158036.synopsis_en: As high school reaches its midpoint, Koichi Asakura—who dreams of studying design at art school—has his plans shaken by explosive graffiti on a museum wall. The artist is Eren Yamagishi, a left-handed girl who buried her talent after a past incident. Drawn together by art, Koichi pursues design as Eren returns to painting, but fear, ambition, and old scars threaten their paths.(Source: Crunchyroll)

titles.ja: 神曲奏界ポリフォニカ クリムゾンS

anilist:5504.synopsis_zh:
精靈和人類，以及神曲。只是以這三個部分所組成世界「POLYPHONICA」為背景的故事 
　　不僅人與精靈共存，同時精靈也擁有著力量，兩者所生活的大陸——POLYPHONICA。人們依賴著精靈所帶來的奇蹟，精靈也以人類所奏的音樂為食量，在這個世界所有的物質以及一切地方發揮著她們的力量。精靈被音樂家所彈奏的音樂操控，發揮著力量。那些能彈奏特殊音樂的人們被稱為“神曲樂士”，有著無尚的尊榮。平時雖然有著隱身的精靈們，但一部分有力量的精靈會以人類或者動物等姿態實體化，同時作為人類的“好朋友”融入社會生活中。 
　　主人公塔塔拉・弗洛恩 ，是培養神曲樂士的弗德神曲學院的學生。雖然無意間與最強的精靈寇緹卡露特締結了契約，但卻因演奏不了重要的神曲處於難以晉級的危險狀態。 
　　在學院生活中，描寫寇緹卡露特與塔塔拉・弗洛恩兩人間的愛情及成長。遇到各種各樣的事情，被追殺，戰鬥。 在那之中，不僅能看到角色之間互相成為同伴，更是沿著人類與精靈這不同生物之間相互理解這一大主題而展開的故事。 
　　月光皎潔之夜，孤兒院的房頂上兩個人相會了。無與倫比的強大精靈——寇緹卡露特與孤獨的少年——弗洛恩。
　　「我想讓你只屬於我一個人的。你那描繪出的魂的形態，只屬於我一個人的。——行嗎？」
　　精靈吟唱著契約的話語。是那結成羈絆的神聖的儀式。但是，所有的一切對那少年來說只不過是黃粱一夢。 
　　之後，時間流逝，那夢的羈絆，在機緣巧合下再次起動。
anilist:5504.synopsis_en:
The new series will again focus on Corticarte, but it will tie into Ichiro Sakaki and Noboru Kannatsuki's Shinkyoku Sōkai Polyphonica crimson S light novel adaptation, which are set during the Academy years of the storyline.

(Source: Anime News Network)

anilist:14653.synopsis_zh: 故事講述了公立高中一年級生的綾崎颯，因其父母性格懶散，使得他不得不每天都打工養家。聖誕夜，回到家中的綾崎颯發現父母留給他一張白條，原來，父母欠下了一億五千萬日圓債務後逃之夭夭。為了還債甚至還企圖販賣綾崎颯的器官。被黑道追殺走投無路的綾崎颯，妄圖綁架附近公園的少女換取贖金，陰差陽錯再加層層誤會之下，綾崎颯反倒成了少女的救命恩人。怎知這位少女正是三千院財閥大小姐，為了報答救命之恩她僱用了綾崎颯當管家，並且償還了他的債務。但是好人綾崎颯卻堅持要償還這筆錢，於是，綾崎颯的管家生活就此開始……
anilist:14653.synopsis_en:
Hayate Ayasaki's life has never been easy, though after being sold to Yakuza who want to harvest your organs to pay off your parents' debts it's hard to imagine things sinking much lower. But since becoming employed as the butler/bodyguard for teenage heiress Nagi Sanzenin, Hayate's misery has been primarily focused around Nagi's insecurity, laziness and the frequent attempts by various parties to kidnap her (with the occasional scheme cooked up by her Grandfather on the side.) However, when a new and unexpected relative arrives without warning, and issues concerning Nagi's long dead father rear their ugly head, Hayate finds himself thrust even further into the deep, dark, messy drama of the Sanzenin clan's affairs. And that is only the beginning of his troubles, as somehow aliens, haunted swords, an untrustworthy kitten and even a cross-dressing curse all come into the mix as well. Will our embattled butler fight his way through these epic complications? Or will his undoing come special de-livery?

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)
anilist:14653.source_doc_raw: 旋風管家3 Can't take my eyes off you(12)(完結)

titles.ja_romaji: Tensei Shitara Dragon no Tamago Datta

anilist:187941.synopsis_zh:
因眼神兇惡而被班裡同學看作不良少年的高須龍兒，進入了高中二年級，並幸運地和暗戀的少女櫛枝實乃梨同班，對嶄新的校園生活滿懷希望。
　　開學典禮後龍兒與校內最恐怖的有“掌上老虎”之稱的逢坂大河狹路相逢，周圍人一同陷入了驚恐狀態。然而他意外地發現，逢坂同時也是實乃梨的閨蜜。
　　在二人相遇的當晚，龍兒知道了原來她暗戀的是自己的好友北村祐作，而自己暗戀實乃梨的事也被大河知道了！互相瞭解對方情況的兩人結成了“戀愛同盟戰線”，開始了半共同生活……
anilist:187941.synopsis_en:
Our hero needs to come out of his shell... literally! Reborn in another world inside a dragon egg, he doesn’t have the amazing magic or mighty physical strength of your typical isekai’d adventurer just yet. He’ll need to break free and grow from a weak hatchling and into a fearsome beast if he wants to escape the deep, dark forest unscathed. What battles and adventures await him in this unique take on the isekai phenomenon?

(Source: HIDIVE)

anilist:10490.synopsis_zh:
私立翠明學園高中二年級學生的西條拓巳，自稱對三次元沒有興趣，和家裡的大量美少女人偶一起生活。在他所住的澀谷在2008年9月7日以來發生了連續獵奇殺人事件“新世代的瘋狂”，成為了網路和電視上的熱門話題。
2008年9月28日深夜，拓巳在聊天室遇到了一個自稱“將軍”的人。“將軍”發言中的URL連結到像是預言下一個獵奇事件的恐怖影象。
第二天，拓巳遇到了和影象中的手法一樣的殺人現場。在屍體前站著渾身是血的少女，咲畑梨深。
anilist:10490.synopsis_en:
Saya is a seemingly normal girl living with her father in a shrine. During the day she goes to school and spends time with her friends at a local cafe. But when night falls Saya is called upon to protect her village from strange monsters. 
(Source: Anime News Network)

anilist:4181.synopsis_zh:
故事發生在一個小鎮上，岡崎朋也是光坂高中在校生，因為家庭原因他一直過著渾渾噩噩的生活。他不參加任何社團活動，唯一的朋友是春原陽平。
某天的上學途中，在櫻花飛舞的坡道上，他邂逅了一名少女——古河渚，從此他的生活發生改變。渚因病休學一年，重返校園的她對周圍環境感到相當不適應。她想加入戲劇部，然而戲劇部早已休部。朋也決定幫助她一起開展戲劇部的活動，二人關係變得越發親密。隨後不久朋也在圖書館中結識了一名天才少女一之瀨琴美。
anilist:4181.synopsis_en:
A few months have passed since Tomoya declared his love to Nagisa, and his life keeps moving forward as he continues to meet a variety of new people, expanding his world in the process. While Tomoya's world continues to expand, his and Nagisa's relationship is entering a new phase, and neither of them is quite sure where it will take them. Through his relationship with Nagisa, Tomoya begins to understand the meaning and importance of family.

But as Tomoya and Nagisa begin a family of their own, they are faced with many hardships along the way in Clannad: After Story

(Source: Sentai Filmworks, edited)

Note: Includes 2 un-numbered 'extra' and 'summary' episodes that aired at the end of the series.

titles.ja: ロザリオとバンパイア

anilist:4214.synopsis_zh:
平凡的少年青野月音高中應試失敗，卻因父親撿到一個神甫掉落的陽海學園的傳單，由此進入了這所怪異的學校。在開學第一天的入學儀式上，便遇到了美少女赤夜萌香。這個人人都想跟其約會的美少女的正體竟然是吸血鬼！！平常很安靜的她，只要外界有大型妖怪的出現，月音取下她胸前的十字架後，便會促使萌香體內吸血鬼正體的覺醒，變身為強大的吸血鬼，爆發出驚人力量！為了恢復學園的平靜生活，她將跟眾多妖怪作戰，並將其一網打盡！
　　如此複雜的愛戀中，又插進少女夢魔黑乃胡夢跟魔法少女仙童紫，還有身為雪女的白雪，精彩的後宮式動畫！
anilist:4214.synopsis_en: A year has passed since Tsukune was sent to the Youkai academy. Tsukune has gotten used to life there, or so he thought. As a second year, him and the girls are looked up to by the juniors. On the first day back to school, a sudden encounter with Shuzen Kokoa, takes a turn for the worst. What Adventures or should we say, misadventures await our human, vampire and friends?

anilist:136668.synopsis_zh:
The series follows Team Estrella, a group of young and talented Beywheelers residing at Destection City. The peace of that place is threatened until a group of aggressive wheelers calling themselves Dominators attempts to take over the Beywheelz world. Unable to accept such a reign of terror Team Estrella opposes the Dominators and ends up fighting them in the Judgement Bey tournament which is to decide the fate of the world they live in as well as the fate of an unknown yet undiscovered one.

此作品於美國與多國放送，日本和其他亞洲地區尚未播映。
